tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bdag nyid ky-i rnam thar nges par brjod pa'i deb gter shin tu zhib mo ma bcos lhug pa'i rtogs brjod ces bya ba'i stod cha bzhugs/

༄༅/ / na mo gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twā+e bh+yaḥ oṃ swa sti sarba pra dzā bh+yaḥ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bdag nyid kyi rnam thar nges par brjod pa'i deb gter shin tu zhib mo ma bcos lhug pa'i rtogs brjod ces bya ba/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rtag brtan g.yung drung 'od gsal rdo rje sems/ / gdod nas rnam dag mkha' bzhin 'phel 'grib bral/ / chos kun 'byung ba sangs rgyas sa bon te/ / rang sems gdod ma'i mgon po rgyal gyur cig/ gang zhig dngos grub gnyis kyi rin chen gter gyur byin rlabs rlabs 'phreng g.yo ba gdams pa'i chu gter rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ / gang las 'gro rnams so so'i bsam pa dang mthun tshangs pa'i 'khor lo bskor mdzad don gnyis phun sum tshogs gyur rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ / gang 'dir zab zhi spros bral rang bzhin gdod nas dag c-ing dri ma rnam spangs 'gog pa'i bden gyur lung rtogs dang bcas dam pa'i chos/ / srid 'dir nag phyogs mun sel mtha' dag yon tan cha shas rab rdzogs theg gsum 'phags tshogs rnams la'ang gus pas dngos po kun gyis 'dud/ / sems nyid thog tha med pa'i brjod bral las/ / srid zhi kun tu 'char ba gnyug ma'i ngang*/ / 'di ni cho 'phrul mtha' yas ston pa'i phyir/ / de 'dra mtha' dag su yis brjod par nus/ /blun pos brjod pa ji ltar 'bad na yang*/ / gzhan gyi don du 'gyur ba ma mthong bas/ / re zhig mi smra'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa mchog/ smra na 'phags pa'i rnam thar brjod par smon/ / rang gi yon tan brjod pa dman pa'i lugs/ / rdzun du brjod na 'phags pa rnams kyis khrel/ khyad 'phags yon tan bdag la brjod rgyu med/ / gnas tshul sgro skur med par brjod na ko / gzhan gyis nan tan bskul ba'i phyir/ / rang gi rnam thar mdo tsam bshad/ / dus kyang dron du 'gyur mod kyi/ / shes ldan thams cad bzod par mdzod/ / de yang gdod ma'i mgon po dang*/

de bzhin nyid dang*/ zag pa med pa'i dbyings dang*/ chos nyid kun tu 'gro ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang*/ rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba dang*/ dang po'i sangs rgyas dang*/ rgyu'i rdo rje 'chang ba la sogs pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs brjod kyi mi lang bas bsnyad par bya ba/ sems nyid rig pa'i skyes bu chen po gang de'i mdzad 'phrin rmad du byung ba ni/ rnam par byang ba'i chos mtha' dag yongs su spel ba dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang*/ ye shes dang*/ yon tan dang mdzad pa 'phrin las thams cad 'dus byas kyi dbus su nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i gter chen po/ mi 'drul zhing bsrung bar mdzad pa dang*/ nam zhig rigs yongs su sad pa nas brtsams te/ gter gyi bum bzang de nyid rim pas phyung ste/ rang bzhin gyi 'dod dgu bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad pa ni/ srid zhi thams cad kyi mgon po dpal yongs grub chen po'i rnam thar bzang po 'phel 'grib med pa'o/ / de ltar yang*/ de bzhin nyid ni thams cad la/ khyad par med kyang dag gyur pa/ de bzhin gshegs nyid de yi phyir/ 'gro kun de yi snying po can/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gcig pur ma bas te mkha' khyab mkha'i rdo rje can dang*/ cha med dang*/ kun 'gro dang*/ khyab bdag dang*/ klong yangs dang*/ khyab gdal chen po yin no/ / de lta bu'i gdod ma'i ye shes de dang lhan cig skyes pa ngo bo de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pa kun gzhi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba/ srid pa'i bdag po zhig yod de/ ji skad du/ de bzhin kun gzhi'i chu bo yang*/ / rtag tu yul gyi rkyen gyis 'byung*/ / rnam shes rba rlabs sna tshogs kyis/ / rab tu g.yo bas gar byed do/ / zhes pa ltar/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i chu klung bye ba phrag brgya 'bab cing bsten pa'i rgya mtsho chen po srid pa thog ma med pa nas/ yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du ma byas pa de srid du rtag tu 'bab pa rnam par shes pa'i tshogs bdun dang*/

sna tshogs pa'i tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes tha dad pa dang*/ gzhal du med pa'i 'du byed dang bcas pa'i tshogs kyi rlabs 'phreng g.yo ba/ gnas snod kyi 'jig rten dang*/ don gzugs sogs yul lnga dang*/ lus dbang po lnga ru snang ba'i rnam rig gi gzugs brnyan rnam par bkra ba rtag tu 'char zhing nub par byed pa'i kun gzhi'i chu gter chen po de las/ 'gro ba drug tu brgyud ma nas brgyud mar 'khor ba'i rnam par thar pa'i mtshan ma ya ma zung brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa dag yod mod kyi/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas srid par 'khyams pa'i snang tshul de lta bu ni brjod kyis kyang ga la lang zhing*/ ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs kyi gzhan dbang las phal cher dran pa'i lam na mi snang bas der bas la/ rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa'i mngon par shes pa drug dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ gzungs dang*/ ye shes la sogs pa sa dang lam gyi yon tan khyad par can ma thob ba'i phyir/ mi chos bla ma las gyur pa yang dag pa ma yin pa'i tshig gis las kyi sgrib pa mchog tu lci ba sgrub bar ga la spobs/ der ma zad rgyas ba sras bcas kyi yon tan khyad par can brjod du yod bzhin du/ so so skye bo nyon mongs pa'i 'dam du bying ba/ rmongs pas rnam par g.yogs pa/ srid pa'i chu bo las ma brgal ba/ sred pas bcings pa/ yang dag pa'i don la kho re chung ba/ bdag lta bu'i las snang gi 'char sgo yi ger dgod par rtsom pa ni ngal ba kho na'i rgyu yin mod kyi/ bskul ba po shin tu mang po dag gi ngo ma chogs pas cung zad smra bar bgyi na/ sngon dam pa'i chos kyi phyogs su cung zad bya ba byas shing*/ smon lam rnam par dag pa lan 'ga' zung btab pa 'dra ste/ tshe 'dir dam pa'i chos kyi bya ba sgrub pa la bar chad kyi sgo med pa'i khyim du skyes shing*/ gang gis khyim du srog gcod pa spangs shing dkon mchog gsum dang*/ yi dam gyi lha rnams dang chos skyong dam pa ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams gus pas bsten pa dang mchod pa la brtson zhing bzlas brjod dang sgrub pas dus 'da' ba'i rigs su skye ba nye bar bzung*/

chung ngu nas rje btsun thugs rje can rnams kyi bka' drin las chos kyi snang bas dus 'das chog pa byung ba dang*/ ngar 'dzin gyi snang ba cung zad srab cing*/ dam pa'i chos kyi gtam zab mo dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rmad du byung ba dang*/ skyes pa'i rabs rnams dang*/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa mthong ba'am thos na yid dga' ba dang skyo ba zung du 'brel bas khyab cing ba spu ldang ba dang*/ gting nas mchi ma 'khrug pa'i dad pa gsum lhag par stobs su gyur pas/ chos brgyad kyi snang ba rags pa 'phral du 'gog nus pa tsam rtag tu 'ong zhing*/ khyad par byis pa mno mi shes pa'i dus nas kyang*/ gsang sngags kyi lha'i sku brnyan mthong ba'am/ cho ga dang bzlas brjod byed pa dang*/ kun spang gi spyod pa can dag mthong ba dang*/ bskyed rdzogs kyi gtam dang che ba cung zad thos pa dang*/ mi rtog pa dang lung sgom pa la sogs pa'i rnam cha mthong ba'i tshe/ bdag kyang 'di lta bur gyur na ci ma rung snyam pa dang*/ dga' bdes nye bar drangs te nyin mtshan gyi snang ba yul yul por 'gyur ba dang*/ 'gro ba la brtse sems kyang chung ngu'i dus nas cung zad 'char ba dang*/ sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam pa gting tshugs pa zhig kyang dran pa rnyed tsam nyid nas yod cing*/ da lta zab mo'i chos mang po la snying thag pa nas nges pa cung zad skye bar snang ba'i phyir ro/ / 'dir smras pa/ rang blo rang la lkog tu ma gyur bas/ / 'di dag rang gis rang la ma khrel tsam/ / 'di tsam rdzun med 'di las lhag pa'ang med/ / gang gi dpang por spyan ldan 'phags rnams bzhugs/ / de ldar gleng slang pa'i dge mtshan yongs su spel nas bdag nyid kyi rigs rus dang 'brel ba'i gtam cung zad cig brjod na/ skad gnyis smra ba mthu stobs dbang phyug rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags pa zhes mtshan srid pa gsum du yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi sku'i rigs su 'khrungs shing thugs kyi sras su gyur pa ni/

skad gnyis smra ba chos rab yin la/ de nyid kyi sku'i rigs la rwa shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las/ nub par mtshan gsol ba/ slob dpon chen po rwa ye shes seng ge dang*/ de'i sras rwa 'bum seng ste/ yab sras de dag ni sprul pa'i skyes mchog lung dang rtogs pa mtha' yas pa'i mnga' bdag chen po yin no/ / rwa shar par grags pa dharma seng ge ba/ de'i sras dkon mchog seng ge de'i sras shes rab rgyal mtshan te/ de gsum yang mkhas shing nus pa thob pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po sha stag tu byon no/ / rwa sher rgyal la sras gsum mnga' ba las/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sku mched ni g.yas ru nub mdar 'khrungs shing*/ gtsang rong dang ru mtshams su 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa zhig byung zhes grags la/ sras che ba rin chen rgyal mtshan ni/ yar 'brog 'phrang du yon bdag mo nam mkha' 'bum zhes bya ba las 'khrungs shing*/ cher skyes nas yab la gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum dang mgon nag la sogs pa'i rgyud lung man ngag thams cad gsan te mkhas par sbyangs/ dus 'khor la sogs pa yab chos gzhan yang ci rigs pa mkhyen/ sman dpyad dang skar rtsis sogs la mkhas pa zhig byung*/ yar 'brog 'phrang rigs kyi nub stod du gnyan dang jo bo la sogs pas sbyin bdag byas nas gshin rje'i lcags mkhar la dpe byas pa'i mkhar brtsigs nas der bzhugs pas/ rwa lcags mkhar ba zhes thogs so/ / sgrub pas nus mthu chen po yang mngon du gyur/ thong lcags chag pa la ljags btab pas zhi zhing 'brel ba dang*/ thog ser dang cho 'phrul la sogs pa thogs med du sgrub pa zhig go / 'dir smras pa/ de la rigs sras lnga tsam yod pa las/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mtshan grags thon pa ni/ / gsum pa chos dbyings pa nyid yin zhes thos/ / sngags kyi lag len bshad bka' la sogs pa/ / lhad med tshig gi brgyud pa ma nyams shing*/ / bsgrubs pa'i byin rlabs rgyun yang che bar yod/

/ yar 'brog phyogs dang gtsang rong la bzhugs pa'i/ / rwa yi rigs brgyud mang po yod pa rnams/ / phan tshun thugs mthun grwa rigs mang ba dang*/ / yon bdag la sogs phun sum tshogs par byung*/ / de yi sras ni brtson 'grus seng ge yin/ / gsang phur 'jam dbyangs shākya gzhon nu la/ / phar tshad bslabs shing pha mes chos la mkhas/ / 'ba' ra ba las rlung phyag zhus te 'byongs/ / de la sras gnyis chos kyi bsam 'grub dang*/ / chos kyi bkra shis zhes byas rnying ma bslabs/ kha thun tshe bdag 'char kha la sogs pa'i/ / gshin rje gshed dang phur pa jo mo lugs/ / nyang gi gter chos sogs la mkhas par byas/ / tshe bdag bsgrubs pas nus pa che bar byung*/ / dang po'i sras ni shes rab seng ge dang*/ / phyi ma'i sras ni tshe bdag skyabs zhes brjod/ / phyi mas la stod phyogs su byon zhes zer/ / dang po'i sras ni kun dga' seng ge yin/ / mngon dga' chos sder pod chen bzhi la bslabs/ / phyi nas bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal dang*/ / gzhan yang bla ma mang po bsten pa las/ / gsang sngags gsar ma'i chos lugs mang po thos/ / pha mes rnams la las tshogs sna tshogs pa'i/ / lag len khrigs chags mthong brgyud yod na yang*/ / pha chos rnams kyi dbang bka' bar du nub/ / chos rje ngag dbang pa la dbang rnams zhus/ / mos zhen dbang gis rdo rje 'jigs byed bsgrubs/ / re ma tī yi zhal yang mthong bar grags/ / skabs der yar 'brog khri dpon dang zlos nas/ / g.yor po stod kyi phyogs na slob ma dang*/ / yon bdag mang du yod pa'i phyogs su phyin/ / dgra bo'i yul du mthu rtags mang du bstan/ / gnas gzh-i ri khrod chung ngu mang du btab/ / sdig bshags don du bcom ldan kun rig gi / bsnyen sgrub byas shing gzhan yang byed du bcug/ gdung la rdo rje sems dpa' rang byon byung*/ / de la sras gnyis seng ge dpal ldan dang*/ / chos kyi seng ger bod pa rnam pa gnyis/ / phyi mas kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel ba yi/

/ chos grwar byon zhing rab 'byams smra ba dang*/ / rig gnas phra mo yang ni mang po mkhyen/ / yi dam dmar nag 'jigs gsum yun ring bsgrubs/ / rab 'byams smra ba 'jam dpal grags pa la/ / bo dong lugs kyi chos lugs mang po gsan/ / g.yas ru shangs su pha rgod bsod bzang la/ / shangs chos yongs rdzogs zhus nas yun ring bsgoms/ / chos skyong myur mdzad ye shes mgon po dang*/ / dpal mgon ma ning dam can mang por bcas/ / bsgrubs pas grub ste mthu brtsal dpag tu med/ / drag po'i las grub dge slong yin na yang*/ / las su mthu gtad ser ba dag la brtson/ / g.yo ru gzhung du dgra bo'i mkhar khyim la/ / dgun dus gnam lcags lan gsum bstud mar phab/ / yul dpon la sogs gnod byed thams cad stongs/ / 'on kyang nai gu'i 'pho ba thebs nas gshegs/ / seng ge dpal gyi bu gnyis byung ba ni/ / 'jam dbyangs blo gros dang ni 'jam dbyangs bzang*/ / 'jam dbyangs bzang pos chos rje bsod grags la/ / sbyor drug zhus pas nyams rtogs bzang po skyes/ / snga mas gtsang gi phung po ri bo cher/ / rjogs chen yun ring bsgoms pa'i lo rgyus snang*/ / dang po'i sras ni bdag gi bla ma yin/ / mes po'ang yin te rig sngags 'chang chen po/ / mtshan ni tshul khrims rnam rgyal zhes pa yin/ / byis pa'i dus na chos grags rgya mtsho'i drung*/ / yig drug bzlas lung tsam zhig gsan zhes gsung*/ / chos rje 'phrin las pa la phar tshad bslabs/ / rlung sems dbyer med la sogs chos 'ga' zhus/ / dbus smyon pa dang pad+ma gling pa dang*/ / zur dbon pa dang so ston kun gzhon sogs/ / snga phyir phyag rdzogs bla ma mang po bsten/ / rnying ma'i phyogs la mkhyen pa shin tu che/ / 'jigs byed la sogs gshed skor rnams dang ni/ / stod 'brug skor dang ngan song sbyong rgyud sogs/ / gsar ma'ang mkhyen cing skar rtsis sman dpyad dang*/ / rten 'brel phra mo sna tshogs mang du mkhyen/

/ rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag na rdo rje dang*/ / ma ning nag po bsgrubs pas rtags kyang thon/ / snga phyi'i yul lha bran du 'khol bar mdzad/ / mkhyen brtse nus mthu gsum ka mnga' ba'i phyir/ / 'gro ba rnams la phan pa rgya cher mdzad/ / gang 'di'i drin las bdag gi pha yis kyang*/ / thog ser la sogs nus pa 'ga' re thon/ / de dag rdzun med bshul ni da lta'ang yod/ / de ltar kho bo'i rus pa'i byung khungs ni/ / rwa lo'i rigs las byung ba yin zhes gleng*/ / nged kyi pha mes brgyud 'di chos nas gzhal na lo tsā ba chen po dang chos mkhas pa dang mthu bo che'i brgyud pa de yin/ 'jig rten gyi dpal 'byor ni/

rwa lo chen po chos rgyal khri ral dang 'dra bar grags pa de lags/ de rjes rwa lo 'bum seng dang sher rgyal yan chad kyang 'phrin las dpag tu med/ dper na bla chen 'phags pas ldong ston dang rong pa rga lo gnyis rwa'i bu chen slob brgyud yin pa de bla mar khur ba lta bu yin/ bod kyi bla ma bzang tshad rwa'i chos 'og tu ma chud pa med pa des mtshon/ pha mes phyis kyi tsho khas drag dpung pa 'dzoms pa dang nor shed ngom thub pa rang med de/ rang rang so so'i thad ka der grwa slob yon bdag skyong rgyu yod nges shes pa'i 'phrin las dang yi dam chos skyong la gsol ba thebs tsam gyi nus mthu yod nges pa yin/ de la nged kyi mes dang pha yan chad khyim btsun sngags pa thams cad kyang dge slong la phar phyag 'tshal/ rten gsum la zhabs tog byed/ bza' ba dang rin gyi don du srog chags la 'tshe ba nam yang spangs/ lo bcu'i bar du klog sogs sbyong*/ nyi shu'i bar du dpe 'dzin bshor/ sum cu'i bar du sgro 'dogs gcod/ bzhi bcu'i bar du bzlas sgom sgrub zer/ de rjes khyim pa rnams bag ma'i bya ba sogs mi chos byed/ sngon gyi bram chen dang bod kyi'ang sngon gyi sngags pa'i mig ltos bzang po de ma nyams par skyong mkhan rang shas che/ deng sang ngam phyis kyi bla ma brgyud can bla brang sngags pa ba bla chen dang bla chung khyu gcig srog gcod la ni mi 'dzem/ sku gsung thugs rten la ras chod byed/ mno ma shes pa'i byas pa nas nal bu rlogakhyim thab snga mo nas len pa la dpa' dpa' mo byed pa de tshad min/ gsar ma'i spyod pa shas che ba'i sngags pa mkhan po tshad ma rang byon/ mi brgyud de rwa shar ba yin/ chos rwa nub pa yin/ gnyen gra sgrigs dang rdzun rib dang lag 'phrul la skyabs tshol mi dgos pa'i sngags pa kha yod lag yod rkyang ba byung ba lags so/ / da ni kho bo nyid kyi gnas tshul sgrag par bya ste/ de la bdag gang du skye ba bzung ba'i yul ni/

dbus gtsang gi mtshams na bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces grags pa/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ga ya dha ra dang*/ / gnyos lo tsā ba yab sras rnams dang*/ gzhan yang ā tsar+ya gnyan dpal dbyangs dang*/ kha rag sgom chung la sogs skyes mchog du mas bsten pa'i gnas de nyid dang nye ba/ bod yul dbus kyi char gtogs pa/ lu hi ta'i chu klong la snyen par 'grogs pa/ 'brang zhes bya ba'i yul grong khyer gyi bkod pa yid du 'ong bas brgyan pa/ bza' shing gi rwa ba'i skyed tshal du mas rnam par khyab pa/ ri bo sman ljongs nyams dga' ba du ma dang*/ tshal sna tshogs pas mdzes pa/ sngon gnyos jo sras rdo rje bla ma la sogs pas yun ring du bsten pa'i gnas gzhi zhig tu phyis chos rje kun dga' seng ges chos 'khor sdings zhes pa'i dgon gnas chung ngu zhig 'debs par mdzad pa 'di lags te/ bdag skye ba 'dzin rgyu'i lo snga ma de tho rangs keng rus chen po dngos su byung ba mi mang po rang gis mthong ba dang*/ stes dbang yin pa gzhir bcas na'ang bkra shis brag zer ba cig yod pa de'i rdo che ba gcig gas shing lhung ba la ma ṇi rang byon chen po cig byung ba ni da lta yang brag logs la yod pa 'di yin/ de la sngags 'chang dam pa tshul khrims mtshan can la rigs kyi sras bzhi yod pa las/ che shos rnam rgyal phun tshogs zhes bya ba bdag gi pha lags shing*/ skye ba 'di nyid kyi lus skyed par byed pa la gcig tu drin che ba mar gyur pa ni/ mtshan rdo rje bu dga' zhes bya ba yin zhing*/ bdag gi pha ni mkhyen rgya mi che yang yi dam lha'i bskyed rim dmigs pa la brtan pa cung zad thob pa yi dam dang chos skyong gi bzlas bsnyen grangs med pa song zhing*/ byin rlabs dang nus mthus brgyan pa/ chos brgyad kyi rnam par rtog pa nub pa'i 'khrul zhig chen por bzhugs/

bdag gi ma yang thugs snying rje che zhing dge ba la dkar ba/ zab cing dkyel che ba'i ngang tshul can no/ / de la yab kyis dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe drugayum gyis dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa'i tshe/ bdag gi yang srid yongs su bzung bar 'dug cing*/ yum gyi mnal lam du 'brang phu gzims khang khang pa brgya che zhing dpangs mtho ba zhig tu gyur pa la yum gyi thog rtse nas dung dkar phyogs bzhir 'bud pa dang*/ yang lan cig rmi lam du rin po che ba la dbang zhus pas/ gser gyi rdo rje zhig spyi bor bzhagaslar de sku 'phrag tu bcug pa'i snang ba byung zhing*/ de'i gnas tshul mes po rin po che la zhus pas/ de srid 'khor ba de'i ltas yin/ 'di la dga' mo zhig 'ong ba yin te 'ong*/ zhes gsung*/ de nas bdag rum na yod pa'i skabs de nyid la rgyal gyi zla ba'i skabs ldum ra'i rgyal men gyi rtsa ba 'ga' re zhig kha 'bus shing*/ cho 'phrul gyi skabs su rkang mi mngon pa'i me tog kha bye ba yang tho re long nge ba byung 'dug pa mthong zhing rgyus yod pa'i mi da lta yang mang du yod/ de kun yang dge mtshan gyi ltas tsam yin par mngon no/ / de nas na tshod ldan zhes pa/ shing mo phag lo chu stod kyi zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi nyi ma rtse shar la bdag btsas par 'dug cing*/ de yang grod pus g.yogs pa'i rnam pa can du byung*/ lte ba gcod pa sogs ni gang yang ma dgos/ de la mes po rin po ches lde mig gis grod pu'i rgya dral pa sogs rten 'brel mdzad/ de skabs skra phra mo g.yeng g.yeng ba kha dog dkar po nyag gcig yod pa zhig byung*/ phyis rim pas kha dog nag por 'gyur/ skra dkar bo yeng yeng 'di'i rigs la shes rab chen po 'ong*/ grib gyis ma bsgribs pa gyis gsung*/ sri ngan bzlog pa'i phyir/ sri gcod rdo rje zhes ming stsal/ zla ba brgyad tsam nas 'gro ba dang*/ lo dus smra shes pa zhig byung 'dugabatsas nas lo gnyis su nye bar tsam na/

'khru nad drag po zhig gis btab/ a khus sman dpyad shin tu mkhas par mkhyen pas/ sman dang rim gro sogs gang drag mdzad 'dug na'ang*/ khyad cang ma byung zhing*/ byis pa nad theg chung ba nas sna yang zhom/ do nub tsam thub bam sang zhogs tsam thub bam zer ba las/ gzhan 'chi bar thag bcad pa'i tshe/ de'i sang zhogs nam langs tsam la nang gi skas nas yar a tsa ra lnga tsam zhig 'dzegs nas byung nas/ sngon ma des po ti zhig gis nged la byin rlabs byed kyin mang po zhig lab kyin yod par 'dugade rnams slar yang skas la babs/ de phyin chad gar song cha med/ pha dang zhang bo sogs nang mi lnga tsam yod 'dug pa thams cad kyis mthun par mthong zhing*/ mthong ba las bya byed kyi blo gang yang ma byung bar 'duga'adi ni de ltar bar chad kyis gtses pa la snga rol gyi skye ba gzhan du bla mar gyur pa rnams kyis bar chad de bzlog par mdzad pa yin par sems/ de kho nas nad de drag ste/ zhag gsum bzhi nas sor chud par snang ngo*/ / btsas tsam nas de skabs phan chad du nyin mtshan phal cher mig mi 'dzum par gnyid du 'gro ba la mi phal cher gyis smra brjod nyung zhing bem lugs 'dis glen lkugs cig 'ong ngam zer/ mes po rin po che'i gsung nas mig mi 'dzum par gnyid du 'gro ba ni 'od gsal zin pa la 'ong bar grags/ gang ltar na'ang 'di ma'i lus la 'khris pa tshun chad nas/ dmigs ltas dga' rab kyang byung bas mi phal pa rang min tsam zhig 'ong zhes yang yang gsung zer/ de nas smra shes tsam gyi dus zhig na thog khar nyi ma la bsnyal ba'i tshe/ rlung sems cung zad dbu mar chug pa'i rtags yin pa 'dra/ nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon dra ba ris su 'byung zhing*/ de dag gi bar bar na lha sku'i rnam pa sku mdog dang dbyibs sna tshogs pa kho nas nam mkha' 'khrig mer gyis 'gro ba yang nas yang du mthong ba byung zhing*/ da lta'ang blo yul na gsal bar snang*/ de dag dang dus mi ring bar mes po rin po che la jo gdan 'ga' zhig dang*/

chu byang kha nas 'ongs pa'i sngags pa so sos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang dang*/ mgon po ma ning dang gu ru drag dmar nag dang*/ phyag bzhi pa gter mgon dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs su gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dbang bskur la sogs pa pha chos 'ga' zung stsal te de kun zhor chos la thob yod par 'dug cing*/ dkyil 'khor dang mchod bshams la sogs pa da lta'ang yid yul la ci rigs par 'dug cing chos kyi tshig don la ni go rtogs cang ma byung*/ chos gral du sdod tshugs shing dbang rdzas zhu tshul sogs mkhas par byung bas rin po ches dges dges mdzad zer/ bskang gso 'chag med du mdzad kyin 'dug pas gtor chab sbron pa dang*/ rnga g.yog 'bul ba sogs phyag g.yog chung chung dgos pa rnams la brtson par byas/ pha mes kyi 'du shes tsam min par bla ma'i mos gus kyang dga' rab skyes 'dugaphal cher pha ma'i zla la ma nyal bar mchod khang du mes po'i drung du nyal/ de skabs mchod bshom la bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i sku brnyan che rab zhig bzhugs kyin 'dug pas/ de'i dri rtog yang yang zhus pas mdzad bcu la sogs pa'i lo rgyus 'ga' re gsung*/ lo rgyus rtsa rtse tshang ba ni blo la ma chags pa 'dug na'ang dad mos chen po skyes shing sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam pa bcos ma min pa byung*/ gshed dmar gyi thang sku lha mgron la kyai rdor yod pa zh-ig 'dug pa/ lha de gnyis mthong ba tsam gyis sems dga' cham cham pa rtag tu 'ong*/ ltad mo gzhan la dga' tshor chung zhing*/ yi dam chos skyong gi sngags sku zing zing 'dug pa kun la yang yang blta 'dod pa'i dga' sems che bar byung bas/ mes po'i gsung nas 'di rdo rje slob dpon zhig gi skye ba yin par 'dug ces gsungs pa'ang dran/ yang re 'ga' ri dwags shor mkhan 'dra mthong ba'i tshe/

snying rje chen po skyes te rang dbang med par mchi ma 'chor ba 'byung zhing lung ba 'di'i ri dwags rnams ngas bsrung dgos pa 'dug snyam pa dang*/ 'di bsrungs kyang de'i pha rol na lung ba dang ri dwags yod/ de'i pha rol na'ang yod snyam pa sogs mtha' med du shar nas gcig bsrungs kyang gzhan rnams ji ltar drag snyam pa'i gang drag ci drag mi tshugs pa tsam yong ba zhig yod cing*/ yang lan cig sgo rtsa na bya btang 'ga' re slong zhing 'dugade nas pha tshad kyi zhing kha na lus gnad bcas sgom byed byed ltar 'dug pas yid la ngo mtshar dang dang ba chen po skyes te/ nga yang 'di lta bu zhig tu gyur na snyam pa yang yang byung*/ yang mon rtse ba'i rtogs ldan 'ga' re rlung bzung zhing 'khrul 'khor byed pa mthong bas kyang de dang 'dra bar gyur/ da lta ltas na khong tsho'i de rang chos gzugs kun gyi spyi nor de ka yin pa 'dra ste rang re blo 'gyur ba ni byung*/ dgon pa ba rnams kun rig gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas sgrub mchod byed pa mthong ba la'ang dga' ba chen po skyes shing cho ga'i sgang la gral la sdod tshugs par byas/ lan cig kha rag gam phu ba'i sngags pa chos rje yon rgyam ba de/ mes po rin po che'i drung du don spyod pa zhig la 'dugamangon spyod kyi gsung bgros mang dag zhig mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ nga rang gis kyang 'di lta bu mang po zhig byas snyam pa sogs yid la ji snyed cig shar/ yang thog kha na yod pa'i skabs shig 'jol mo rnams skad mang po 'don gyin 'dug pas skad kyi gdangs la dbon po sri gcod ces nga rang gi ming nas 'bod pa dang*/ yul mi 'dra'i skyid sdug yod tshul lab pa sogs lan 'ga' yar du byung*/ de skabs gnyid min sad min pa rmi lam shin tu gsal snang che ba/ yul mi so sor na tsha shi chad sogs kyi rtags mtshan gsal bar things pa dang*/ re 'ga' mngon sum du'ang mi ma yin gyi spyod pa re re tsam mthong ba byung*/

phyis sde dpon gyi rdzaung gzhis sogs su phyin pa nas gsal snang de kun yang 'gribs nas song*/ yang lan cig a tsa ra 'ga' shas lam zhor la sgo rtsa na lto slong gin 'dug pa mthong nas kyang dga' spro dpag tu med pa skyes shing rgya gar gha ya la sogs pa yin snyam pa'i yul mang po zhig yid yul du wal wal shar ro/ / smras pa/ sngon goms dbang las mtha' dag dge ba'i chos/ / gcig car shar ba 'di las legs tshogs ni/ / ma tshang med pa nam yang 'byung ba yang*/ / sngon gyi dge ba'i mthu dpal 'ba' zhig yin/ / de ltar smra shes pa nas rang lo bzhi'i steng du sleb pa tshun chad du smra brjod kyi sgo la/ nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin/ nye gnas dpal 'byor zer ba zhig yod de/ rngog rong 'og ma ba tshang gi nang la song zer ba zhig gzhan gyis rtsed mo dang kyal ka sogs ky-is dris pa la'ang yang yang smra ba zhig brgyud mar byung 'dugagazhan 'ga' re la yong ba'i slob mkhan de 'dra'i rigs ni gtan nas med pa rang sems dpang bo thub par yod/ pha ma dang yul ba rnams ni rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gi zhal mthong ba lta ci smos/ mtshan thos pa tsam yang med pas thog mar re zhig rang babs su smra ba zhig yod pa la/ dge 'dun sgang pa'i jo gdan 'ga' zhig gis rje dam pa de nyid dbus gtsang yongs kyi bla ma yin tshul brjod 'dug pas/ de skabs bu gcig po yin pas nged rang la yang de bzhin ma zer gsung ba'i dam bzhag mdzad kyang*/ byis par song bas sngar bzhin ka smras/ de skabs chos dbang bzang po ba gzims khang du yang yang yong ba zhig yod pa/ khong gi a khu rje btsun dam pa la mos pa can cig yod pa la khong bas glengs 'dug cing*/ de sde ba'i dpon yig pa yin pa 'dug pa nas/ yar 'brog tu khri dpon chen po bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po la zhu bar phyin pa bzhin/ sde pa rang la'ang mnal lam bzang po khyad par can byung gsung zhing*/

de 'phral dngos la gos chas sogs bzab rgyas su stsal/ de nas sde pa bstan 'dzin drung gis/ mkhan chen rin po che dang*/ rgyal rtse nas brtsams te/ zhabs drung stobs rgyas drung gi bar tshun chad kyi/ rjes dam pa'i yon bdag dang bu chen rnams kyi sar gnas tshul re yang 'bul ba gnang 'dugakhyad par chos rje rig 'dzin pa ched kyis mngags nas/ khong la rje dam pas gnang ba'i dbu rgyan bya spu ma zhig yod cing*/ gzhan yang gong dkar chos sde sogs nas dbang rdzas mang du g.yar nas/ 'brang phug gzims khang gi sgo rtsar 'ongs/ thog kha nas ngas bltas khong 'dug pa mthong ste/ chos rjes rig 'dzin pa sleb 'dug byas/ chos rje thal byung du nang du shor/ dbang rdzas de kun bkrams nas nged la bstan pa la dbu rgyan sgro ser ma de blang te/ nga rang gi yin tshul sogs cal col mang du smras/ chos rjes ngus shing byin rlabs zhus/ de nas mi ring bar bstan 'dzin ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po'i drung yang phebs byung zhing*/ gsol ja bzhugs gral zhig 'duganged la gdan dma' ba zhig byung bas khro zhing sdod ma 'dod/ zur sbug cig tu logs se ba byas te cang ma smras par bsdad/

jo gi zhig dang gsung 'phros mdzad kyin 'dug pa cung zad go ba snyam byed/ nges kyang phan ma byung*/ bal po rgya gling pa gnyis 'dug pa'i sar phyin/ zhabs drung yang dgyes rgyu med tsam la de 'phral phebs song*/ bka' las kyang sku khams ni dwangs po 'dug ste/ rje dam pa rang ni min pa 'dra zhes dbus phyogs kun la gsungs 'dug cing*/ gong dkar na phyag ris ngos ma rang 'dug pa dngos su mthong*/ dngos cag lta bu bar dor mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i slob dpon spyod pa ba yang srid 'dzin pa'i tshul ston pa lta ga la zhig sa thob pa'am de la nye bar bsnyen pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun tsam la yang gnas pa ma yin/ 'on kyang de dang der byin gyis brlabs te 'gro ba'i don spyod pa yang srid pa'i phyir gcig dang tha dad pa'i dpyad pa mi dgos so/ / de nas mi ring bar smon lam gyi stobs chen pos dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba/ mkhan rin po che lung rig rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas/ de gong mnal lam du lung bstan rim pa gsum tsam byung 'dug pa dang*/ sngon dus rje dam pas snga phyi'i lung bstan mang po gnang ba'i tshigs bcad du yang*/ nam zhig rang gnas ri bo'i phug tu mjal/ / zhes gsungs pa'i dus kyang 'di yin zhes/ nged kyi gtam gsan 'phral chos lung byang rtse sogs la mi gtong par mdzad de/ mched grogs dpal sdings pa dang*/ ga thog pa dpal kun dga' legs rgyal gnyis kyang zhabs 'bring du 'phral 'byor byung 'dug cing*/ de mtshams dpon slob rnams myur shad du phebs byung ba/ phebs 'phral dngos la gdan mthong sogs bkur bsti ches che ba mdzad/ zas sna shing thog la sogs pa'i ston mo mang po dang*/ gnang sbyin gyi skyes rgya cher stsal/ de'i nang bar nas zhag 'ga' rer rnam 'joms la sogs pa'i bkru byabs kyis lus ril gyis bkru ba yang yang mdzad/ zhag lnga tsam bzhugs nas bzhis ka gong dkar du phyag phebs/

gong ma khu dbon dang mjal 'phrad legs tshogs che bar byung 'dug cing*/ nged kyi skor bseng bkrol yang gnang*/ gzhis ka nas kyang dngos cag la ja 'dren byung*/ de skabs gnam gang ba la rje dam pas gnang ba'i byin rlabs rten 'ga' re 'dug pa rnams ngos 'dzin byed zer nas nged kyi sar khyer byung ba gsal bar dran cing brjod sgo yang 'ga' re smras 'dugadapal legs grogs mched kyis rgyal sras chos rdzong pa'i thugs dam rten bde mchog dang dmag zor ma'i shing sku/ rje dam pa'i 'bral spang mi g.yo ba dang sgrol ma'i zangs glegs sogs khyer byung bas ngo shes pa'i rnam pa dang*/ khyad par de gong sgrol ma ma gtogs lha rigs de dag mthong thos med na'ang*/ lha rnams ngo shes shing ngos 'dzin bshad pa byed rgyud yang don dang mthun pa mang dag byung*/ yar 'brog nas kṝ ya sa muts+tsha'i dbang rdzas kyi sa gzhong zhig bskur ba mdzad pa'ang ngo shes shing*/ dkar mdung yod med kyi rtsad gcod kyang byas/ de gong skra rnams ral bar yod pa tshogs gsog ring mo ba dang chos dbang pa gnyis kyis bseng nas sil bur 'cho yin yod tsa na/ ral ba'i thor tshugs byas rus rgyan zhig gyon shing nags kyi gseb la cham cham 'gro ba yin pa la snyam par byung*/ de nas hor zla dgu pa'i nyer lnga la/ mkhan rin po che'i phyag phyir dkris te/ rang yul nas gzhi btegapha mas kyang lung pa'i phu'i la mtshams na bkra shis brag zer ba ming bkra bzang ba zhig yod pa de bar skyel mar phebs/ de nas skabs skabs su pha ma dran pa'i gdung shugs ci rigs par byung mod kyi/ phal cher ni ma snying bu dang*/ bu snying rdo'i rnam par song*/ de skabs ni zla bo rnams kyis kyang a ma rim pas rjes la phebs kyin yod do zhes brid pa ltar yang byas so/ / de nub yar 'brog dpal der sleb/ gur chas bzang po bshams gzhi len gzab ma byung*/ gral gyis tsam na mkhan rin po che yang bzhugs shing khong tsho'i mi 'ga' re 'dug pa la mno mi shes pas dpal de ba rang gi mdog stabs la bya ba zhig kha nas shor/

byis pa'i kha la la nye yod pa'i dpe de 'phral du gsal bar byung*/ de'i sang ya sribs phyogs la lam mdzad de phebs skabs/ de phyogs rin spungs kyi lam yin nga mi 'gro byas nas bslab nyes mang du byas/ 'dab lung du sde pa bstan 'dzin drung dpon g.yog kyang bsu ba la phebs/ sna dkar rtse'i mdun gyi skyed tshal der zhags gsum bsdad/ nyin gcig tsam rtser yang phyin/ skyed tshal der yod dus ja 'thung 'phro la dkar yol zhig khri steng nas zhal ba'i dkyil du 'phangs pa gas chag gang yang ma byung*/ dkar yol de sde pa bstan 'dzin drung rang gi phyag tu bzhes song*/ de skabs yar 'brog nas sku mched dge skyon gyi stabs byus dpangs shin tu dma' bar yod pa/ slar mi ring bar sku mched kyang nang 'dums shing*/ chab srid mtha' rgyas su byung song ba de lta bu'i dge mtshan gyi rten 'brel yin par mngon no/ / de nas rim pas brgyud nas blo bder sleb/ dpon po kun bsam pa byung ba ngo shes byung zhing*/ de'i sang rgyal rtse nas bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te rgyal rtser sleb/ der zla phyed tsam song nas rtse chen du phyin/ yum sras rnams dang sde ba drung 'tsho ba sogs kyis zla gcig tsam gyi bar phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byor bas bstabs/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes dang yang mjal zhing shin tu dgyes pa dang dang pa dpe med pa mdzad kyin 'dugabla brang shar chen du phyin pa sogs da lta'ang shin tu gsal ba yid yul na 'dug cing*/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i smin byed cig stsal 'dug ste ha cang gsal bar mi dran/ rtogs ldan zla grags pa dang*/ shākya ba dhi gnyis byung ba'ang gsal bar ngo shes/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen gyi bla brang dkar por mched grogs thar ba bslebs pa'ang ngo shes/ zhag shas song skabs/ rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas dang*/

sbas pa'i sangs rgyas rje btsun lha dbang grags pa'i zhabs dang*/ bla ma dam pa rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang po dang*/ rje kun dga' bstan gsal ba'i drung dang*/ dpon drung 'phan ne ba dang*/ ngam ring nas mi sna la khang gsar nas kun dga' legs grub pa dang*/ rje dam pa'i phyag g.yog rnying pa rnams dang bcas phebs/ kun chos pa gzhung pa 'phan ne'i ba'i drung rnams ngo shes 'dugade nas rim pas 'brong rtse/ stag rtse khyung rtse pa snam brgyud tshong 'dus dbu rtser ka brgyad mar bzhugs gral zhig byung ba'i rten mchod la/ sku skye bcu gcig gi ze'u lha khang zhig 'dug pa de la dag mi dag gi dpyad pa mang po byas pas/ zhal ngo rnams thugs mtshar mtshar mdzad kyin 'dugade nas bsam 'grub rtser phyin skabs gser ma'i thad tsam du gser mdog can gyi dge 'dun brgya tsam byin rlabs zhu bar byung*/ de gong gser mdog can pa tshos/ karma pa'i phyag g.yog la rdo brdungs byas/ de'i chad sgrub sogs 'khrun chod grub nas rgyang tsam song skabs yin 'dug na'ang*/ zhing gis zhe ma sdug mdzad pa'i dge 'dun rnams thugs gu dog tsam gyi dus yin pa dngos cag bsam rtser 'ong pa'i rkyen gyis gnas tshul de rang grol du song*/ der zhal lnga tsam bsdad/ byis pa'i spyod pa kho nas khro tshul dang bcas gral la ma phyin pa'i rkyain gyis sku mdun drung de'i nang bar rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi thags sku la sogs pa 'bul ba cung zad zhig dang bcas snga mo rang phebs nas/ nged rje btsun rin po che la mi phyed pa'i dad pa yod cing*/ bla mas kyang dgongs par shin tu bzhugs pa yin pa la da lam dgongs khrel ba'i rnam pa 'dug pa rgyu gzhan gcig kyang med/ gser mdog can pa'i skor 'di yin pas/ sngar byas la bshags pa 'bul zhing da nas gser mdog can pa la gang drag rang byed gsung pa phebs/ de nas snar thang du zhag gsum tsam bsdad/ de nas gnas su zhag rtsis byas 'dug pa sngon gyi bag chags shig gis sdod pa'i blo gtan ma byung na'ang g.yog rnams kyis 'brid thabs byas/

de nas bo dong du byang ba'i bdag po sku gzhon pa'i drung bzhugs sar 'byor zhing gzhi len dpe bral mdzad/ de nyid dus mdos kyang 'dugagrangs chen rab 'byams pas rje btsun rin po che'i dbu zhwa zhig nged la lan gsum ston du byung ba de la cang lab pa ni ma byung mthar tshig pa zos te khong rang la 'phangs/ sku 'dra dung khung ma sogs mjal/ de'i nang bar ri khrod chen po jo mo nang du sleb/ rdo bcal gyi chos 'byung rang byon/ thug sna lnga la sogs pa rtsad gcod byas pas/ rje drung rin po che'i gsung gi chos 'byung rang byon mgon khang du bsdus yod mchis/ rnga thug kyang phyi ru nag po sbron pa yin/ sna lnga nang na yod gsung gin 'dugade nas smon 'gror phyin dus ga da la nas zhabs drung bkra shis stobs rgyas pa dpon g.yog rnams kyis bsu ba gnang zhing*/ phyag g.yog la 'gro lung chos rje 'dus pa ngo shes byung*/ smon 'gro'i gzi brjid kyi phug gi gzims chung der sdod sa byung zhing*/ de na sprul sku ngag dbang gis bris ba'i sku skye bcu gcig gi thang kha rnams kyang bkram 'dug der bag chags shig kyang sad rgyu byung*/ mkha' spyod rtse mor phyin pas rdo'i maṇ+ḍal sogs mchod chas rnams ngo shes shing*/ rnal 'byor ma'i bris sku rnams mthong pas rkyen byas te/ oṃ gsum ma ma bslabs par blo la shar/ de'i sang nyin chos lung byang rtser brtol te/ mchod khang rtser phyin dus 'jigs byed kyi zhal 'bag sogs rtsad gcod byas shing*/ dge slong rnam grol la zhang 'khrul zhig gi thugs dam dgra nag gi sku sogs rtsad gcod byas pas/ dge slong pas mchi ma btang*/ sngags sku sngar ma mthong bar phal cher yang ngo shes pa rdzun med dpang po can yin no/ / gang gi rigs dag sad gyur pa/ / de la de yi phun tshogs 'byung*/ / yongs smin pad+ma'i ge sar rnams/ / nyin byed shar na lhag par rgyas/ / de nas mi ring bar dus chen yang tshugs/

de grol nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang thog ma'i rten 'brel du zhus/ slar gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang zhus/ de dus dbang zhu ba'i 'dun pa dang bla ma lhar bsgoms pa sogs gsal zhing mos gus skye bar byung*/ gzhan yang de skabs sgrub sder gsung ngag lam 'bras la sogs pa chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor ba gnang gin 'dug pas/ gang la gang 'tsham gyi rjes gnang byin rlabs sogs kyang zhus shing*/ khyad par dpal kyai rdo rje yab bka' yum bka'i dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun ldan gyi tshul gyis nos/ 'di dag gi gong du bla med kyi dbang gnyis gsum tsam zhu myong yang gsang mtshan tsam yang blo la ma zin 'duga'adi skabs tshig don gyi go rtogs ji bzhin rnyed pa ma byung rung*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul mtshams dang dbang rdzas sogs kyi rim pa krig ge blo la chags/ dkyil 'khor du bla mas dbang bskur ba'i go ba dang bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med du byed pa sogs kyi rnam gzhag chags pa tsam byung*/ gshed dmar gy-i dbang dang*/ kyai rdor gnyis ka la me tog gtso bos bzhes de dang mthun pa'i ming stsal/ gsang mtshan yang grogs kyis 'dzin pa la ma bltos par rang blos ma brjed par bzung thub/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa grub pa'i khyu mchog chen po rje btsun brag stod par yang*/ sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang*/ bla med kyi dbang 'ga' zhig dang*/ tshe dbang brgya tshar/ khyung khra dus 'khor lugs/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ grub brgya'i chos skor sogs thob/ rje drung rin po che jo nang pa'i drung du yang*/ pu ṭa'i zur bka' sogs rjes gnang 'ga' zhig zhus/ dbyar smad byang du sde pa sku mched gzigs phyogs mi gcig pa'i dus mi bde la brten zhabs drung stobs drung yang yul bud gal/ khong pa yod na rje dam pa'i bstan pa cung zad spel ba'i 'dun pa yod mod kyi/

so so'i dus mtshams kyi dar rgud 'byung ba 'dus byas spyi'i chos nyid du 'dugade rjes su'ang sku mdun zhing gshag pa lo shas bzhugs na'ang 'phral phun sum tshogs pa yong ba yod na'ang de'ang de lta'o/ / 'on kyang gnas skabs 'jig rten phyogs kyi spraus spros bkur bkur cog cog med pa de ka phan yon du song ste/ rang gi tshugs khyer la bltos pa'i thos bsam sgom gsum 'phel bar byung bas/ bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rjes ma dor par nges shes skyes so/ / de skabs yar lam yon bdag so sos byin pa'i rdzas kyang bzang rab yod pa/ smon 'gro ba dang yon mchod gcig byed pa'i khungs byas/ skyos mar ming btags pa'i sum cha tsam smon 'gror bstab pa yin na'ang gzhan gyis sel bcug pa yin nam sems/ bar skabs nas 'phan ne rang gis kyang reg la ma 'byar ba'i 'phral lag pa dam la bsam gtan gyi dogs pa khong 'chang rang byas/ gzhan byang phyogs kyi bla ma 'dra dang ci rigs pas/ de skabs nged rang rtsed mo'i bya ba la gtor rgyag dang*/ 'jigs byed kyi phyag mtshan thams cad dpal lags kyis bcos shing de rnams thogs pa'i 'cham byed tshul sogs rtsed mo tsam la sgrau btags pa'i bdag po nam mkha' rgyal po sogs la/ khong dpon slob kyis zhabs drung stobs kyi phyogs zhen byas/ gtor rgyag byed kyin yod par 'dug tshul sogs mang po byung ste la cha/ de la bden zer 'cha' ba ni de las kyang rgod bro/ gzhan yang brjod gleng sna tshogs la brten pa'i bdag po sku mched de kun khong tsho rang 'das 'das kyi bar du ma mgu pa'i khungs rang gda'/ de skabs chos lung gi chos ra na/ kun mkhyen don dpal ba'i thugs dam 'jigs byed kyi ras bris zhal ba la sbyar ba de mthong res kyi yid la dga' ba dpag tu med pa skye zhing*/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs kyi tshigs bcad dang*/ 'jigs byed kyi sngags gsum po dpal lags kyis lan re tsam 'don gyin 'dug pa 'dzin rtsol ma dgos par rang babs su blo la chags/

skabs shig mchod khang rtse nas rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil thang chen mo de blangs nas lta yin yod skabs/ lha mgron myur mdzad mgon po'i sku dang nged rang gi bar der bya rog cig lhung thabs su babs/ ma hā ka la de na zer dbyangs gda'/ dgun dus yin na'ang thugs la me'i rnam pa ci yang 'bar ba zhig byung*/ smon 'gror yang phyin nas zla gcig tsam bsdad/ yang chos lung du 'ongs dgun zangs kyi 'phral chas dkon ne ba byung*/ de la rgyu mtshan mang po 'doga'abrug lo hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig la klog yig slob pa'i 'go tshugs/ ka mad sum cu la de nyid tshar gsum bzhi zhig ngos sbyor byas/ sang zhogs klog pas ha'i thad du cung zhig bsam dgos/ gzhan rnams thogs med du shar gyis byung*/ brtson 'grus cher ma byas pas klog byang rab tu 'gro ba la lo lhag tsam thogs/ yang de skabs zla bo 'ga' dang lhan cig rdo chal du rtsed mo byed 'phro la 'phral du zla bo tsho la ma sdod 'gro byas nang du sleb 'phral rbab shin tu rang che ba zhig lhungs pas ngo mtshar du rtsi ba byung*/

de skabs gting skyes nas 'bod mi byung zhing lam kun na tseg ge'i bags che bar yod zer bas/ 'phan ne sogs phal cher gyis ma phyin pa legs tshul mdzad kyin 'dug na'ang*/ tseg ge la rdo brdung btang bas chog byas/ hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gcig la bteg nas rim gyis gdong dgar 'byor/ de skabs dpon sa dpon sgrel po dang rnam rgyal lags gnyis yod/ rim pas mdos 'drar sa skyong rab mdzes pa dang mjal zhing*/ de'i sang nyin mkhar chen du 'byor/ bsu ba sogs kyi bkod pa rgya chen po yang mdzad/ bla ma rin po che 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can dang yang mjal/ de skabs mos gus dga' tshad yod/ rjes su mos gus cher gtong dgos rgyur 'dug ste/ bred po gsum la chos bred thu/ zer ba de rang yod par gda'o/ / de nas zhag lnga nas bla ma rin po che ni gser mdog can du chos 'khor la thegs song*/ nged kyis de mtshams chos grar spos/ brag stod du spyan 'dren brdzangs ba bzhin/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po phebs/ nai gu'i khrid gnang skabs nyid mtshan thams cad yid dga' bas khyab pa'i gnyid kyang 'di byung mi shes pa yul yul pa zla ba lhag tsam gyi bar du byung zhing*/ khrid gnang ba'i tshig don gsal bar go ci rigs blo la yang chags/ phag dkar gyi rjes gnang zhig zhus nas chos dbang pas grogs byas te zhag bdun bsnyen pa bskyal/ bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang zhus dus sta gon gyi nub mo rmi lam ya mtshan can mang po byung*/ phyis mched grogs pa rnams kyis nang du dam sel byed pa'i rmi ltas kyang gsal bar byung*/ gzhan yang chos bka' dpag tu med pa thob/ gting skyes chos grwar zla ba drug bsdad/ de skabs yar 'brog nas myur shad yong dgos tshul phebs pa bzhin shar phyogs la bskyod de/ gam pa rdzong dang gad dang rgyang ro'i gzhung ded nas phyin/ stag lung rdzong du zhag bcu skor song*/ de nas chos sde'i bla brang dkar por spos/

ston dang dgun de'i ring 'dul ba lung gi po ti gnyis gsum dang*/ skyes rabs brgya rtsa sogs la klog dar 'dra byas pas lo rgyus mang po blo la zin gzhan la bshad du btub tsam byung*/ 'di yan la bstan pa spyi'i chos spyod rnams blo la chud cing*/ ston ka 'di nas bzung ste dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon rtogs dang yi dam chos skyong gi gtor bsngo ma chag par byas pa yin/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang du tseg ges thebs pa yang myur du sor chud/ de skabs nyin mo skad 'gags pa la mtshan mo gnyid kyi skabs bla rdol thabs su mtshan brjod sogs chos spyod kyi rigs dang*/ yi dam gyi mngon rtogs che chung rnams ma nor bar gtsang sing nge skad gsal por 'don pa kho na de'i ring la rtag tu byung 'dugazla bo tsho ni dkyus ma min pa bar chad yin nam snyam blo skyog zer/ cho 'phrul gyi sgang la tshe dpag med kyi bzlas mtshams zhag bdun ma zhig dang sgrol dkar gyi bzlas pa mtshams zhag bdun ma zhig byas/ zla ba gza' 'dzin zhig dang bstun nas phyag rdor gyi bzlas pa mtshams zhag bdun ma zhig kyang byas te zla ba gang yin brjed 'dugadapyid phyogs rje btsun dpal stag lung pa chen po lha sa'i zhig gsos dang gser phibs 'bul bar phebs skabs/ sog yul du 'gro don rgya che ba'i legs lam 'bul bar kun dga' snyan grags btang*/ de nas bla ma rin po che 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can spyan 'dren du chos mdzad kun rgyan btang*/ khong tshos kyang 'phral du sku gzhogs su 'byor/ hor zla drug pa'i tshe lnga la yar 'brog stag lung gi chos sder zhabs zung dgod par mdzad/ tshes bcu gcig nas thar gling chos sde'i bla ma slob dpon drag bsdus thugs dam la gzhol ba lnga bcu skor dang*/ bdag cag la sogs pa kun bsgril ba brgya skor zhig la gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag dbu tshugs par gnang zhing*/

'di skabs lam 'bras kyi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ snga phyir rjes gnang zur bka' bzhi bcu lhag tsam dang*/ de dag dang 'brel ba so so'i chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa mtha' rgyas su gnang zhing*/ bdag gis kyang 'di nas brtsams nas lam dus thun re re dang*/ lam zab dang*/ bir srung thun mong ba/ rnal 'byor ma rnams 'chags med du 'grub cing*/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs zhus pa'i nub rmi lam gyi snang ba shin tu gsal ba la/ bdag rang gangs bzang gi mgul nas yar gos dmar po zhig gyon nas 'gro yin 'dug pa/ gangs kyi phug cig nas bud med gzhon nu zhig byung nas ngas lam sna bya'o zhes/ gangs la zhig brgal nas phyin pa nas phyogs nyams dga' ba/ me tog shin tu che bas khyab pa zhig nas phar sleb pas/ snang ba 'gyur zhing yid dga' sems chen po zhig la lung pa de gang yin dris pas o rgyan yin zer/ de'i mthar dur khrod kyi rnam pa 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba zhig gi sbubs nas yar phyin tsa na/ phug pa chen po zhig gi nang na bud med stong tsam 'dug cing*/ dbus na khri chen po zhig la gzi brjid dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'i mi'i bud med kyi rnam pa las 'das shing 'di lta bu'o zhes brjod par dka' ba'i gtso mo zhig bzhugs 'dug pa/ de la phyag cig byas nas drung du 'dug tsa na/ gtso mo des phyag bdag gi spyi bor bzhag pa'i mod la/ bud med de thams cad gad mo theg theg pa zhig byed kyin 'dug pa/ de ka'i ngang la gnyid sad de rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur pa'i mtshan mar go / de skabs gsung ngag sogs mthar phyin tsa na yar rgyab kyi dpung chen thams cad yar 'brog stag lung du lhags shing*/ 'on kyang bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyis chos sde de nyid du gdan phab pa'i bar chings yang yang 'byung ba la brten nas rdzongs 'tshangs drag po rang ha cang mang ba ma byung*/ spyir stag lung rdzong la zla ba gsum tsam dmag gis bskor/

mthar khrigs kyang legs par thob/ skabs der byang stag lung nas rje btsun bla mas a ho bkra shis phun tshogs pa ja 'dren du gnang*/ bdag cag dair yod pas kyang yar 'brog tu phan thogs shin tu che bar byung*/ dus gzings de skabs thams cad du yang bka' chos thun gcig kyang ma chag cing*/ yar rgyab nas sde pa dpon chen drung sku mched dpon g.yog rnams kyang thugs shin tu mos gus che bar 'dugahor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun la dmag rnams kyang gyes/ tshes bcu dgu la yar 'brog stag lung nas gzhi btega'abrug sbrul gyi lo 'di tsho la zhabs drung stobs dang yang yang mjal byung*/ rim pas rgyal rtser phebs/ de skabs ngos kyis kyang mkhan rin po che dang mjal ba'i chos bka' ci rigs zhus/ de mtshams te skyes su sde pa rab mdzes drung gshegs par brten/ bla ma dam pa spyan 'dren byung bas gting skyes phyogs la phebs song*/ rgyal rtse zhal ngo rnams la tshe dbang zhig phul/ ngos kyis rim pas spos khang du/ mkhan chen kun dga' chos skyong bas 'bod mi gnang ba ltar phyin/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i snam sbyar dang rdza sku don zhags kyi bris thang sogs tshogs chos lung pa'i rten khyad par can thams cad mjal/ de nas pa snam du sde pa kun lha'i drung dang mjal/ bkra shis rdzong khar yang phyin zhag bdun tsam bsdad/ mkhas mchog byams pa lhun grub dang thog mar 'di dus mjal/ gnas bcu'i thang ka cig bkram 'dugade'i yan lag 'byung dang sku'i rnam pa 'dra ba'i gtam rgyud cig yod/ de nas tshong 'dus su mkhan chen zla ba bzang po sogs gser mdog can gyi mkhan slob rnams dngos 'phrad par phebs/ chos 'brel tsam phul/ lu gu rir zhag gsum bsdad/ myur shad du lam bcad de/ mda' rgyab kyi dar la thon nas dga' por sleb pa'i nub/ jo nang gi sgrub pa mo thams cad 'phrad par byung*/ de nub rang jo mda'i thad kar dar mi theg tsam chags/

sang snga dro khong thams cad la ma ṇi'i lung zhig byas/ rtsed chung gi 'phrang mtshams par sgrub pa mo byings skyel ma la byung*/ khong rnams ldog dus dar khyer grub 'dug zer/ kun chos pa nas dang po rje dam pa la yang 'di bzhin byung ya mtshan po yin pa 'dug zer/ de nyin nyer lnga yin zhing de nub chos lung du sleb/ de res cho 'phrul dus chen gyi skabs su tshogs la sdod rtag par byas/ cho ga rnams blo la byang bar yod cing*/ dmigs pa rnams kyang gsal rab dang tshogs la sdod pa la mi sun zhing dang spro bar byung ngo*/ / mkhan rin po che'i zhabs drung dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs rin po che sogs zhal mthun pa'i bka' bkod du/ khyod kyi gnas kyi slob dpon dang klog pa'i slob dpon du bsten par 'os pa ni/ mkhas pa'i dbang po byams pa lhun grub nyid yin te/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan thams cad kyis nye bar brgyan pa dang grub mtha' bzang zhing rje dam pa'i dngos slob gtsang mar gyur pa dang khyad par gser mdog can du rje dam pas chos 'khor mdzad skabs mjal dar 'bul bar mdzad pa la yang dar 'di/ dar ba chen po chos kyi tog bya ba yin zhes pa'i lung bstan khyad par can brnyes pa yin pas so/ / zhes phebs pa ltar/ bla ma gnyis kyi bka' la brten dus chen grol mtshams kyi tshes bcu bdun la phebs/ zla 'phro de ni ci bder bzhugs/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig gza' skar bzang pa nas/ tshad ma rigs pa'i gter gyi dpe 'dzin gyi 'go brtsams shing de nyin rang bsdus rkang brtsi ba'i yang 'go tshugs/ phebs sgo la yang dang po rje dam pa la yang 'di bzhin mdzad 'dug pa bzhin/ don bzang zhing tshig bkra legs pa zhig byed dgos gsung zhing*/ gzhi grub na brtson 'grus ma yin pa bud zer na/ shes rab chos can zhes pa nas brtsoms zhal nas blangs/ rtags chos don gsum khyab pa 'bud gshogarjes khyab zlog khyab rnams lan gcig gsungs pa tsam gyis mod la go ba chags/

dpyid la dbyar btags te brtson 'grus che ba rang ma byung na'ang*/ bsdus rkang sum brgya tsam/ rnam 'brel gyi thal 'phreng ci rigs pa dang bcas gsung ngag las len pa bla bar byung*/ go ba dag blo nus 'bring tsam yod pa la/ gzhung dpe 'dzin shin tu kha dog par byung ste/ rigs gter 'dzin pa la'ang zla ba lnga tsam thogs/ de la slob dpon rin po che nas/ nged la chung ngu'i dus nas yul spyod nyid kyis nya phag sgong gsum dang srog chag sna tshogs pa'i sha zos pas de lta bu'i zas grib kyis bsgribs pa yin nam/ rigs pa'i 'jug sgo 'di la dpags na/ dpe 'dzin yang yangs po zhig yong thang ba la/ sngon dpang lo chen po sku chung ngu'i dus lug gi 'o mas gsos pas rnam dpyod kyi phyed 'gribs zhes gsung pa sogs lo rgyus dang bcas yang yang gsung ba/ de dus kho bo'i sems la shes rab che chung skal ba bzang ngan yin/ zas kyis sgrib rgyu rang ci yod snyam pa shar mod/ lar ni rten 'brel mtha' yas pas de 'dra'ang srid pa 'dugadapyid dus bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can yang phebs/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi dbang 'phags zhabs lugs gnyis ka'i rgyud lung man ngag yongs rdzogs/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi chos skor dpag tu med pa dang*/ lam skor phyi ma rnams dang*/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i dbang khrid lung man ngag yongs rdzogs dang*/ rgyu sde lnga'i dbang chen po sogs snga phyir bka' chos grangs med stsal bas ser kha la thug gi bar nyin zangs kyi chos zhu bas dus 'das pa lta bu byung*/ skabs der slob dpon dam pa spyan shin tu bsnyung ba zhig byung bas bsam sdings kyi chos skyong 'khren du thugs dogs pa dang thugs brel 'ga' zhig gi dbang las re zhig shar phyogs su thegs/ snga sor dus chen grol 'phral chos mdzad kun rgyan la sogs pa byang stag lung du/ sa gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal stag lung pa chen po spyan 'dren pa'i phyir brdzangs pa/

'bri stag gi zir bun 'phro cung zad yod 'dug pas thugs 'gor che ste/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin par dpon slob zab rgyas cog grwa dang bcas pa chos lung byang chub rtse mor zhabs zung 'khod cing*/ de'i sang nyin chos grwar dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po dang*/ rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun brag stod nas dang*/ rje drung rin po che rnams dang bcas dpal stag lung pa chen po dang mjal/ gral dang gdan la rtsod pa dang che 'dod sogs ye med thams cad chu la chu bzhag gi thugs snang dag pa legs tshogs shin tu che bar byung*/ nyer gsum gza' skar bzang ba nas bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus shing*/ dpal stag lung rin po che spyan 'dren zhus pa'i don gyi gtso bor bka' drin zhu ba nyid yin pa ltar/ rang lo brgyad pa sna tshogs zhes bya ba'i lo khrums stod kyi zla ba'i tshes lnga'i nyin/ chos lung byang rtse'i rtse mchod khang gi yang thog tu snga mor slob pa byas skra bregs rab tu byung ba'i rtags ma yin pa rnams dor/ skra 'breg mkhan ma chen chos ye ba yin/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te dpal stag lung ba chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi mkhan po dang*/ mtshan brjod par dka' ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi slob dpon dang*/ rje drung kun dka' dpal bzang pos dus go ba dang*/ chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan pa mdzad/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang po lnga zhu ba'i yul dang las gral du bzhugs te/ nyi ma bzhi cha shar ba'i dus skyes bu gcig dang rkang pa gnyis kyi dus su chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang rtser/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par mnos te/ 'jig rten gsum du thob par dka' ba'i ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan drang srong gi rtags kyis yang dag par brgyan pa'i bka' drin stsal lo/

/ de mtshams mkhan slob dge 'dun bla ma dam pa so so phyogs kyi mi sna sogs gzhi byes shin tu mang ba la dga' ston rgya che ba dang*/ mkhan po dam par gser zho sum cu so bdun gyi maṇ+ḍal sogs gzhan yang so sor bka' drin rjes dran gyi 'bul ba rang nyid kyi rgyu dngos la bltos pa'i gang 'grub bgyis/ dngos cag gi cha nas blo tshim zhing legs tshogs che ba'i mthar thug tu byung ngo*/ / srid gsum ma lus skyes bu thob gyur kyang*/ / ngur smrig rgyal mtshan thob pa'i char mi phod/ / srid kyi 'byor ba 'di ni nam yang 'jig/ ngur smrig thob pas 'chi med grong du bgrod/ tshes bcu skor la bstan 'dzin rin po che yang dpon slob zab rgyas su byas nas phebs/ legs ja bzab mar gnang zhing sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dpag med kyi sgom lung zhus/ de nas mi ring bar stag lung rin po che dpon slob rnams kyang shar phyogs su phebs/ 'di skabs thams cad du 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can la/ sa skya gong ma dkar po rnam gsum gyi bka' 'bum gyi lung zhu ba'i skabs yin/

rdze btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug gi drung du yang*/ 'di res phebs 'phral nas ras chung snyan brgyud kyi smin grol yongs su rdzogs par zhus shing*/ dpal rtag lung rin po che bzhugs skabs kyang*/ chos drug sras mkhar ma'i chos thun chag med re dang*/ skabs 'dir rgya gar gsang spyod yongs su rdzogs par thob/ de mtshams 'tshed nas spyan 'dren gnang ba ltar dgongs bzhed bzhin 'tshed du phebs/ slar yang chos lung du zhag shas bzhugs skabs bde mchog bong zhal can gyi dbang zhig zhus pa'i dngos gzhi ye shes 'bebs pa'i skabs/ lus la bde nyams dpag tu med pa zhig byung zhing*/ dbang thob nas kyang lus 'gul mi shes pa 'dra ba zhig byung*/ de nub rmi lam du chu chen po zhig la mi mang po dang lhan cig gru brgal te/ po ta lar 'gro rgyu yin zer ba zhig byung*/ gzhan yang tshe ring mched lnga'i bka' gtang sogs mang po thob/ de nas kyang lug lo'i dus chen ma tshugs kyi bar la/ bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can gyi drung du gsol ba thon nas nyi ma nub kyi bar bka' chos kho nas dus 'da' ba'i chos thob shin tu che ba dang*/ snga dro re bzhin sdom gsum rab dbye'i dpe rgyugs re byang bar bzung*/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyi shu skor la mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan slob dpon rin po che yang phebs byung*/ lug lo'i dus chen la mchod khang rtser bla ma rin po ches rdo rje slob dpon gnang shing*/ 'du khang gi tshogs dbu la dngos kyis phyin/ bla ma dam pa dpon slob dus chen grol nas kyang zla gcig skor bzhugs pa gnang skabs/ sa paṇa gyi bka' 'bum gyi lung dang*/ gzhan yang chos thob shin tu che bar byung*/ kā ri kā lnga bcu pa dang bshes springs sogs blo 'dzin byas shing*/ slob dpon dam pas zhib bshad gnang bas/ rang res kyang dbu zhabs med par 'bru non pa tsam byung*/ rtags rigs dang blo rigs zhib rgyas su zhal ngag nas bzung*/

de skabs chos lung gi dkar me'i ru ba khri tshang bas bdas/ rmi lam du 'tshub 'gyur dpe med byung*/ de 'phral rang nas rtags rim par bstan pa yin/ dngos la rta lo'i sked tsam man chad nas chos lung du bag mi phebs pa'i snang ba sha stag dang*/ chos lung nyid du'ang kha mchu sogs ci rigs pa byung zhing*/ khyad par de skabs su dmigs ltas rtsub cing mi bsrun pa brgyud mar byung*/ dngos kyi lag na drag drag yod pa kun gcig kyang ma lus par gtsang gi grā sa dang sde dgon ris med du tshogs gsog spong thag tu btang*/ da bsams dus bdag 'dzin blos ma thongs pa'i dge ba de yang a re re las mi gda' snyam mo/ / de skabs khri khang nas sde pa grwa lnga'i drung gis 'bod mi byung ba ltar 'gro ba'i rtsis byas/ smon 'gror zhag bcu tsam zhig bsdad skabs grib cham zhig gis btab/ slar yang chos lung du yud tsam phyin skabs cham pa shin tu na ba zhig byung*/ mar lam smon 'gro ba zhal ngo rnams dang sdebs te jo nang du 'ongs/ smon 'gro dpon sas kyang chos gzugs mdzad/ nged la ming zhu bar byung ba kyal ka'i tshul du 'jig rten ma nus pa'i khar chos kyang ma nus pa zhig 'ong*/ kun dga' ma nus btags na yong ba 'dra byas/ phyis lo gang yang ma 'gor bar de ka rang byung ba de yin/ de nas snar thang sogs brgyud nas tshong 'dus su 'byor/ zhag gsum tsam skyed tshul du bsdad/ pha jo yang 'brang nas phebs byung*/ mes po rin po che chos dbyings su gshegs pa'i skad cha yang go / dgongs rdzogs sogs kyang grub par gda'/ de skabs rdzas rnams thams cad spong thag tu btang zin/ 'phral gyi 'tsho ba'ang bya tshol byi tshol las rang dbang thob pa cang med na'ang*/ 'phral chas yon bdag dad can la brten pas chog pa byung bas rtsol sgrub 'phran bu 'dra byas nas/ zha lu snar thang gnyis su mang ja 'gyed bcas tsam dang*/ thang kha gsum tsam zhig bzhengs nas mes po rin po che'i dgongs pa rdzogs par smon lam btab/

de skabs gsos la dbyar btags pa zla ba lnga'i bar du chos rgyal pho brang du bsdad shin tu skyid cing slob gnyer 'pher bar byung*/ de bar du snga dro re bzhin zhogs rgyugs cung zad re ma chag par bzung bas/ mngon pa mdzod dang spyod 'jug gi gzhung rdzogs par zin/ rtog ge snying po'i bar bar du mtha' gcod kyi spyi don dang thal ngag nyer mkhos brgyan pa/ slob dpon mkhas pa'i gsung rgyun las bzung*/ dgongs re bzhin blo gsal 'ga' re dang bsgro gleng yun ring rab re ma chag par byas shing*/ bar bar du spyod 'jug la go bshad zhus pa yang mgo zhabs tshar gyis yongs su rdzogs par song*/ shes rab le'u la go ba ji bzhin rang zhig de dus ma chags/ de min tshig thams cad la go bshad kyang pher ba byung nas slob dpon rin po ches ma gsan par lkog tu gzhan la rdzogs par bshad/ bzod pa'i le'u dang bsam gtan gyi le'u'i skabs kyi bzod pa sgom pa dang bdag gzhan brje ba sgom tshul rig pas dpyad pa mang po 'dug pa de kun la ya mtshan cher skye bar byung*/ spyod 'jug 'dzin skabs rmi lam kyang bzang*/ 'di skabs nas gzung dpe 'dzin gyi kha yang snga ma las gsum 'gyur tsam gyis che bar song*/ nyin re bzhin du gzhung 'dzin dpe rgyugs dang gsung ngag nas bzung ba sogs nyin rgyugs mang rab re yong gin 'dug pas gshor sbyang rem par byas/ 'dir sdod ring mngon rtogs rgyan yang gsung spor gyi ngang nas blo la chud/ mdzod kyi 'jig rten bstan pa dang las bstan pa gnyis 'bru bshad thub pa byung*/ phyis byung rang bla ma la la gsung lugs rang gi yon tan la zad rgyu med par khas len/ la las zhogs rgyugs re rer sh+lau ka lnga brgya zin/ zhogs rgyugs re la 'jug pa'i gzhung zin zer ba yong 'dugang ni de 'dra'i rigs ye min sgo dog po gcig ka yin/ gang zin de la go blo rang bzang rab 'dogarje grol mchog ni thugs rtsol che ba rang yin par 'dugang ni le lo dang snyoms las kyi mnga' bdag rang yin no/

/ deng mthun par snying thag kyang shin tu ring ba gcig lags pa re chen po ma mdzad cigade skabs hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gsum la pa snam lhun grub rtser phyin zhing*/ sde ba grwa lnga'i drung sogs zhal ngo thams cad dang mjal zhag gsum tsam bsdad/ sa n+ya shi mang po dang rgya gar gyi gleng slang mang po byung*/ de nas bsam sdings su phyin zhag gsum ngal gso byas/ nyin gcig jo mo sman gcig phur thang gi rtse la ri ltas la phyin/ phyogs thams cad mthong gsal che zhing nyams dga' ba zhig 'dug pas des rkyen du gyur te phyi nang gi snang ba thams cad yul yul ba zhig gi ngang nas ngos gzung dang bral ba'i rjes lhag ge ba zhig byung ste de skabs ngo ma shes/ de nas zla ba gcig mtshams dam par bcad de gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i mngon rtogs kyi steng nas sgrol ma'i bsnyen pa bskyal/ rmi lam du khron pa chung ngu gting zab pa zhig gi kha na 'dug pa/ khron pa'i gting nas chu chen po gyen du brdol te/ lung ba thams cad mtsho chen po zhig tu mer gyis song*/ mtsho de'i dbus na me tog shin tu che ba ser po dang sngon po shas che ba 'dugade mtshams nas rmi lam yang zin cing*/ snang ba de la yun ring du blta rtog byas/ yang lan gcig lung pa gcig na sa rdo ri klung med pa g.yu las grub pa 'dra ba zhig la nags chen pos khyab pa/ brag phug kyang mang du 'dug pa zhig la brag phug thams cad na gsung rab gser ma re 'dugade rnams zhal phye zhing bltas pa thams cad na sgrol ma'i sngags 'ba' zhig bris 'dugs phyogs 'di yang g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing yin snyam pa dang*/ nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' tshon dkrug dkrug pa dang rol mo'i sgra chen po grag cing me tog sder ma tsam gyi char 'bab kyin 'dug pas/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma nam mkha'i mthong na bzhugs nges snyam pa'i mos gus chen po byed kyin 'dugade nas mi gcig na re sa cha 'di rgya nag gi shar na yod zer bas rkyen byas te/

kha sang rang bsam sdings na yod pa yin pa la 'di rmi lam du 'dug snyam pa dang*/ de thams cad yul gyis yal nas song*/ de nas mtshams grol nas bkra shis rdzong khar phyin/ dpe mtshams kyi tshul du zla gcig bsdad/ zhogs rgyugs la dbu ma 'jug pa bzung zhing*/ gro thon nas tshad ma'i spyi don gyi 'phros nas ngag slob tu zhus shing*/ dgongs ja nas srod la thug gi bar sher snying dang sgrol ma sogs kha 'don ci smar byas/ rmi lam gyi ltas kha cig byung*/ snga sor rta lo'i nang du chos lung gi gnyer la kun chos pa dang smon 'gro nas dpon sa'i drung gi gros steng nas/ nged kyi lag g.yog snyan grags pa bskos pa yin na'ang*/ bsam sdings nas mched grogs dpal sdengs pa myur shad stod phyogs la song*/ smon 'gror phyin rgyang tsam song skabs mched grogs pa dang tshe dbang don grub pa gros kyi steng nas snyan grags gnyer tshang dang chos grwa sogs na yod na/ dgon pa la rtsis med kyi lag thal du gtong rgyu yin pa 'dug na'ang sgrub sde'i 'du khang du chos lnga sgrub mchod kyi sar bros thar/ kun chos pa la'ang skyon de 'dra yod grabs byung*/ de ka'i gnas tshul tshor ba la brten nas chos dbang pa dang tshong 'dus nas mi sna 'tsho byed lhas byin dang bcas chos lung gi gnyer gyi sar btang zhing*/ de lo'i ston sdud skabs/ smon 'gro nas kyang mdzad sgo ngan pa ci rigs pa dang*/ mched grogs dpal bas ngan smra mang po dang*/ chos lung bkra shis pas kyang smon 'gro'i rgyab skyor ba'i bka' bkyon mche ba gtsigs gtsigs pa 'dug tsa na/ zla ba gnyis gsum nas khong rang 'ur song*/ de nas slar yang bsam sdings su khor gcig phyin/ de skabs bdag slob dpon rin po ches sgrub gnas bsam sdings kyi khri thog tu bzhagade nas mkhan rin po che'i bka' bkod ltar dpal 'khor bde chen du 'byor/ zhag shas sku gzhogs su ngal gsos/

smon 'gro nam mkha' rin po cher yang ci rigs zhus pa'i kun chos pa zur du 'jog dgos tshul gyi bka' nan phebs pa ltar 'jog dgos byung*/ dngos kyis rtse rgyal du zla gcig zhag nyi shu tsam bsdad/ sngar gyi dpe cha rnams skyor sbyang tsam ma gtogs de bar du slob gnyer 'di yin rang zhig ma byung*/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga skor la slar yang chos sde'i bla brang dkar por bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa'i mkhan rin po che nyid kyi zhabs 'bring du 'byor/ blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid dang*/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim zhib rgyas stsal/ blo sbyong dang lam rim gyi yig lung mang po dang*/ rgyal sras bka' 'bum/ mi tra khrid drugasgrol ma nyer gcig jo bo lugs/ rjes gnang zur bka' shin tu rnam grangs mang ba/ man ngag khrod phu rgya rdza ma/ brgyad stong pa dang sher phyin gyi mdo phran rnams dang*/ snying po'i mdo bcu sogs kyi lung*/ gzhan yang rdo rje 'jigs byed skor sogs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs shin tu mang ba dang bcas pa thob cing*/ 'dir sdod ring zhogs rgyugs la rnam 'grel le'u dang po yongs rdzogs/ dgongs mo theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i 'phrin las kyi phyed tsam yan zin cing*/ phar phyin gyi spyi don thal ngag sogs gsung las thun che rab re ma chag par bzung nyin gung mkhan rin po che'i sku gzhogs su dam bca' bsgro gleng re ma chag pa dang*/ nub mo yang bsgro gleng rgyang tsam re 'chag med byas/ gzhung don la blo bskyed kyang che bar byung*/ spre'u lo de nyid kyi sa ga zla ba'i nang du dge tsha sogs kyi thugs brel la brten pa'i chos thob sogs mi yong ba 'dug pas/ tshes lnga nas gzims khang mkha' spyod du bskyas/ tshes brgyad nas mtshams bsdams te/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bsnyen pa la zhugs/ zla ba gcig tsam nas sde gzar gyi zir bun langs pas/

slob dpon rin po che'i drung bsam sdings phyogs su phebs song zhing*/ dngos kyis bsnyen pa'i 'phro bskyangs hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu la mtshams grol/ bcu gsum la mkhar kha rdzong du phyin/ zla ba gnyis tsam zhabs 'bring du bsdad/ der mdo rgyud thams cad kyi snying po/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgrod pa gcig pu'i lam/ zab lam thams cad kyi rgyal po/ nges don mthar thug las kyang shin tu mthar thug pa/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa thob ste/ de yang jo nang lugs la khrid dmigs zhig rgyas su stsal/ sngon 'gro'i dam po grol nyin mchog dbang gnang zin tsam na/ nang rol lung pa'i mi rnams nged la ma ṇi'i lung zhu ba la byung*/ bka' las sbyor drug gi 'gro don sa 'ur rdo 'ur 'ong pa 'dug gsung*/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi'i dam po'i skabs rnams lus mnyen pas zug gzer ni cher ma byung*/ bar bar du gnyid du thor re ba song*/ lus gnad lta stangs kyi bye bcings kho na'i mthu las rtags snang ci rigs pa shar/ jo lugs kyi 'khrid grol nas/ bu lugs la mgyogs 'khrid du gnang ba zhag po bcu skor la tshar/ jo zhal bla ma dam pa lugs kyi yig skor tshang ma dang*/ rgya gzhung dang yig rnying phal cher dang*/ nges don rgya mtsho sogs kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung mang po'i lung*/ dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum gyi byin rlabs dang khrid/ rgya gzhung dang yig rnying skor po ti gciga'ajam dbyangs rin rgyal ba'i yig skor gyi lung*/ grub thob chos drugamado sde dkon brtsegs kyi lung la sogs pa chos kyi rnam grangs shin tu mang ba so so'i 'dod chos su stsal ba rnams kyang thams cad thob/ tshe 'dir nyams khrid thob pa'i thog ma sbyor drug lags shing*/ dam po grol nas mkhar khar sdod ring de la rgyud bla'i 'phros dang*/ rgyud kyi rgyal po brtag pa gnyis pa rdzogs pa bzung*/

bka' chos kyi bar bar bzhugs gral thams cad du phar tshad gang rigs re la bshad pa dang*/ bsgro gleng yang yang byed dgos/ de min mkhar khar sdod ring de sor sdud dang srog rtsol la sgom thun re yang byas/ mdo phyogs kyi dpe cha rnams ni bzhagabartags gnyis la blo 'gro bar byung*/ 'grel ṭīka sogs lta rtog lcogs pa med na'ang rgyud nyid la go ba ci rigs pa blo la 'char thub pa tsam byung ngo*/ / smras pa/ gang zhig bdud rtsi 'thung la mngon dga' ba/ / de dag nges par 'chi med gnas su 'jug / dbul po'i khyim gnas rin chen gter brnyed dang*// bcud len dam pa thob 'di ngo mtshar rmad/ / de nas slar yang phyag phyir dkris nas phu'i la la bcad de chos sde chen por phebs/ su kha chos druga'abri gung ba'i zab chos dgongs gcigabastan snying sogs der yang chos mang po thob/ de skabs slob dpon rin po che yang phebs byung zhing*/ bka' phebs la kha sing nas mtshan nyid kyi slob gnyer 'phro chad pa ma legs/ sngar gyi tsho la brjed gsos kyis gsung*/ gzhung rnams sngar byang po yod pas brjed gsos cher dgos pa ma byung*/

spyi don bshad pa sogs la brjed gsos kyang byas/ de nas hor zla brgyad pa'i nyi shu lnga drug tsam gyi tshe/ mkhan rin po che dpon slob rnams gzhis ka rin spungs pa'i dmag sgar khyung rtser brtol ba la/ chos sde chen po'i zhu don rgya che ba dang*/ mjal 'phrad sogs la phebs pa gnang song zhing*/ nged kyis de mtshams blangs pa gser gling du phyin/ zla ba phyed gnyis tsam bsdad pa chos rje kun bkras pas mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa la brten skyid du tshor ba byung*/ der yang slob gnyer gyi ngo bo sngar gyi 'phros la phar tshad kyi ṭī ka so so nas gang la gang 'tshams slob dpon mkhas pa'i zhal las blangs shing*/ rgyud bla la bshad pa tshar gcig gnang bas gzhung gi 'bru bshad pher pa tsam byung*/ zhogs rgyugs su mdo sde rgyan dang 'byed gnyis byang bar bzung*/ 'di skabs rmi lam du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku gzugs kyi rnam pa sha stag yong ba zhig byung*/ hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin khrom dbang zhig dang dgon pa'i rten mjal zhib par byas shing*/ khyad par dam pa sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra phyag gnas ma de la mos gus chen po skyes shing gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ zhal ras la zil pa khrom khrom byung ba sor mos blangs te mid pas lus sems bde cham me ba la snang ba 'gyur ba nyi ma gnyis tsam byung*/ de skabs sdod yul gzims khang chos 'khor du grags pa de gnas rengs kyi rnam pas shin tu 'tshub cing cho 'phrul che ba zhig 'dugade nas rtse chen nas 'bod mi gnang ba dang bstun zla ba bcu pa'i 'jug tsam la rtse chen chos sde'i bla brang shar du sleb/ rgyud bla ma'i gzhung gi 'phros dang*/ rnam 'grel gyi le'u gnyis pa dang bzhi pa dang gsum pa'i grags che che rnams 'dir sdod skabs bzung ba yin zhing*/ ṭī ka'i nye bar mkho mkho nas kyang mang du bzung*/ bka' las kyang tshad ma'i dpe cha sngar yang mang du song da dung 'di legs par shes pa rang zhig byed dgos phebs kyin 'dug na'ang*/

de skabs tshad ma'i chos skad la blo 'gro ba zhig ma byung bas dpe 'dzin sogs dkyus mthun byas mod kyi/ tshad ma la chos skad lhongs su gyur pa ma chags/ phyis tshad ma'i dpe cha la dpe klogs 'dra byed dgos byung ba'i tshe sngar dang mi 'dra ba go ba 'char 'char 'dra ba yong gin 'dug na'ang*/ chos byed lugs nged cag gi rigs 'di la dgos don chung bar shes nas rtsol ba byed pa ma byung ngo*/ / spyir nas byang chub sems dpa' mchog shing rta chen po'i ring lugs la 'gangs chung zair ba lta ga la yin/ mkhas mchog thams cad kyi 'jug ngogs yin pa gzhir bcas/ dgun de bla brang shar gyi dpe cha rnams la dpe blta zhib mor byas/ de skabs bla brang na'ang dpe cha shin tu mang bar 'dug cing*/ dpe cha klogs pas don go bas blo bskyed 'phral 'phral thon pa rang ma byung na'ang*/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung rgya bod kyi 'grel pa yig cha so so'i 'jogs kyi yong thang la 'di lta bu yod par 'dug snyam pa'i chos rgyus la shin tu phan par byung*/ bya lo'i cho 'phrul kyi skabs/ gsung rab dang rten bzhengs gsar pa mdzad pa rnams la/ slob dpon rin po ches rab tu gnas pa mdzad pa'i phyag phyir dkris te nged rang gis kyang cho ga byas/ lan gcig po de kha la rab gnas kyi phyag len nges par byung*/ snga sor spyan 'dren btang ba ltar de'i sang nyin brag stod nas rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal snga nas kyang phebs/ tshes bcu dgu la slar yang dpon slob thams cad lhan du bla brang shar du byon/ de'i sang nyid na bsre 'pho'i khrid dang 'bum nag gi lung gi dbu tshugs/ zla ba gcig la chos skor rnams yongs su rdzogs par gnang*/ bla ma dam pa ni zhabs drung bkra shis stobs rgyas drung gis ra lung du khor tsam spyan 'dren gnang song zhing slar yang rtse chen du phebs nas gyi ljang lugs mgon po lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang dang*/ 'gro mgon zhang gi bka' 'bum po ti dang po'i lung sogs stsal zhing*/

hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum gza' skar dge ba la/ ngos cag rtse chen chos sde'i khri thog tu mnga' gsol/ sras yum rnams dang*/ rgyal rtse nas yon mchod/ phyogs kyi dad can so so nas legs ja yang mang dag byung*/ 'di nas bzung nas mthun rkyen yang ma 'phongs tsam dang*/ khyad par ja bskol rgyu 'bad med du byung*/ de nas tshes bcu la 'brong rtser sleb tsam byas/ stag rtse dang lhun grub rtser khor tsam phyin nas/ dpon slob thams cad ri khrod chen po bsam sdings su phyag phebs/ zla ba gnyis tsam gyi bar du rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen por/ chos kyi sgo bgrang ba las 'das pa thob ste/ zhang 'tshal pa'i chos skor thams cad dang*/ yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung dang*/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ dwags po bka' 'bum sogs bka' brgyud kyi bla ma snga phyir byon pa'i gsung rab shin tu mang po dang*/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang sogs thob cing*/ o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid dang lung yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ bcu gsum phag mo'i byin rlabs sogs dpag tu med pa thob cing*/ chos bar du zab mo'i chos kyi gleng slang las brtsams pa'i sku rtsed bzhad gad theg ge ba/ nyin mtshan kun tu nyams dga' yal le bas 'da' ba byung*/ de nas bkra shis rdzong kha nas spyan 'dren bzhin rdzong khar phebs zla ba gnyis tsam bzhugs/ rje btsun mar pa'i thugs bcud thugs sras rngog la bka' 'babs pa'i dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug dang smṛ ti nas brgyud rngog pa la byung ba 'jam dpal gsang ldan rnams kyi dbang bskur ba dang*/ so so'i rgyud 'grel/ rgya bod kyi yig sna shin tu mang ba dang bcas pa'i lung stsal zhing*/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i zab khrid/ bsre 'pho'i 'khrid tshul zab rgyas su gnang*/ dgyes rdor yab yum gdan bzhi ma hā mā ya rnams kyi dbang gnang skabs rmi lam gyi ltas ngo mtshar can yang mang du byung*/

byin rlabs kyi tshad ka zla med par yid ches brnyed/ bar skabs su thob rgyal du 'bod mi nan can byung ba la brten khor tsam zhig phyin/ ra lung nas spyan 'dren gnang ba ltar rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po slar yang ra lung du phebs pa gnang song zhing*/ bdag gis bsam sdings su 'ongs/ de skabs dus 'khrug gi zir bun yang che bar yod/ rtse chen nas 'ong nas de bar du chos thob che zhing zab mo'i don la blo skyed che bar byung yang*/ mdo phyogs kyi slob gnyer 'phro chad/ slar yang 'phro 'thud pa'i khungs tsam du yod na'ang*/ gtam bya rin chen 'phreng ba gsar 'dzin thub/ de min ston la thug gi bar dpe cha byas rjes cang ma byung*/ snga sor zha lu pa'i bka' srol skyong ba rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug rje byang gling pa la chos gang zhu zhu yod kyang 'dun pa med pas zhu ma thub/ 'di skabs sku gshegs pas phyis 'gyod par byung*/ de nas sde pa gtsang pa'i dmag kyang pa snam du lhags/ rdzong la 'pho 'chug byung*/ sde pa grwa lnga'i drung smin drug khyung rtser 'byor dgos shar/ ser kha de rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po slar yang bsam sdings su phebs shing*/ bla sgrub dang rten 'brel yongs su rdzogs par thob/ ro snyoms sgang dril tsam zhig dang*/ 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma'i dbang sogs yid tshim par byung*/ dus gzings grol 'phral khri snar lhun rtse gting skyes sogs brgyud nas sgrub gnas dam par phebs pa gnang song*/ de nas mi ring bar rje drung dbang phyug rdo rje pa snam du phebs pa la/ bdag gis kyang zhal mjal zhu bar phyin cag mal zhig bsdad/ slar yang dgon par log phyin nas zhag shas shig song skabs/ stod phyogs nas bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can yon mchod rnams kyis 'bod mi gnang byung ba ltar stod phyogs la 'ongs/ smin drug khyung rtser sde ba grwa lnga'i drung dang mjal tsam byas/

tshong 'dus dbu rtser sde pa rje drung dang lhun chen sogs dang mjal zhag shas bsdad/ lo chen rat+na bha dra'i sprul sku yang karma pa mjal bar phebs pa'i lam zhor du dbu rtser phebs/ nged la shin tu thugs dag snang che bar mdzad kyin 'dugathog mar ngos kyis 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig zhus shing*/ phar yang chos 'brel zhig dgos gsung ba ltar bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig ka phul/ yar lam snar thang sogs brgyud nas/ rje klu sgrub pas 'bod mi gnang pa ltar bya rgod gshongs su khor tsam phyin rim pas jo nang du sleb rje drung dang mjal tsam byas shing*/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la chos lung byang chub rtser son/ rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can dang mjal/ zhal ras mthong ba tsam la lus nyams dpe med pa zhig byung*/ zla ba de'i ngo sgang la bka' chos mang du zhus/ cho 'phrul dus chen gyi tshes lnga'i nyin/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnas mchog chos lung byang rtser khri thog tu bskau ba gnang zhing*/ bla ma dam pa nyid kyis phyag nas kyang gtor/ snga sor bsam sdings nas yar yong grabs yod pa'i skabs nas nyin re bzhin sna khrag than thun yong ba byung*/ yun ring pa nas skabs 'di tsa na lus kyi shed kyang cung zad bri/ de skabs smon 'gror 'phan ne drung gi nang rten gser gdung bzhengs grub pa'i skabs yin pas dus chen grol nyin rang*/ bla ma dam pa'i phyag phyir dkris nas smaun 'gror phyin/ de nyid rang rab gnas kyi sta gon 'jug pa gnang*/ nang bar dngos gzhi'i cho ga rnams nyi phyed yan la grub/ dga' ston bzhugs gral gyi steng du dngos kyis pod chen bzhi la dam bca' re byas/ chos rje ngag dbang bkra shis pas bgro gleng gtong ba mdzad de rigs lung bag chags par byung*/ rab gnas rang gi rten 'brel ni 'os bab las ma byung*/ ngos cag sngar gyi na ba'i rgyun de thur song ba mngon pa tsam byung*/

nyer gsum la lhun sdings zhol du sleb tsam pas/ nyer bzhi la bsam 'grub dga' ldan du phyin/ khong rnams kyis bsu ba sogs bzab ma byas/ nyi ma gnyis po de shin tu khams ma bde/ khyad par se mkhar chung gi lho thad der grog po zhig tu rta babs nas cung zad sdod dgos byung*/ ja dkar yol gang 'thung ring tsam dbugs kyi rgyu ba yang 'gags slob dpon rin po che dang*/ zla bo rnams thugs 'tshab la gtad par gda'/ nga rang gi snang ba la da lta'i snang ba 'di nub cing*/ he ru ka'i sku'i rnam pa mang pos nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab pa'i snang ba tsam byung*/ phyis bsams dus 'di yin pa byin rlabs kyi ltas cig yin par 'dugade ltar byung ba gsangs pas gzhan gyis ma shes/ sang zhogs bsam 'grub dga' ldan pa rnams kyis chos 'brel dgos zer/ nged kyis khri thog tu 'ongs pa dang dung bus pa dang nyi ma shar ba gsum dus mnyam du byung*/ rten 'brel des da res bar chad kyi dbang du mi 'gro ba 'dug snyam nges pa brnyed/ nang par ngam ring du 'byor zhing*/ bla ma dam pas bdag cag dang sde bdag zhal ngo dang yon mchod du sbrel ba'i bka' bkod gnang ba la/ snga sor zhal ngos kyang zhal len mdzad yod 'dug na'ang*/ bar skabs der gzhan rkyen gyis bsgyur 'dugabla ma dag pas drung chen sangs snying ba sngon la rdzong ba mdzad pa'i bka' nan chags kyis stabs mi mdzes pa med tsam om so ba byas/ der yang zhag gsum bsdad skabs khams shin tu ma bde/ de nas rma bya shug khrod du phyin/ de la ngam ring du sleb pa tshun chad nas shug khrod du zla ba gcig gi bar du snga dro re bzhin sna khrag bzed zhal gang gang brdal/ lus kyi shed stobs thams cad bri/ tho rangs ja sbyor re tsam ma gtogs mtshan mo gnyid kyang mi yong zhing*/ gnyid cung zad de'i ring la skye ba sna tshogs su 'phos pa de dag gi spyod pa sna tshogs pa'i rmi lam zad mi shes pa re rtag tu 'ong*/

nyin bar chos zhu ba sogs la mi bde ba rang ma byung*/ de skabs sman dang sngags gdams ngag sogs 'di ma byas bya ba med de ci yang phan pa ma byung*/ chos skyong gi 'khu ldog yin nam zer bskang gso stong tshar sogs byas kyang ma phan/ zla gcig tsam song skabs der rmi lam du ri chen po zhig gi rtse na/ bram ze rin chen rdo rje'am kha che a mo gha yin nam snyan pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam pa gzi brjid can zhig la bud med sum cu bzhi bcus bskor ba zhig 'dugade'i zhal nas khyod sngar 'khor lo sdom pa la mchod pa rtag tu byed pa yin pa la/ phyis ma byas par yun ring rab song*/ bde mchog gi rgyud la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis nad 'di 'phral du grag 'gro/ de nas bsnyen pa zhig byas na bar chad thams cad sel zhing dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rjes su 'dzin par 'dug gsung ba cig byung*/ sang slob dpon rin po che la zhus pas/ 'o na bla ma dam pa la dbang zhig kyang gsan na dga'/ rgyud kyi dpe ni 'di ka na yod pas da rang nas ka 'dzin pa gnang na gsung gin 'dug pas/ spyir gsang sngags dang khyad par 'khor lo sdom pa'i chos la dang spro bar byung nas de nyin rang nas dpe cha bzung*/ zhag gsum song ba nas sna khrag je nyung la song*/ de mtshams slob dpon rin po che cung zad bsnyung nas rdo rje gur khang du bzhugs pa gnang*/ bla ma dam par bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang zhus pas dngos gzhi'i snga dro nas sna khrag chad/ dbang gnang dus so sor dmigs pa dang lha ngo bstan pa'i dus su dkyil 'khor gyi dmigs pa shin tu gsal ba dngos su mthong ba snyam pa dang dbang gi ring la lus bde cham cham pa byung*/ dbang grol nas tshogs 'khor gyi tshe lus la sngar las shed cher song ngam snyam pa 'dugade phyin chad khams bde zhing lus kyang yar sor byung*/ de nyid kyi 'phro 'thud nas dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang yang zhus/ nag po pa dang dril bu pa'i khrid tshul yongs grags rnams dang*/

thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan brgyud zhal shes rnams kyis legs par brgyan pa dang*/ rtsa bshad so so'i bshad 'doms dang lung sogs mthar rgyas su stsal/ byams chos kyi bshad 'doms khog phubs kyang nyin re bzhin stsal ba yang lhag par blo la 'jag cing nges shes skye ba byung*/ bla ma dag pa'i bka' lung gis shug khrod kyi khri thog tu bsko bar gnang*/ bla ma dam pas phyag nas gtor/ bdag po nam mkha' rgyal po sku mched kyis kyang khri ston sogs gnang ba yin kyang*/ phyis bla ma dam pa sku chos dbyings su gshegs rjes/ drung chen pas nged la gros tsam yang ma dris par byang rang du phul ba yin/ de nas hor zla gsum pa'i 'jug la sku gzhogs nas dgongs grol zhus phyir yongs skabs brtan bzhugs bzab rgyas su phul te/ cu pa rong sogs brgyud nas mar lam khrod phur gnas mjal la phyin/ byams pa'i zhal ras lha khang du zhag gcig nyal/ de nub rig pa dwangs shing gsol ba yun ring du btab pas byams chos kyi tshig don sngar ma go ba 'ga' zhig la go ba lam lam 'char ba zhig byung*/
