de nas sna thang khrid khang sogs brgyud nas rang gnas bsam gtan sdings su sleb/ de mtshams zhag shas nas bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyang tshang bar blo la 'grigade lo chos lung du mkhar las shig byas pa dka' las che la ngo mtshar chung ba zhig byung*/ de bar la slob dpon rin po che'i drung du dag ljon skor gsum dang rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i 'dzug khrid zhib len zhus/ brtag gnyis la sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad sgros blo la 'them zhing go ba chags/ bla ma sa lugs kyi bshad sgros la ches dges shing thugs rtsis che ba 'dug na'ang*/ nged rang 'bru bsnon rngog lugs de khyad kyis blo la 'bab pa byung*/ hor zla lnga pa'i nyer lnga nas bsnyen mtshams bsdams/ zla ba gsum gyi bar du bsnyen pa 'jur bar bgyis shing*/ grangs bsnyen kha skongs lhag bcas sbyin sreg dang bcas pa grub/ kha skongs kyi bzlas pa'i skabs rmi lam du rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ rnal 'byor pa dang*/ bod kyi bla ma 'ga' re dang bcas pa kun bsgril phyed dang nyis brgya tsam 'duganged rang gi lus po shin tu che ba zhig 'dug cing*/ de rnams kyis ste'u dang sog le dang gzong sogs kyis lus la gzhog pa sogs bzo bcos mang po byas te/ lhag ma thams cad chu la bor/ rus pa la bcos pa yin zer ba'i bde mchog gi sku mda' gang tsam zhig 'od khrom mer 'dugarang gi lus sogs 'di yin med pa la de la phar blta zhing ngo mtshar che snyam pa zhig shar ro// rab dwangs sems kyi chu mtshor srid zhi yi/ / snang brnyan gsal bar 'char la ya mtshan ci/ / byin rlabs zer ma gcig gis dngos grub kun/ / 'grub 'gyur bla ma dam pa'i mthu 'di mtshar/ / mtshams grol 'phral la nye skor gyi yul mi rnams la khraum dbang tshe dbang zhig byas/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi thang ka dang dpe ster mkhan byung ba la nye bzang khri snar gnyis nas 'bod mi nan can byung ba ltar khor tsam re phyin/

tshur lam khri khang nas sman lung du zhag gcig bsdad/ nā ro pa'i phyag dril dang thugs dam dgyes rdor gyi dkyil thang mjal gsol ba btab/ nang bar mdol byung du sleb zhag shas bsdad cing*/ gzims khang la rab gnas dang dgongs bzhed kyi chos than thun phul/ bsam sdings su khor tsam phyin/ 'jag pa dpon slob grwa rigs thams cad nged la 'phrad pa dang chos 'brel nod par phebs/ 'jag bsam lhan du tshogs pa de ga la dus gtor chen mo yang mdzad/ mkha' 'gro ma'i dbu thod byin rlabs kyi rtags can gcig kyang lag tu byung*/ de dus nang mchod la bdud rtsi ril bu gcig rang brdungs nas btab/ de nas chang rnams la cung zad re gtor/ chang de tsho 'dres tshad dam rdzas dri zhim mtshungs pa med pa rang gis khyab/ phud mchod byed zer ston mo tshogs 'khor nyin re la lan gnyis re tsam yod pa la snyad pa'i chang 'thung gi yo lang zhag mang po byung ba'i rting ma chang lhag tshun chod la dri bzang chil chil rang yod pa byung ba mi mang thams cad ky-is 'thung myong ba'i rdzun med rang yin/ slar stag rtse brgyud rtse chen chos sde'i bla brang shar du sleb dgun zangs kyi bsdad/ mtshams ha cang dam pa ma yin pa phyi mtsham med pa byas/ sangs rgyas thod pa dang ma hā mā ya'i grangs bsnyen re song*/ bde dgyes kyi rgyud 'grel kun la dpe blta re yang ma chag par byas/ de skabs mkhan rin po ches/ rje 'phags pa'i drung gdan sar bsko bzhag gnang ba dpon slob gnyis car du ja zhus gang bzab re phul zhing*/ mtshams grol 'phral mkhan rin po che mjal ba dang chos zhu'i bzhed chen po yod na'ang*/ gsang stabs nas nub chos lung du 'phral phebs shar/ cho 'phrul gyi ring la sgrol ma lha khang du gsung rab rnams la rab gnas kyi rdo rje slob dpon byas/ de skabs kun dga' chos ldan pa lo gsum grol zhing*/ mkhan rin po che'i dgongs pa'ang grol ba nas nged kyi zla la byung*/

hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum la shar phyogs su bskyod/ de gong blo bde nas yum drung gshegs pa'i dmigs ltas gsal po zhig byung ba skabs 'dir dngos gsal du gyur/ bcu bdun gyi nyin stag lung rdzong rtser sleb/ yab sras rnams dang mjal/ phyag gi rten mjal rnams zhib par byas/ rje btsun o rgyan mtsho mo'i sku skye ye shes dbang mo dang yang mjal ba rmi lam bzang bar mngon pa tsam byung*/ yar 'brog bsam sdings pa rang gi phyag gi rten mjal rnams zhib len byas/ sde pa g.yu lo ba'i nang rten sman pa'i rgyal po'i gser sku la rab gnas bgyis shing*/ slar yon mchod lhan du stag lung bla brang dkar por phebs/ nai gu'i khrid dgos phebs pa ltar sgyu lus dbang mo ches sgo phye nas/ khrid tshul shin tu smin pa zla ba phyed gnyis kyi bar du phul/ chos rje sngags ram bas gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon rin po ches dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang khrid yongs su rdzogs par gnang song zhing dam po rgyag pa'ang mang du byung*/ de skabs sde pa bstan 'dzin drung gis dngos la mjal res kyi phyag rten bzang po 'chag med mdzad/ bkra shis kha btags bzang ba rang yang phyed nyis brgya tsam byung zhing*/ de thams cad lha sa dang rwa bsgreng gi bar du snyan dar 'bab zhig la phul bas gnyis thang du dge tshogs 'phel bar byung ngo*/ / nga ni bla ma nor po che de min/ gang yod dge ba la gtong mkhan cig de dus nas yin/ sde dpon dang mi nag pa la yon gnas 'chol mkhan gyi bla rdzus tsho dang cung mi 'dra lags/ de nas dzo gi mang po dang yang lam sdebs byung ste rang yul du brtol/ drin can gyi ma dang mjal zhing zhag shas bag phebs par bsdad/ chu bo ri'i gru la thon/ kun chos pa yar 'brog nas gzung nas chu nad byung ba la sman dpyad sogs gang drag bgyis kyang ma phan te/ skyor mo lung du sleb tsam yod la re ba'i blo 'dun yin na'ang*/

chu shul gla ra'i gong tsam du 'das/ 'on kyang phung po la 'ja' tshon zug pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i rtags mang du byung*/ gye re lha khang du tsha thog la sleb/ bris sku khrag 'thor ma'i rten mjal dgos tshul zhal ngo rnams la 'phrod phul bas/ rje dam pa'i skye ba yin na rang re'i rje sangs rgyas ras chen dngos yin 'dug pas mjal dgos par 'dugade min bris sku rten mjal la bskur gtong gsung nas brtag bsgril mdzad pas brtag pa thon gsung*/ de 'phral lha rin po che sku mched gnyis car phebs te/ phyag sogs gus pa'i bkur bsti dpag tu med pa mdzad/ rten mjal rnams kyang shin tu zhib cing blo khog tshim par zung*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi chos 'brel zhig kyang phul/ sang nyin snye thang 'or gyi lha khang rnams mjal/ rim pas skyor mo lung du 'byor/ zhabs drung yum drung dang mjal bas shin tu dgyes pa'i ngang nas dgongs bzhed kyi dbang chos ci rigs pa phul/ zhag bzhi tsam bsdad/ de nas dpal gyi chos 'khor lha sar sleb cing zhag bcu gsum tsam bsdad/ nyin re bzhin 'phrul snang rang la rten mjal lan gnyis ma re dang*/ ra mo cher lan re 'chag med du phyin/ de skabs rgyu dngos bzang po med na'ang gang yod mchod rdzas la 'bungs shing*/ tsan dan dkar dmar dzā ti gur kum sogs dri bzang gi phye ma ka to ra do tsam zhig la ser zho bcu drug tsam bsres/ nyin re bzhin sku rnams la gtor/ dri bzang gi bdug spos dang snyan dar kyang rang blo tshim par 'bul rgyu byung*/ lha sa rang dang ra mo che dang lha khang rme ru pho brang dmar lcags grib mda' lha khang tshun chad kyi lha thams cad la/ gser zhal yang bzang rab byung*/ lha khang so sor smon lam yang mang du btab/ de nas yer ba mjal bar phyin/ stag lung nas dpon sa'i drung shin tu dgyes pa'i ring nas zhag shas bsdad/ zhabs drung stobs rgyas drung 'bri gung phyogs nas der phebs pa dang mjal shin tu dgyes par byung*/

der stag lung nas 'bod mi gnang byung ba bzhin yer pa'i la rgyab/ jog po'i nang la babs yongs/ mkhar rtse ba'i sde pa rgyal bu yer ba mjal bar phebs pa'i phyag g.yog rnams dang lam der 'phrad byung zhing*/ sde pa rang lam gzur ba tsam mdzad song*/ de nub gnyag grong du bsdad/ sang nyin lhun grub rdzong du sras yum tshor tshe rta sbrags ma zhig dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ sang snga bar phyag la brgal phyin mtshams grwa nang gling gsum gyi mkhan slob mi sna so so dang bcas pa rnams ja 'dren dang bsu bar phebs/ nyin phyed tsam la gling gi dge 'dun rnams kyis bsu ba rgya chen po dang bcas te gzigs spyil du 'byor gnangs nyin de gza' skar bzang ba yod 'dug pa nas/ mchod khang rtser rigs brgya'i mgon po sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs drung dang mjal/ shag byang du sna len gyi bzhugs gral bzab rgyas su gnang zhing*/ phyag rdor 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i tshe dbang de nyid chos 'brel gyi thog mar zhus shing*/ de mtshams nas bde mgon lha mo sogs kyi dbang rjes gnang so so'i chos skor yongs rdzogs/ khyad par sku rags skor gyi 'khrid tshul zhib rgyas su stsal/ 'gro mgon rin po che phag gru'i bka' 'bum nas zab bsdus kyi glegs bam gcig tsam dang*/ stag lung thang ba chen po'i bka' 'bum/ gzhan yang rgyud sde mang po'i lung sogs thob cing*/ dngos kyis lha khang shod du tshogs pa rnams la sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang dang*/ nai gu sogs ci rigs par bshad/ bka' nan cher stsal ba la brten te/ zhabs drung du 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang zhig gis thog ma'i legs byas kyi sgo phye nas/ dgongs bzhed ltar chos bka' ci rigs pa phul/ 'di skabs stag lung du zla ba phyed dang gnyis tsam song*/ bar skabs shig rwa bsgreng mjal bar phyin/ phar lam ser gla'i gnas mjal byas nas phu mdor sde pa yab sras rnams dang yang mjal/

rwa bsgreng du zhag po bdun tsam bsdad/ gser zhal dang mchod pa sogs rang la bltos pa'i gang grag 'bul rgyu byung*/ 'di skabs rje grog kha ba dang yang mjal/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang zhig zhus/ stag lung nas phyir 'ongs dus zhabs drung rtser rten 'brel gyi bkra legs pa'i dbang du byas/ tshe ring mched lnga'i rjes gnang zhig zhus shing*/ brtan bzhugs bzab rgyas shig kyang phul/ lha 'phreng gi rnam pas char brdungs yang yang byung*/ de nub dbu ma ba'i nang du bsdad/ sang nyin po to'i gnas mjal byas te/ lhun grub rdzong brgyud lcang lung chos sdings su zhag bzhi bsdad/ tshogs chos 'chag med dang so so'i 'dod chos ci rigs pa bshad/ spyan snga rin po ches 'bod mi nan can gnang ba ltar glang thang du phyogs khrom che grags pas ma shogs nas khong tsho byings kyis byang sgo la byon/ nged kyis chas brdzus nas shar sgo la 'ongs/ phyis khong tshos nged la glang thang 'dzin bdag khyed dgos tshul gleng slang mang po byung na'ang byed mi dgos pa'i rten 'brel du song 'dugazhal lnga tsam bsdad de chos dang 'byor pa shin tu rgyas par byung*/ de nas sgo la la thon nas slar yang ra sa 'phrul snang du sleb/ zhag drug tsam zhig bsdad/ 'di skabs nas 'brang du sdod skabs yan la/ drung sngags 'chang don grub pa la rang gi pha mes tsho'i nyams bzhes kyi chos mang dag la dogs gcod dang gsar du zhu ba sogs byas/ de skabs chu shin tu che bas lha sa dang ra mo che'i bar gyi chu la yang ko ba gtong dgos zhag kha yar byung*/ skor lam thams cad kyang chus khengs shing chu rags 'phral 'phral brtsigs kyang 'phral 'phral zhig 'gro ba'i mi thams cad sun zhing gtsug lag khang la chu nyen shin tu che bar 'dug ste dka' tshegs la ma 'dzem par/ jo mjal la lan gnyis gnyis dang*/ ra mo cher lan re 'chag med dang*/ chu gseb la yang skor ba gnyis gsum re gang 'grub byas/

rta skyog zhon nas 'gro ba khad de 'dra ye ma byas/ de nas shun du zhabs drung grags pa rgya mtsho dang mjal zhing*/ shin tu dgyes pa'i phyag sogs bkur bsti dpe med gnang*/ chu rgyas pas 'dza' 'phrang dzo 'phrang la mi thar ba 'dug pas/ bang la zer ba ri mthon po zhig bskor te nyi ma phyed yol la 'ga' grong du sleb/ sngar 'dris med rung 'ga' grong gi gnyer pas gzhis len bzang po dpe med byas/ mgron po'i bsod nams lam gyi dper byung*/ 'jangs pa'i sde pa zhal ngo rnams la ma ṇi'i lung zhig byas/ 'jangs dang 'tshar pa sna'i bar yang 'phrang gi lam chus nub nas rtas 'gro mi thub pa 'dug pas bye la zhig la bcad nas 'ongs/ rta khal sogs chad/ la shin tu gzar bas sbyong spyod che bar byung bas 'tshar pa sna'i ne thang der cung zad ngal gso yin bsdad/ dgon pa na rgyang nas dpon sa'i drung bzhugs 'dug pas 'bod mi byung*/ de nub bla ma lha khang der bsdad/ zhag gcig shin tu skyid par byung*/ nang bar chu shul du mthun rkyen bzab ma mdzad/ chos 'brel zhig kyang byas/ khong zhal ngo rgan pa rnams mos gus skyes bstan 'dzin rin po che'i gsung cho zong mar song zer bar gda'/ sang yol ri gong du sleb tsam byas/ smyug lar sde pa dpal bzang pa la rtswa shing gi mthun rkyen dgos tshul zhu bar ma ṇi ba dge 'dun rin chen gyis phyin kyang mthun rkyen ni sna gcig kyang ma byung*/ ri gong du zhag gsum bsdad/ rang byung mgon po la phyag mchod smon lam yid tshim bar byas/ de nas lhun rab tu 'bod mi nan can byung ba bzhin phyin/ gzha' ri skyed tshal ba rnams nang 'khrug gi skabs shig na 'dug zhal ngo rnams kyis gzhi len bzabs/ de'i sang 'brang mda'i chugs la 'thon 'brang phu dgon par sleb/ de mtshams slob dpon rin po che bsam sdings la phebs/ nged kyis zla ba gcig tsam bsdad cing*/ mi ngo rnams la nai gu'i khrid cig kyang bshad/

a khu rab 'byams ba zhig byung 'dug pa khong gi phyag dpe rnams la blta rtog 'dra byas/ tshad ma mdo'i gzhung zhig 'dugaslob dpon rin po che tshad ma'i dpe cha bzung ba la shin tu dgyes par 'dug pas/ kun las btus kyi gzhung de byang bar bzung*/ de nas dpal de brgyud g.yu mtsho la ko ba btang ste sgo lung bar sleb/ yul pa dang dgon pa so sor tshe dbang sogs 'dod chos 'dra bshad nas/ lhun grub smon mkhar du sde pa bstan 'dzin drung dang mjal/ de mtshams nas zla gcig mtshams dam par bcad/ mi g.yo ba sngon po'i bsnyen pa zhig byas/ de grol mtshams 'dzam gling chos 'khor nas rin po che grags pa lhun grub pa gtso bor byon pa'i do nang gi bla mar smos pa bdun brgyad zhig dang*/ gzhan yang don gnyer sum cu skor la skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim dang*/ nai gu'i khrid tshul ngag nas bshad cing*/ lhag ma khrid brgya lung khrid kyi tshul du rdzogs par btang*/ gsang 'dus sgron gsal gyi dpe zhig ster mkhan byung ba dga' ba dang gus pa chen pos blta rtog klog 'thems pa zhig byas/ de skabs go rtogs ni gcig kyang ma byung yang phyis go ba rang zhig byed snyam pa'i zhe dam byas/ dgon pa lha lung du phyin pas ya mtshan pa cig yod/

rim pas yon mchod lhan cig rgyags kyi gzhis kar phebs sang snga bar byon sngon dus mar pa do pa'i bzhugs gnas rgyags mda'i lha khang zhig ro der phyin/ sa phyogs de grub pa'i bsti gnas su 'dug pas gus pa chen pos phyag dang skor ba zhig byas dar lcog cig btsugs/ 'dzam gling chos 'khor du gung tshigs byas/ sna dkar rtse'i klu sdings su sleb/ de nub rmi lam du bud med cig na re/ mar do lo tsā ba de bde mchog 'khor lo rang yin te mkhas su re ba 'ga' zhig gis skur pa byed kyin 'dugakhyed rang mar do'i gsung la ltos dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i nges gsang rnams de na yod zer ba zhig byung*/ phyis glang mtsho'i 'gram du bud med khyim ma gcig gis lnga tshan gcig byin pa'i sdebs la mar do'i 'gyur rtsa rgyud mchan ma gcig byin byung ba de la bltas dus rgyud kyi tshig don 'ga' re'i go ba la phan pa byung ba dang*/ lar phyi nang gi byang phyogs skor do ba lugs bshad pa bzang pa la lta ba 'dra/ gzhan dmigs gsal rang ni ma byung*/ de nas nged yon mchod lhan du mkha' ro gangs phug tu phebs/ zhag po lnga pa zhig bsdad/ de nas gnam gru bzhir sde pa grwa lnga'i drung dang mjal byung*/ rgyal rtser sde pa zhal ngo rnams la tshe dpag med lha dgu ma'i dbang bskur zhig phul te/ de'i sang nyin rtse chen du sleb/ de skabs dpon mo rgyal bu khrid phebs 'phral yin/ rtse'i gtsug lag khang gi gnas brtan lha khang du zhag shas bsdad gtso cher sgrol ma byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs pa kho na byas/ zhal ngo so sor dgongs bzhed kyi chos 'dra phul/ 'di skabs chos sder rgyang tsam bsdad cing so so'i 'dod chos 'dra bshad/ de nas mar lam stag tsher gyi gong tsam der yur ba zhig na 'od 'tsher ba 'dug pas mgyogs por phyin nas blangs tsa na/ don zhags kha che paṇa chen lugs lha lnga'i rdo sku zhig brnyed/ de nub rang gnas bsam sdings su sleb/

de skabs hor zla bcu pa'i 'jug yin zhing*/ bcu gcig pa tshes 'phral mtshams bsdams zla ba gsum du gshin rje'i gshed kyi rigs 'dra'i bsnyen pa dang*/ de rjes zla ba gnyis bstan srung gi bsnyen pa 'dra byas/ 'di skabs rmi lam gyi ltas rtsub 'gyur che ba mang po byung*/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi dang bco lnga la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mkhas pa'i dbang phyug slob dpon rin po che'i drung gis don gnyer mang dag zhig gi ngor/ bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs su gsol te/ dbang bskur cha gsum bzhi gnang bar sgo dod pa/ dngos kyis kyang bdag po chen po'i dbang gi bar rdzogs par zhus/ 'di'i gong tsam du chos lung byang rtser mched grogs dpal sdings pas/ gzhung pa'i khang pa la me bcugagazhung pas kyang dpal sdings pa'i chas ka mang po bcol po'i sa nas bskor/ gnyis kar bla ma dam pas chos lung nas 'bud pa gnang 'dugaskabs 'dir dpal sdings pa bsam sdings su sleb byung chas ka sogs gang drag byin nas brdzangs/ khong smon 'gro ba'i rtsa mi rang yin te rang la tshugs kha ma byung tsa na gnas skabs der khyi bskyur wa bskyur la song*/ de nas rim pas khri khang du zla ba phyed tsam bsdad sde pa rje drung dang zhal ngo gzhan so sor dgongs bzhed kyi chos than thun phul/ de nas snar thang du zhag bcu bdun tsam bsdad sdod sa byams lha khang du byas/ zer bzhi'i slob dpon sogs dge bshes mang dag la nai gu dang snying po don gsum bshad/ byang chen la nyin 'khor zhig mjal du phyin/ de nas lu gu rir zhag gcig bsdad/ chu mig gi rje btsun ma bzhugs kyin 'dug pas phyag mchod smon lam mang du byas/ srad rin chen rtser smyug grong nas mchog lags kyis bzab ma mdzad/ byi lo'i sde gzar gyi 'go yang mngon du gyur/ de nas bzang ngu'i la brgyud bkras gling du gting skyes nas zhal ngo thams cad bsu ba la phebs chos grwar zla gcig zhag po nyi shu skor bsdad cing zhal ngo rnams la rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dang*/

dpal mgon trak+shad kyi rjes gnang sogs rjes gnang zur bka' mang rab dang*/ chos rje stag sna ba'i dgongs bzhed ltar dgon gsum gyi grwa rigs drag bsdus rnams la sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang dang khrid tshul thad thud 'dra bshad/ de skabs dus 'khrug gi skabs yin/ de nas la smad kyi dkar la'i sgrub gnas de mjal du phyin pas bag chags cung zad zhig sad/ byang phug gi jo bo mjal zhing zhag gsum gyi bar du phyag dang skor ba ci nus byas/ dkar me snyan dar yang mang rab 'bul rgyu byung*/ stag sna chu 'dus nyi shar rnams brgyud nas drang so'i mda' der/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po grub pa'i dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas kyang*/ bsu bar phebs pa dang yang zhal mjal bong chu'i rab brgal/ mtsho sgor dpon sa khye 'dren gyis bzab ma byas/ de nas 'brang dpon po'i sar zhag gcig bsdad/ khong tshos rus gcig pa yin zer ba'i zhen gyis sprug sprug bsigs bsigs byas/ de nas sa la gnas pa'i 'og min brag stod ye shes kyi pho brang du sleb/ bla ma'i bka' bkod dang bstun nas/ sgrub sde rnams la nai gu zhig bshad/ snga phyir pha drug gi yul mi 'phrad du byung ba rnams la'ang chos kyi 'brel pa re thogs/ bla ma rje btsun gyi sku drung du grub snying a ma na si'i skor yongs rdzogs dang*/ chos chung brgya rtsa'i skor/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma sna tshogs pa'i rnam thar mang po'i lung*/ ma hā mā ya'i khrid tshul zhib mo/ gzhan yang zab khrid ci rigs pa dang bcas pa zhus/ chos rjong gi jo bo spyan ras gzigs kyang phebs byung ba mchod pa bzang du phul/ de skabs zla ba phyed gnyis tsam sku gzhogs su bsdad/ de kha'i dbyar la ston btags kyi ring de la slob dpon drung du dbu ma 'jug pa'i bshad pa yongs rdzogs dang*/ gzhung phran 'ga'i bshad pa dang*/ dbu ma rtsa ba sogs gzhung che ba 'ga' la gnad bsdus gal che che'i bshad pa rnams thob pa blo la nges par byung*/

phyir yong skabs tshogs 'khor rgyas pa zhig zhus shing brtan bzhugs phul/ 'di skabs bla ma rin po ches ni zla ba phyed kyi bar du zhabs skyil dkrungs lan gcig gnang ba ma zhig par bzhugs 'dugadangos kyis mtsho sgo dang mang mkhar bde skyid gling brgyud/ lha rtse rdzong du bdag po nam mkha' rgyal po dang mjal/ hor zla dgu pa'i zla smad sgrub gnas chos lung rtser sleb/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang zhal mjal/ de nas mi ring bar gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras kyi dbang khrid shin tu smin pa de'i 'go tshugs/ mai tri mkha' spyod sogs sngar ma thob pa'i chos sna'ang mang du thob/ gsung ngag gi khrid tshul rnams yig spyi la ma bltos pa'i smar khrid du thebs/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha'i nges gnas thams cad ma 'dres par phyed pa'i blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas par byung*/ 'di skabs chos rje byams rin pa/ rin po che ka bzhi nas kyi mi sna'i go chod dang*/ khong pa rang nged la 'phrad par phebs pa yang yin par 'dugagang na'ang ka bzhi nas kyis 'bul ba shin tu bzab pa rang gnang*/ dang po rje dam pas khyod rang bla ma ma byed gsung ba yod na'ang bar skabs su bla chen gyi khungs byas pa de bka' bcag par song bas de'i bshags pa yin zhing da sgos bla tshugs mi phyed pa'i dam bca' 'bul/ da lta yig brgya 'bum ther tshar gang ma'ang byed kyin yod pa'ang de la dmigs pa yin gsung ba phebs byung*/ khong rnams la yang chos 'brel bshad/ de rjes khrid grol nas zhag gnyis chos mtshams shig gnang ba/ bla ma dam pa sku khams shin tu zi ba'i nyen che ba rang zhig byung ba/ sku rim du gsang ri sogs gnas chen rnams su tshogs mchod re gtong du bcugabartan bzhugs zhig phul ba brtan bzhugs kyi tshogs grol 'phral sku khams dwangs sor gyis byung bas blo bde sangs kyis song*/ zhag bdun sku mtshams bcad rgya gnang bas sku khams shin tu dwangs par byung zhing*/

de lo rtse'i bde mchog sgrub mchod kyi rdo rje slob dpon bdag la gyis bka' bkod phebs pa ltar sa chog nas rdul tshon spyan 'dren gyi bar lhag chad med pa dang*/ dngos gzhi nyi ma bcu gsum byung*/ de skabs bka' nan cher stsal te chos lung gi khur len byed dgos phebs pa nas/ spyir dngos cag gis dgos gzhis rgya chen po 'dzin thub pa'i rigs su yang med/ da lta slob gnyer 'dra dang thugs dam 'dra yong du re ba'i 'dun pa kho na yin pa dang*/ khyad par dgon gnas 'dzin pa'i blo bzhed kyang med pa dang*/ sgos su sde pa rnams kyis kyang dgongs par bde ba med pas bzung yang bstan pa'i zhabs tog tu mi 'gro ba dang*/ yang sgos bla ma dam pa dpon slob bzhugs phyin du nged rang la 'os bab med pa'i snyan zhus zhag mang po sbel te dgongs grol zhus kyang ma byung*/ slar yang zhu nan ches na thugs log pa'i rgyud 'gro ba 'dug pas bka' bzhin mi sgrub mthu med byung zhing*/ de nas sku ji srid 'tsho'i bar du chos lung rang du gdan phab pa'i bzhugs sa gnang dgos tshul gyi gsol 'debs kho na zhus pa/ de skabs zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar byung na'ang lo de'i ngo sgang tsam ma gtogs/ chos lung du ma bzhugs/ nged rnams de skabs hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum la shar du phyogs te/ jo nang du rje drung rin po che mjal/ kun mkhyen chen po'i rnam thar 'ga' rong pas mdzad pa'i lung dang sbyor drug gi khrid lung mgyogs khrid cig zhus/ jo mo nang gi khri thog tu 'god par mdzad cing rje drung nyid kyis phyag nas kyang gtor/ de nas bya rgod gshongs su yongs zhag gsum sdod dgos byung*/ 'od dpag med kyi lha khang dang jo bo dang rnam sras kyang mjal/ jo bo la gsol ba btab dus 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku dngos yin pa la dri mas gos pa'i sku las 'od mthing kha zhig byung rang la thim snyam pa zhig byung*/

mar lam snar thang du zhag dgu bsdad/ gzhi rgyang sogs kyi dpung chen thams cad 'dugarin spungs nas sa skyong ngag dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug yab sras/ rgyal rtse nas bdag po rgyal ba'i drung*/ sde pa gser ma nas dang*/ khyung rtse nas sde pa'i drung sogs dang mjal zhing*/ so so'i dgongs brjed kyi dbang rjes gnang rnam grangs mang ba tsam phul/ rim spungs zhabs drung yang de gong brjod sgo sna tshogs la brten pa'i zhu 'phrin zab pa rang med rung*/ de skabs dad gus yang dag pa gnang gin 'dugaslar bsam rtse klu sdings su zhag gcig bsdad/ nang par mi pham rgyal ba'i mdun sa thub bstan gser mdog can gyi chos grwar 'byor mkhan slob dge 'dun rnams kyis bsu ba mdzad cing*/ bla brang du sleb ma thag bkra shis brtsegs par gzhi len bzhugs gral bzab mar byung*/ zhag bzhi'i bar du tshogs chos re ma chag pa dang*/ gzhan so so'i 'dod chos ci rigs par bshad/ 'phrad mi shin tu rnam grangs mang bas brel ba che bar byung*/ rang gnas bsam gtan sdings su sleb 'phral nas phyi mtshams se byas/ spyir snga phyi thams cad du le lo dang g.yeng bas dus 'da' ba zhig rang re'i mdzad spyod kyi sku skal du yod na'ang*/ lo 'di la brtson 'grus kyang dga' tshad tsam byas/ de lo dus gzings shin tu 'khrugs pa yod na'ang chags sdang gi rnam rtog dang chos brgyad kyi skyed 'phel gcig kyang ma byas par thos bsam sgom gsum kho na la bsgril te/ dpyid gsos mdo rtsa'i gzhung rdzogs par blo la bzung*/ mngon pa mdzod kyi dbu zhabs thar chags su zhib bshad mtha' gcod dang bcas pa/ mkhas pa'i dbang po byams pa'i mtshan can nyid las zhus/ de yang nyin phyed nas nyi ma bzhud du nye ba tsam gyi bar paṇa chen rin po che'i bka' 'bum gyi lung stsal zhing*/ dgong mo thugs dam gyi thun rnams grol ba'i rjes su/ srod la bshad pa thun che ba rang la nan chags re zhus shing*/

tho rangs snga mo thun grol mtshams sgron me'i 'od la dpe blta rgyang tsam byas/ snga dro gdan bzhes grol 'phral mdang gi bshad pa de nyid slar skyor ba re byas/ dbyar ka 'dul pa'i bshad pa zhus te sngar lugs bzhin byas/ ston ser de sgra ka lā pa'i kun bshad dang po yan la blo steng nas sa ris shin tu zhib pa zhus shing*/ de mtshams rgya 'dre'i cho 'phrul che ba byung*/ bla ma dam pas kyang kun bshad man chad slob dpon snga ma la dpe steng nas gsan/ phyis lha ldongs pa bshes gnyen rnam rgyal ba'i slob brgyud la thugs steng nas bslabs par snang bas rtog dpyad tsam byung*/ de man chad dpe steng nas 'dzug khrid rdzogs par zhus/ lo snga ma gting skyes su chos rje blo bzang pa dang mnyam du snyan dngags kyi rtsom rgyugs ci rigs pa song ba de skabs 'phro ma lus pas/ 'di skabs de'i 'phro nas blangs te rtsom rgyugs rdzogs par song*/ mdo sde rgyan la rgyas sras thogs med pa'i ṭīk+ka dang*/ 'byed gnyis la rong ṭīka sbyar ba'i bshad pa rags rim dang lung yang mnos pas go ba legs rab shar/ de ltar tha snyad kyi gtsug lag la cung zad bslabs shing*/ gzhung lugs chen po rnams la'ang ro bro blta ba tsam re byas pas kyang*/ phyis kyi mkhas grags can 'ga' zhig gis rtsom pa byas pa'i dpe cha mthong ba dang*/ mkhas pa rnams bshad pa dang 'bel gtam byed pa la ye nas rang 'gram mchu mi ldang ba tsam snang ngo*/ / 'dir smras pa/ thogs med lung rigs shing rta'i rlung stobs kyis/ / yid 'ong legs bshad 'od stong 'char ba las/ gang blo'i rgya mtshor mtha' dag shes bya yi/ / gzugs mdzes nam yang 'char ba su yis 'gog / de nas rtsas ma phyed chod tsam nas bsnyen mtshams dam par bsdams te/ cho 'phrul grol gyi bar du gdan bzhi ye shes dbang phyug ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje gnyis kyi bsnyen pa yongs rdzogs dang*/

dus 'khor lha dgu la brten nas rgyud sde gzhan gyi rung mthun sbyar ba'i bsnyen pa zhig rnams song*/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i nges gsang gi tshig don rnams la cung zad cung zad sbyangs pa dang*/ bskyed rdzogs rnams la nges shes dad pa cung zad thob pas sgom 'dod thun mong ma yin pa skyes te/ slob dpon mkhas mchog dam par gsal 'debs zhus nas cho 'phrul grol mtshams nas sa ga'i tshes bco lnga'i bar du mun khang bsten te sbyor drug rtse gcig tu bsgoms/ dngos gzhi'i mun mtshams zhag gsum nas zla gcig tsam gyi bar du lus nyams mthong nyams kyi rtags snang sogs zad mi shes pa nyin mtshan khor mor 'gro ba zhig byung*/ de nas zhag shas gcig kyang ma byung bas bshad tshod ltar spogs chog rnams byas/ de'i rkyen gyis rtags bcu'i rim pas phal cher dang don dam bsnyen pa nas bshad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rtags de yang byung*/ de la gegs sel gyi rlung sbyor dang byed bcings de byas pas gegs kyang ma byung*/ de nas bzung ste da lta'i bar du thig le lu gu brgyud sogs rtags snang rtag tu 'char ba byung zhing*/

de skabs lus gnad byed bcings la bzhur pa'i tshe gnas pa 'thug po yun ring du gnas par byung*/ de nas zla gcig tsam zhig de kha'i ngang nas rmi lam 'dzin sbyong 'dra byas pas zin sbyong gnyis car gyi sne zin nges shes pa tsam byung*/ lo snga ma glang lo dang stag lo 'di la 'brug pa sprul pa'i sku gtsang du bzhugs skabs yin/ spyir gar phebs su 'phrin las 'ur langs pa lta bu dang snyan grags lhag par che ba rlabs chen lung med du snang na'ang*/ sngon gyi las smon lam zhig gis mjal ma thub/ 'di skabs rtse chen chos sde'i kha 'dzin yang spyir dus mi bde'i g.yeng ba ches pa dang*/ khyad par sde pa gzims dpon pa sogs kyis blos chod ma chod sna tshogs kyi stabs dge sbyor 'chag pa rang zhig byung nas slar rtsis phul bas zos bde ba rang byung*/ hor zla lnga pa'i nyer gsum la tshong 'dus su sleb par byas zhag bdun tsam bsdad/ nai gu'i mgyogs khrid cig phul/ slar snar thang gi chos sder phyin zla ba gnyis tsam bsdad/ de bar la snga dro re bzhin slob dpon bzhi dge bshes dge 'dun mang dag dang dogs gcod 'bel gtam gsung gleng 'phel ba dang*/ de nas byams khang du phyag 'bul brgya rtsa re dang skor ba sum cu re/ nyin gung zhal ngo so sor dgongs bzhed kyi chos thun ci rigs dang*/ chos sde tshogs pa spyi la blo sbyong gi khrid shin tu rgyas pa dang*/ chos chung brgya rtsa'i lung sogs bka' gdams kyi chos thun che nges re dang*/ dgong mo 'dul ba lung gi gsung sgrogs yid la gcags pa'i sgo nas thun gang che re bklags zla ba gnyis po la lung bzhi rdzogs par klog thub/ gsang 'dus rim lnga'i gzhung dang spyod bsdus sgron me'i gzhung nyid la lta rtog dang go ba btsal bas phal cher la go ba 'bad med du shar/ phyis kyang mtha' gcod sogs kyi blo skyed cher 'phel ba ma gtogs gzhung tshig gi go ba la spod dgos cher ma byung*/

de skabs gnas brtan bcu drug gi yol thang zhig bsod dpal ba dang tshe ring 'phel gnyis kyis ri mo mkhan byas te bzhengs/ yol thang bkram ma thag gi thog ma'i tshig bkra la yang*/ dpe cha ster mkhan zhig byung ba'i kha yig klog pas bkra shis don grub dang bkra shis ring mo bzhugs zer ba zhig byung*/ rab gnas zin pa'i dga' ston gyi skabs su/ slob dpon pa rnams la gnas brtan gyi mdo dbyangs shig mdzod byas pas/ chos rje don yod dpal 'byor ba na re/ dang po gcig gi bkra shis skor re ma'i dpe yin/ mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shog rang la 'dam gsung ba sogs tshig bkra rten 'brel legs par byung*/ de nas hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gnyis kyi tho rangs rmi lam gyi ltas shin tu ngo mtshar ba mang po dang khyad par na gar ko ṭa'i grong khyer dza lan+dha ra'i rgyal po grub pa thob pa zhig yin yang zer/ shar phyogs lwa ba pa yin yang zer ba zhig gis sha chen kham gcig nged la gnang byung zhing*/ zos pa na lus sems bde cham gyis song ba snyam byed pa na gnyid sad/ de nas nam langs kyi bar du rig pa dwangs shing lus sems bde cham me 'dugatsha ba thon 'phral mnyam med sangs rgyas sgom ba'i gnas chen byang chub chen por yon mchod lhan du thegs/ dgon pa lho'i g.yag ra der gur 'bibs pa mdzad 'dug pas gur rang der sleb nas ja sbyor gnyis tsam song mtshams/ rje btsun sbas pa'i sangs rgyas gu ru lho phyogs pa bud+dha gub+ta nā tha'i zhabs phebs byung zhing*/ de yang dzo gi me tog ser pos thod bcings ba mthong ba tsam gyis zil che ba zhig byung*/ ja sbyor gcig tsam yul gyi gleng slang ci rigs pa zhus/ de mtshams nged kyis tshogs su khri thog tu phyin khri ston sogs kyi brel ba la yun ring bar 'gor/ de grol mtshams nas dgon pa byang gi gtsug lag khang du spos/ grub chen gyis steng gi thigs khang der bzhugs/

bdag chung ngu nas rgya gar yul dbus kyi 'phral skad 'di sus bslabs med pa zhig la shin tu byang bar shes pa zhig byung*/ 'di skabs tsa na legs sbyar gyi skad kyang mang rab shes shing*/ yul tha dad pa'i skad rigs mi gcig pa sna tshogs 'dug pa kun yang ci rigs pa phran tshegs shes kyin yod pa nas/ thog mar yul so so dang*/ chos lugs sna tshogs dang*/ rgyal rabs la sogs pa snga phyi'i lo rgyus las brtsams te dri ba mang po zhus pas/ gzhan rnams dang mi 'dra bar lo rgyus dpyis phyin pa 'thad ldan 'ba' zhig gsung pa 'dug pa dang*/ sangs rgyas pa'i mkhas grub rnams kyi lo rgyus dri ba zhus pas kyang*/ a tsa ra blun po rnams kyi gtam dang gtan mi 'dra ba shin tu yid ches par byung zhing*/ de nas rim gyis sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas tshul yang go phyag rgya bzhi'i snying po zhes bya ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor de thog ma'i chos 'brel du zhus/ rdo rje phag mo'i chos skor mang po dang*/ dza lan+dha ra'i rdo rje'i glu bi muk+ta mañdza ri'i bshad pa dang man ngag sogs zab don dpag tu med pa thogasgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dbang zhus pa'i sta gon gyi nub mo/ nged rang gi lpags pa rnams dras te shog bu byas/ khrag gi snag tsha byas/ rtsibs ma la smyu gu byas/ bud med mdzes ma drug bdun zhig gis yin mkhan byas te rgyud chog yin nyog yin gyi po ti mang po yud tsam zhig la bris grub/ sha rnams kho rang tsho la drangs/ skras glegs thag byas/ nang khrol dang rus pa sogs yon du byin pa zhig rmis/ bla ma la zhus pas shin tu bzang gsung*/ mi g.yo ba'i byin rlabs zhus pa'i nub mo'ang rmi lam ches bzang ba zhig byung*/ zla shas nas nan gyis gsol ba btab na'ang bzhugs par ni ma gnang bde mchog bla sgrub de chos 'brel gyi tha mar zhus so/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa 'di'i bka' drin gyis theg pa bla na med pa'i gzhung lugs kyi grub mtha' la sngon med pa'i blo skyed du mngon pa grangs su btab pa'ang lnga brgya tsam byung ba da lta'ang gcig kyang ma brjed bar bkra lam me yod/

gsang sngags kyi go ba la rje 'di kho na bka' drin che ba yin no/ / 'di smras pa/ gang gi zhal lung lho phyogs dri len ma/ / nges gsang sbrang rtsi'i dog pas 'khyud pa 'dis/ / snying la reg pa'i mod la mtshan rtog gi / gdung ba nam mkha'i dbyings su thim par gyur/ / phyir phebs rjes su zhag shas yid 'phreng zhing skyo shas che bar byung*/ bzhud ba'i nub tho rangs gnyid zi ba zhig la bla ma phebs byung bas yid la dga' ba dpe med byung ste/ bla ma phebs pa legs bzhugs sa gang du mdzad dam zhus pas/ khyod kyi mgo la lo 'bum phrag gcig sdod do gsung ba rmi/ rim pas de'i gnangs nyin gangs can chos 'phel du sleb tsam byas/ de nas mtshan 'gros kyis myur bar bcad nas rang gnas chos lung du sleb/ de mtshams rje drung rin po che jo nang pa gting skyes phyogs nas sku 'khor 'phral chos lung du phebs pa dang mjal/ de'i sang nub nas 'brum pa'i skya nad kyis the bas/ rmi lam du khrag gi mtsho zhig gi nang du lus bying ba/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi yin zer ba'i mi dkar po zhig gis bton pa rmis/ de lo bzlas pa'i rigs dang zas spyod sogs 'brum pa yang ba'i thabs byed pa ma byung zhing*/ de gong nas kyang rtog pa rtsing nge ba dang*/ nad khog tu zhugs nas kyang skya nad mngon du ma gyur bar du spyod log 'dra yang byung song bas yin pa 'dra/ zhag nyi shu skor du shin tu na ba rang byung*/ 'on kyang nad gzhug yun ring ma byung*/ 'brum lkogs byed gogs tsam la sde pa rin po che ka bzhi nas bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang zhu bar phebs byung*/ snga sor nas gsung phebs pa dang sku snangs che bas chos sgugs yin rings gnang dgos byung na mi legs par shes te/ kha gso'i bsnyen pa 'phral du btsugs/ bar bar du dpe lta dgos par byung bas phyis mig la gnod pa zhig byung*/ mtshams grol 'phral sku rkyang du dbang bskur tshar gcig dang*/

gzhan dbang cha gcig pa zhig byas/ de skabs rin po che'i drung gis mngon rtogs 'chag med gnang ba'i dam bca' gnang song na'ang*/ zla ba lnga tsam nas dbus nas mi ched btad gnang ba zhig la bde mchog gi mngon rtogs chen mo mi lcogs pa 'dug pas dam bca' 'grol dgos phebs byung*/ dpal gro nas rje btsun drung yang chos lung du khor tsam phebs rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs shig dgos gsung pa ltar phul/ de yang yin ni gnyis thad nas phyi'i mdzes khrigs tsam gyi tshul ka yin khog pa long mnyam du gda'/ lar yang 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi chos zhu ba rang mang lags/ bar skabs su sgrub sde'i sgrigs lhod por song 'dug pas phan du re nas bslab pa 'chal nges mngon mtshan can gnyis bskrad/ gzhan rnams la snyan 'bul gang drag byas kyang chos lung smon 'gro yon mchod thams cad dges pa ni mi 'dug go / spyan 'dren nan zhus byas pa ltar brag stod nas rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal snga nas dpon slob rnams kyang 'di skabs phebs/ thog mar zhag gnyis gsum tsam kun gsal du sku ngal gso ba gnang zhing*/ de mtshams nas skyid phug nyid du bzhugs yul gnang*/ 'grel chen dri med 'od dang*/ rdo rje snying 'grel dang dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung mang po dang bcas pa'i lung nod cing*/ spyir bla ma dam pa 'di dang 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can las legs par thob pa rnams bsdoms na/ dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang*/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi gzhung 'grel dpag tu med pa'i lung thob bo/ / 'di skabs rdo rje gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa dang*/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ rngog pa'i rgyud ṭīka dang man ngag sa ra ha'i chos lnga sogs kyi lung thob cing*/ gzhan yang rjes gnang dang byin rlabs 'ga' re zhus/ de ltar na chos sna rnam grangs re'i chos thun che ba re ma chag pa dang*/

phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor dang*/ sems nyid ngal gso'i khrid la nyams khrid du zhus te zhag po gsum gsum nas 'char sgo dang bstun dmigs pa spo ba sogs gnang*/ dus chen gyi snga phyi thams cad bsdoms pas zla ba lnga tsam sgom blo byas pas mi rtog pa kra kri dang gsal rig ngo mthong tsam ma gtogs thag chod rang zhig ma byung*/ dus chen gyi bde mchog sgrub mchod la rje btsun bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon por phebs shing*/ las kyi rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis bgyis/ gzhi byes bsdoms pas bde mchog sgrub mchod pa mchod khang du mi shong ba tsam byung*/ lo snga ma stag lo de dus chen chen mo yin yang dus gzings kyi stabs zhabs tog bzab rgyas rang ma byung 'dug pas/ de'i dod du de lo rgyal gyi zla ba nas brtsams dus chen gtso bor gyur pa'i 'jug gi hor zla gnyis pa'i mgo sgang yan chad tsam la lag nas mang ja lnga bcu tsam dang*/ 'bras 'jam bcu tsam/ dar 'gyed gsum/ skam 'gyed snga phyir lan bzhi tsam/ yon bdag so so'i phyogs nas bskul ba dang bcas pa kun dril bas mang ja brgya drug cu tsam/ 'jam bzhi bcu zhe drug tsam byung zhing*/ yar 'brog yan chad nas yon bdag so sos/ rje dam pa'i dus dran nyin la dmigs pa'i 'gyed sogs dpag tu med pa byung zhing*/ cho 'phrul dus chen gyi tshes dgu la ngam ring nas mang ja sbrel ma dang bsngo rten bzang ba bcu gcig tshan/ gral 'gyed dkyus mthun dang*/ spyir nas khal sum cu tsam zhig byung*/ phyi ltar du sku rim yin pa'i khungs 'dug na'ang*/ ngo bo ni bdag po nam mkha' rgyal po'i dgongs rdzogs su 'dugadus chen grol khar yar 'brog nas sde pa sgo mang shod pa gshegs pa'i mang ja bsngo rten rnams kyang 'byor/ rje btsun bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon por bzhugs/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu zhig gi sgrub pa brtsams te/ phye ma dang lde gu'i zhag la dri bzang che ba rang yod na'ang*/

tshogs rdzas la dam sel can zhig 'dres pa'i rkyen gyis de 'phral rang dri bzang yal ba zhig byung*/ yang zhag gsum tsam sgrub pa skyor ma mdzad pas ka pā la'i nang du bdud rtsi dkar po dngos su babs pa dang*/ rdzas rnams las tsheg sgra brgyud mar byung zhing dri bzang chen pos rtse zhol thams cad khyab pa byung*/ ril bu'i sgrub pa zin skabs/ rje btsun bla ma'i drung du ril bu thod pa gang nam mkha' la 'phar ba dang*/ mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa'i gsal snang khyad par can byung bar 'dugade skabs bstan 'dzin rin po che ni 'brum 'dzem gyi stabs bla ma dam pa spyan 'dren gnang stabs ma bde gsung nas yar ja zhus shig gnang byung*/ 'dir sdod pa'i snga phyi bsdoms pa la 'dul ba'i 'phros nan tan du bklags mdo rtsa dang gtam rgyud thams cad sbyor thub pa tsam byung*/ de nas dngos cag lho phyogs su 'gro ba'i rtsis yin na'ang*/ yar 'brog nas sde pa bstan 'dzin drung sku khams ma 'tsho ba'i stabs nas chos dbang ba 'bod mir byung zhing gsang brtol dang sgo bstun gyi sleb dgos tshul 'dug pa nas mar phyogs 'gro dgos shar/ slar ma phyogs 'khor ba'i lho mtshams ri khrod cig la bsgril bar blo thag gcod pa'i lugs su byas/ de nas smon 'gro khram phu jo nang o rgyan rdzong snar thang tshong 'dus bsam sdings sogs brgyud 'dol byung du zhal bcu gnyis tsam sgug dgos byung*/ de nas rtse chen gyi klu sdings dang rgyal rtser yang bcags mal zhig 'gor/ hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes drug la sna dkar rtser sleb/ de skabs dgongs rdzogs kyi sgrub mchod mngon dga' ba thar gling pa 'dzam gling chos 'khor ba rnams la re re bzhin grwa pa brgya skor gyis kun rig gi chog grwa dang*/ gzhan yang dgon pa so so'i chog grwa chung chung mang po 'dug cing*/ dngos can dpon slob bcu bzhi tsam gyis gdung gi rtsar snga dro mi 'khrugs pa dang*/

phyi dro rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga re byas shing*/ bdag rang la yon bdag gi sa nas sde pa de drin can yin/ sku sdig kyang che rab yod pas dngos kyi lag nas kyang dgongs rdzogs gang grag bgyis shing*/ khyad par thugs yid bsre ba'i khungs su byas te de'i ngang nas bzlas brjod sogs sku sgrib sbyong ba'i thabs la nyin mtshan du 'bad rtsol bton/ gdung 'bul ba grag grag thams cad kyis bsngo zhus re yang 'bul ba srol du 'dug pas nyin re la yang bsngo ba lan mang du byed dgos thams cad la yang bsam pa thag pa nas smon lam btab/ dgongs rdzogs ngo bo zhal nyi shu rtsa gnyis song zhing*/ dngos gzhi'i nyin mo 'tshom chen du dge 'dun stong bud pa tshogs pa'i gral dbur phyin/ de mtshams 'dzam gling chos 'khor du zhag gcig bsdad/ 'di skabs kyang 'brang du khor tsam phyin nas drin can ma sogs mi ngo rnams dang 'phrad/ so so'i thugs bzhed kyi chos 'dra byas nged rang skyes dus nas mi ring bar skyes pa son 'debs po med par rang skyes pa'i bse ba mon pa tsho nam se zer ba de tshan la me tog dmar chil ba shar 'dug pas/

de'i rtsar chos thun re byas/ slar tshul lam sna dkar rtser sde pa ma chen gyi gdung 'od bzhu byas/ yon mchod lhan du stag lung gi chos sder byon/ zhal ngo so so'i dgongs bzhed dang mthun pa'i dbang chos ci rigs pa dang*/ sde pa rgyal bu'i drung gi dgongs bzhed ltar dgyes mdzad kyi dbang dang mgon po che chung gi rjes gnang sogs phul nas yar 'ongs/ thog mar rgyal rtse'i gzims shag tu zhag shas bsdad/ blo bde nas dpon g.yog tshor sgrol ma nyer gcig dang phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang sogs bzhed chos 'dra bshad/ de skabs shin tu 'tshub cing rmi lam du blo bde nas tsho rang lhag par mos shing lug gnyis kyi brtad so'i bla ma zhig gi bsang gtong gin 'dugaci mdzad pa yin dris pas bsang dud 'di btang bas sngar yang blo bde ba'i skyed tshal 'di'i shing 'di tsam bskams pa yin zer byed tsam bskams 'dug pa rmis/ de sogs sde pa blo bde ba rang la mi dge ba'i rmi ltas mang du byung ba/ sde pa dpal drung rang la ci rigs snyan du phul/ sku rim shin tu rgya che ba rang zhig gnang dgos tshul zhus/ de mtshams rtser yang zhal ngo so sor dgongs bzhed kyi dbang chos 'phran bu phul/ rtse chen du zhag bdun tsam gyi ring la smar khrid bsdus pa zhig dang tshe dbang sogs phul zhing*/ de nas bka' drin mnyam med mkhan rin po che de nyid kyi sku gdung zhugs 'bul la blangs pa gser gling du phyin/ chos 'khor gyi rnal 'byor dbang phyug zer ba'i g.yabs der thog mar sku gdung rin po che dngos la sku khrus gsol dri bzang sogs kyi mchod pa rgya cher phul zhabs la gtugs te smon lam mang du btab/ bla ma dran pa'i gdung shugs kyis mchi ma rang dbang med par byung*/ de nas thab kyi dbus su mchod yul dam par bzhugs su gsol te bsregs blugs kyi mchod pa phul ba na zhugs kyi 'od la dpal be'u dang pad+ma'i rnam pa shin tu gsal ba yun ring po'i bar du byung*/

phyi rol tu yang sgra dang 'od dang me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma kun gyi mig lam du phebs/ de'i sang nyin 'du khang steng der gzhi byes rnams tshogs pa'i dbus su bka' drin mnyam pa med pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mchog nyid kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa zab mo rdzogs pa dang thugs rje'i gzigs pa rtag tu 'jug pa'i don du mchod bsngo rgyas par phul/ mar lam stag rtser phyin pas/ de nas 'dol byung du 'gro rgyu char zhod che grags pas nyang chu rgyas te rab la ma thar bar rtse chen gyi zam pa bskor/ 'dol byung du zla phyed skor bsdad cing*/ sde pa dmag dpon drung dpon g.yog rags bsdus la dgongs bzhed ltar nai gu chos thun gnyis gnyis dang dbang rjes gnang ci rigs pa dang bcas pa phul/ de skabs 'tshub cha che zhing nor bu khyung rtse ba rang gi sde 'jig pa'i ltas yang yang byung*/ grong dkar thub skyel ma la yang sde pa dmag dpon drung rang gis phebs/ phyis mi 'phrad pa'i rten 'brel gsal por byung nas zla bo rnams la'ang de 'phral glengs/ bsam sdings su bdun phrag gnyis pa zhig mun mtshams la brten te sbyor drug bsgoms/ tshong 'dus su pha rin po che tre bo sprul pa'i sku dang mjal/ dpon slob tsho dang lhan du zha lu ri phug gi rten mjal zhib rgyas mdzad/ de nas lu gur rir sde pa rin po che dang mjal zhing zla phyed skor bsdad dgongs bzhed kyi chos 'ga' zhig phul/ dben gnas byang chub chen por bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid cig bshad/ lhun po rtser 'bod mi gnang ba ltar phyin zhag bcu tsam bsdad dbang chos dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ srad rin chen rtse brgyud nas rim pas gting skyes su 'byor mkhar chen du zhag gsum tsam bsdad nas/ chos grwar rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa [rdo rings ba ] 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs 'bring du sleb/ shin tu dgyes pa chen pos bka' stsal lhug par gnang zhing*/

'di skabs zla ba gsum tsam nyin re bzhin gsol ba thon 'phral nas nyi phyed par sku gzhogs su bsdad cing*/ zab mo'i chos gyi gleng slang ba las brtsams te phyi nang gi nges gnas khyad par can dpag tu med pas yid sim par mdzad/ res 'ga' snying po'i don gyi bka' chos zhal kyal gyi tshul du gnang bas bzhad gad chen po'ang yod/ de skabs kyi bka' bkod ci rigs pa zhig ma 'ongs lung bstan kho nar snang zhing*/ bdag gi bla ma de thugs rgyud grol ba zhig yin 'dug na'ang*/ de sngon sbas pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ 'di skabs sbas skungs bton par gda'/ dbang rjes gnang gi rigs ni sku khams log gi dogs zhu ma nus/ rang lo bcu gnyis pa nas 'di yan chad du rang res ni nag po gzhung drugadril bu skor gsum/ lū hi smad lnga/ gshed dmar la bi rū ba'i gzhung brgyad/ mā ya la ku ku ri ba'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang ba/ dpe med mtsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/ dza lan+dha ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs la legs par sbyangs shing don khong du chud pas rnal 'byor ma rgyud phyogs la blo gros byang bar byung*/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun dus tshes bzang pa la 'dul ba 'dzin pa thams cad kyi gtsug rgyan/ mngon pa smra ba thams cad kyi dbang phyugamado sde 'dzin pa thams cad kyi gtso bo/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yab/ rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi rdo rje slob dpon/ rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi mkhan po/ bla ma dam pa mkhas pa'i dbang phyug chen po slob dpon rin po che byams pa lhun grub pa'i zhabs kyis las kyi slob dpon/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang*/ rje drung kun dga' bsod nams sogs kyis las kyi kha skong mdzad de/

bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa yang dag par thob bo/ / 'dir smas pa/ khams gsum bdag po sngon yang lan brgyar thob/ / tshul khrims rin chen rnyed pa brgya la 'ga'/ / snam sbyar rgyal mtshan bsgreng pa'i 'od dmar gyis/ / mtha' dag sa 'di gcig car zil gyis gnon/ / de nas cho 'phrul gyi dus su sde pa zhal ngo rnams kyis bskul ba dang*/ bla ma'i bka' yis gnang ba la brten te dam rdzas kyi sgrub pa zhig kyang byas pas/ phyi ltas su sgra lan gnyis tsam bstud mar byung zhing*/ nang ltar du yang mthong snang ya mtshan che ba tsam byung de skabs bla ma dam pa 'di'i bka' las da lta nas la stod lho phyogs su sgrub pa la bsgril ba ye mi legs pa'i bka' nan yang yang byung bas re zhig de las 'os ma byung*/ slar yang hor zla gsum pa'i nang du bsam sdings su 'ongs/ sleb 'phral nas mtshams dam par bcad/ zla gcig tsam lha phran 'ga'i bsnyen pa byas/ de mtshams su mkhris pa thog babs kyis shin tu na ba nyen po rang zhig byung yang*/ a khus bcos mdzad pas gragaslob dpon rin po che yang gser mdog can dang snar thang sogs la phebs shing*/ slar khyung rtser sde pa dmag dpon drung sku bsnyel ba'i sngas srungs la spyan 'dren zhus/ mi ring bar sde pa'ang sku tshe'i 'phen pa rdzogs pa nas gdung gi 'dog mal dang khrus chog sogs kyang gnang dgos byung 'dug cing*/ khyung rtse ba rang gi zer bun la yang skabs su bab pa'i legs lam gang 'os gnang*/ bdag gi de bar thams cad du rgyal khams kyi 'gyur ba ci rigs pas skyo shas kyis yid drangs nas mtshams dam du bcad cing*/ rmi lam gyi dge sbyor la bsgril bas rmi lam gyi rtsal yang bzang rab byung*/ de sngon chung ngus nas rgyal 'gong gi cho 'phrul gyis rmi lam 'jigs shing mi srun pa sad nas kyang yid bsgyur nus pa yang yang yong ba zhig yod pa/ rang lo bcu drug gi skabs rmi lam cud zad sbyangs pas/

rang nyid rta mgrin du sprul nas 'dul ba'i snang ba zhig byung ba nas rmi lam rtsub 'gyur de khyad kyis nyung ngu song*/ 'di skabs zla ba gsum tsam song skabs shig rmi lam du shin tu zhud che ba'i rnam pa zhig la thang stong chen po zhig nas yar phyin pas/ mi dkar zhwa theb gyon pa'i rta ba shin tu che ba 'jigs pa zhig la 'khor btsun pa dang khrab pa dang mo btsun rgyan can mang po dang 'bag pa dang sngags 'cham pa mang bo sogs sa phyogs de thams cad khyab cing lang long du 'gro ba dang gos sku'i rnam pa zang zing mang pos sa gzhi ri klung med khra chem chem khyab cing*/ de'i gseb nas rta ba 'jigs pa zhig gis nged rang gi gnya' ba nas tshir gyis 'jus nas sga gong du rgyab byung nas phaṭa tsha re rgyal po pe dkar gyi bar chad kyi cho 'phrul yin pa 'dug snyam sems shin tu 'tshab pa la/ spre'u gnyis ltag par zhon nas so shad dang sbar sha byas zhum bu nag po zhig gis mdun nas tshur brad kyin rmugs 'jigs skrag chen po yod tsa na/ ga re 'di thams cad sems kyi snang ba yin pa 'dug snyam pa dang sems kyi rang snang la bzang ngan dgag sgrub blang dor gang yang med pa'i ngo shes thag chod cig lhang gi byung nas de thams cad lhan gyis song*/ snang ba de thams cad kyang rim gyis yal nas 'od gsal yun ring du skyong thub pa zhig byung*/ de'i sang nub rmi lam du rta ba nag po zhig gis snying khar mdung rgyab byung bas snang ba kun sprug thom pa zhig la yal song*/ yang rmi lam gzhan shar ba na 'di thams cad bar do yin par 'dug snyam par ngo zin cing yun ring du sbyang thub par byung*/ 'di phyin chad nas sngar gyi rtsub 'gyur de rtsa ba nas zhi/ yang lan cig rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shin tu gsal ba'i rnam pa 'ja' tshon las grub pa zhig dang rdo rje'i glu che chung de rnams rmi lam du gsal bar byung ba lags te yi ge'i logs su bkod pa las shes par bya'o/

/ de'i phyi nyin dkyil 'khor de dang cho ga'i rnam spyi blo la gsal seng nge ma brjed par 'dug pas slob dpon dam pa sogs mtshams 'og yod pa rnams la gleng slang byung*/ de 'phrul la rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga chen mo shog bu sum cu lhag tsam zhig nyin mo gcig la zin cing byang bar byung rdzun med dpang po can yin/ spyir gyi 'dzin blo che ba min de skabs byin rlabs su gda'/ de lta bu'i mthong snang re zhig bar gzhan la ma bshad na yong rgyur gda' ba la bshad pas cung zad 'phyugs 'dugade nas dbyar gung zla ba gnyis tsam zhig 'dod lha 'ga'i bsnyen pa drag tu byas shing rmi lam gyi dmigs pa'ang zhor la sbyangs/ nam phyed phyed dge sbyor rang la bsgril bas tho rangs 'od gsal re yang rtag tu zin/ de skabs blo bde nas sde pa dpal drung sku gshegs pa la brten te rgyal rtse dpon blon nang 'dzings kyi zir bun de yang byung zhing*/ bsam rtse'i dmag rnams nyang la song mtshams tshong 'dus su zhag gsum bsdad/ sgrol dkar mngon rtogs kyi bshad pa brtsams nas phul ba la shin tu dges pa'i dogs gcod kyis dus 'da' ba byung*/ byang chen du sleb 'phral nas mtshams bsdams/ sgrub sde pa rnams la slob dpon dam pa'i zhal snga nas gcod khrid la sogs pa'i bka' chos mang du gnang*/ sngar bsnyen pa ma song ba'i chos skyong kha cig gi grangs bsnyen tsam re bskyal/ de mtshams shig sman dpon bsod nams phun tshogs rgyal rtse nas 'bod mir gnang byung ba ltar mi ring bar rtser sleb/ drung pa rin po che gu shri grags don pa lho brag la phebs lam rgyal rtse phyogs la byung ba klu sdings su mjal tsam la phyin/ de skabs rgyal rtser zla gcig lhag tsam bsdad/ bdag po ma chen drung rtse chen du bu gter phebs dgos sogs nas sku grib kyi rnam pa dang thugs la'ang bde dog mtho dman che ba rang 'dug pa dang*/

rtse rgyal gyi 'phel gdung yang kha dog nag por song ba sogs nas nyin re bzhin bum pa bsgrubs pa'i rten khrus dang*/ zhal ngo tshor sku khrus phul ba'ang shin tu 'phrod pa'i zhag bcu tsam nas 'phel gdung yang kha tog sor chud/ bdag po ma chen sku grib kyis bying bying de yang sangs/ gshed dmar gyi dbang zhig phul spros med kyi spyan dmigs 'dra yang btab pas thugs kyi bde dog de yang gragade nas myur shad kyis rang gnas bsam sdings su sleb bsnyen mtshams shig byas/ de nas tshong 'dus su zhag shas bsdad/ zha lu'i rten mjal zhib rgyas dang ri phug tu'ang zhag gcig bsdad/ gnas dgon gyi rten rnams la phyag mchod smon lam/ dge 'dun rnams la zhabs tog brda mtshon re thub cing*/ bstan pa spyi sgos dar ba'i smon lam snying thag pa nas yang yang btab/ yang byang chen du zla gnyis tsam lha phran 'dra'i bzlas brjod smin par byung*/ 'di skabs dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal ldan chos bzang spyan drangs te/ don zhags rdor dbyings sogs dbang bka' chen mo 'ga' re zhus/ bla ma'i gsung gis nged bu lugs kyi dbang chos mang po'i dgongs bzhed yod tshe/ rtse chen dbon po ba la zhus na yong phebs kyin 'dug pas/ thog mar 'dus pa 'phags skor gyi zhu 'bul byas/ rten 'brel 'grig na khong pa rang la sku tshe dang 'gro don legs po yong ba yod na'ang*/ ye mi mdzad gsung nas rten 'brel ma 'grigaphyis khong pa sgom mdzad pa'i rjes kyang med/ chos bshad pa'i rjes kyang med pa la dus 'das so/ / de nas dge sdings su dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa bdag chen bsod nams dbang po'i zhabs drung dang mjal/ zhag gnyis sdod phebs pa ltar bsdad/ shing mgon dang 'phel gdung sogs rten khyad par can de dag gi byin rlabs kyang thob/ yar lam 'tshe du mjal 'dod yin yang sku mtshams dam po gnang 'dug pas mjal ma thub/

'di skabs chos lung byang rtser zla ba phyed gsum tsam bsdad/ nged sleb nas zhag po bdun brgyad tsam song dus/ gnas 'byi dpon gnyen blo gros dpal ldan bsnyung ba'i stabs nas/ slob dpon dam pa gser mdog can la phebs song bas/ phyi mtshams se ba la srod thor snga dgongs rnams rje btsun grags pa'i yi ge'i nang nas bshad pa ltar sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i lha rnams kyi bsnyen pa de byas shing*/ nyin gung chos rje lha mchog pa la dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi thig rtsa rnams bslabs/ lag pa mi bde bas bris ni 'bring tsam ka shes/ de skabs dpon gnyer yang thegs 'dugami ring bar slob dpon rin po che nyid gser mdog can spyi bla brang gi mi sna dang bcas chos lung du phebs pa gnang byung ba khong gi phyag rdzas rnams chos 'khor gyi mthun rkyen du sbyor ba yin pas/ da lam cis kyang gser mdog can du yong dgos tshul nan chags phebs pa nas mi ring bar 'gro ba'i sgo dod cing*/ snga sor chos lung du dngos kyi mi sna gnyer pa snga phyir gnyis tsam bskos pa yin na'ang*/ rtse sgrub sde smon 'gro rnams khog gcig pa'i 'dzugs reng gis spod dgos sha stag byung zhing*/ yos lo yar 'brog la 'gro khar khang gsar nas kun dga' legs grub pa bsko bzhag gi skabs/

rtse sgrub kyi mi sna so so dang*/ khyad par smon 'gro nas dpon sa ye shes drung rang la sger du sbyor gtod zhus pa'i legs slob nyes sub mgo 'don gnang dgos tshul zhus nas phyin pa yin na'ang*/ nged kyi mi sna 'bud gang thub rang gi 'phral rtse sgrub sde la 'bog bcog bcol ba'i zar zir zhig gis mgo thon dka' ba zhig byung bas lo gcig song mtshams yos lo'i dpyid ka/ rtse sgrub sde'i mi sna rnams la gnyer rtsis sprad/ de phyin rtse sgrub kyi khog sgyongs smon 'gro rang nas byas pa yin dus/ de mtshams smon 'gro rang nas mgo 'don dgos rgyur 'dug na'ang*/ dgon pa nas za rgyu byung na za/ phyi nas dgra byung ba sogs gang la'ang khur mi 'khyer bar 'dug pas/ rtse sgrub kyi mi sna gnyer 'dzin mi rnams dka' la don chung nge ba zhig gi gnas tshul la brel ba than thun 'dra byung ba nas/ 'di skabs zhag shas 'gor/ de 'dras byed pa de la'ang smon 'gro dang khong tsho rang la gnad cig 'duganged kyis kyang de go nas cha la bzhagade nas mi ring bar smon 'gro/ khram phu/ jo nang sogs su khor re phyin/ de lo jo nang du rdza shar pa dang gling pa zings che ba byung bas dus khrid chag 'dug pa nas/ 'di skabs nged la rje drung rin po che'i bka' phebs pa nas tshogs pa rnams la sbyor drug mgyogs khrid rang zhig bshad/ phu phag dpon chen drung dang rgyal lags la dmar po skor gsum gyi rjes gnang dgos gsung ba ltar byas pa gtor ma lan gsum mgo ma thon par lan bzhi skyor dgos byung*/ de nas lam 'gor sogs gang yang med par mar lam bsam rtse'i klu sdings su zhag gcig bsdad/ sde pa sku mched dang mjal tshe dbang tsam phul/ de nas thub bstan gser mdog can du 'byor/ thub dbang gnas bcu'i gos sku yang zhal 'byed mdzad 'dug pa bzhin phyag mchod smon lam rgyas par byas/ sleb pa'i gnangs nyin nas tshogs chos kyi dbu tshugs/

'di skabs snga dro re bzhin dpal 'khor lo bde mchog slob dpon spyod pa pa'i bzhed srol ltar dngos gzhir dang sta gon re/ de nas tshogs su sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang*/ rgya gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa'i thun re ste nyin re la rjes gnang brgyad dgu re byas/ dgongs phyogs mkhan slob bka' bcu rab 'byams thams cad dang bcas pa sum cu bzhi bcu re la gsol ja bzang nges pa 'debs gnyis gnyis zhus shing*/ de bar du nyin re bzhin dge bshes re res bshad pa mtha' skyong bar mdzad/ 'bel gtam mang pos dogs gcod gleng slang yon tan la phan tshun du thams cad la phan nges byung*/ 'di skabs tshogs su yang mang ja sum cu lhag tsam/ bdag cag dpon slob gnyis thad nas dge 'dun so so'i phyag tu 'bab rgyu rnyed pa'i bkur bsti yang mi lod thub/ bde mchog nag po'i dbang cha sum cu tsam dang*/ tshogs chen du paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po nyid nas brgyud pa'i shangs chos kyi skor tshang ma dang*/ bka' gdams lha bzhi la sogs pa'i rjes gnang zur bka'i rigs mang dag zhig dang*/ khro phu brgya rdza'i lung*/ dril bu rim lnga'i khrid tshul/ bshad pa zhib mo mtha' gcod dgag sgrub dang bcas pa la sogs pa chos sna mang rab dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rags bsdus rnams la bde mchog lū hi pa'i dbang*/ dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang*/ ma hā mā ya/ gdan bzhi sogs dbang bka' 'ga' shas shig dang*/ mkha' spyod ma skor gsum gyi byin rlabs sogs bgyis shing*/ slar bla ma rin po che rnam pa gnyis mjal bzhed kyis yar yong*/ snar thang dang byang chen du zhag shas bsdad cing*/ blo sbyong sogs khrid ci rigs pa yang bshad/ srad brgyud de gting skyes su 'byor/ 'di skabs chos grwar zla gcig tsam bsdad/ de skabs sngar gyi rgyun las ri khrod 'grim 'dod rang rtag tu yod pas/ sgyed lcags phug gi skor de la sdod thub na bsam pa zhig gis yon bdag la khang pa bco thabs kyang zhus/

rgyal ba kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can gyi zhabs drung du sleb cing shin tu dges pa chen po'i bka' stsal mang du gnang ba dang*/ phyin chad yang yang mjal bar dka' ba'i 'dun pas rtse gcig pa'i gdung shugs kyis gsol ba yang yang btab/ bka' phebs thams cad zab cing rgya che ba'i bka' chos kho nar yong ba 'dug cing*/ de min chos bka' ni sku khams log dogs zhu ma nus/ sku gzhogs su bsdad pa la dges par 'dug pas nyin re bzhin sku drung du rgyun ring ba re bsdad/ phyin chad mjal bar dka' ba 'dug snyam pa'i yid skyo sang nge ba yang yang byung*/ phyi mtha' ji bzhin gzigs pa'i bka' phebs la yang da 'u cag lo gcig tsam e sdod ces yang yang gsung gin 'dug pas mchi ma rang dbang med pa 'khrug par byung*/ 'di skabs sde pa zhal ngo rnams la tshe dbang dang rjes gnang sogs ci rigs pa dang*/ grwa rigs grag bsdus dang bcas pa la gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang dang rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dbang zhig byas/ rim pa brag stong rdo rje'i pho brang du sleb/ 'di skabs sku drung du zhag nyi shu rtsa bdun bsdad cing*/ sgrol ma nyer gcig nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi skor rnams dang*/ sgrol ma bla med kyi phyi dkyil dang*/ lus dkyil gyi dbang bskur ba thob/ mchog tu zab pa'i sems khrid phyag chen ga'u ma zhig kyang bskyar nas zhus/ 'di nas khyi lo sku gzhogs su ma 'byor gyi bar tho rangs phyag chen gyi sgom thun re 'chag med byas/ skabs 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag bzhes kyi bka' babs mchog dang ldan pa'i bum can phyi nang byed bcings dang bcas pa zhus shing*/ lo bzhi'i bar du srid la rlung thun 'chag med re yang bsgoms/ 'di skabs kyang sngar ma thob pa'i chos kyi cha lag mang du zhus shing*/ ras chung ba'i bsre 'pho'i gdams skor lhad med rnams dang*/

zhi byed brgyud pa phyi ma'i skor cha tshang ba rnams te zhag nyung yang chos thob shin tu che bar byung*/ spa lung du khor gcig phyin/ rje btsun bla ma dam pas kyang phebs zhag gsum tsam bsdad cing khrom dbang zhig dang*/ chos rje ngag dbang pa dpon slob rags bsdus shig la ma hā mā ya'i dbang bskur zhig bzhed pa ltar byas/ slar yang brag stod du 'byor/ 'di skabs slob dpon pad+ma'i chos skor la rten 'brel gyi sgo 'grig la khang pa la 'phyugs pa zhig byung*/ brag stod sgrub sde ba rnams la dril bu rim lnga'i khrid zhig dang*/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye yang dngos la skra bcad mdzad cing*/ rngog lugs dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang zhig bzhed pa ltar bskur/ yong khar bla ma la brtan bzhugs phul bas rang gi tshe 'phel ba'i ltas cung zad byung*/ de nub bde ba can du bsdad/ nang par lha chur zhag gcig bsdad cing*/ chu 'khor ba sogs kyi mi dmangs rnams la tshe dbang zhig byas/ de nub rmi lam du jo mo g.yu ri ma yin zer ba'i bud med 'khor mang po dang bcas pa zhig byung*/ phyag gsum btsal nas mdun na bsdad 'dugakho na re/ nga nai gu ba la mos pa zhig yin/ khyad par bla ma lha dbang pa'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa zhig yin pas/ sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa skyong ba zhig byung na sa gang na 'dug kyang mthun rkyen sgrub/ chags sdang gi skyed 'phel byed na mi sleb pa 'dug zer/ gnyid sad nas bsam mno la rang gis sgrub pa nus na mthun rkyen dam can thams cad kyis sbyor ba zhig yin 'dug pa la yon bdag grwa rigs sogs kyi ngo dga' ma 'phongs pa'i chos brgyad kyi snang ba kha thal ba'i snyad gzhan phan yin no zer ba'i ling ling chom chom 'di la sangs rgyas byang sems rnams thugs khrel ba lta ci smos/ dkar phyogs kyi 'byung po thams cad kyang zhe khrel 'ded kyin yod par 'dug snyam pa zhig snying nas shar/ de nas yang byang nyi shar chu 'dus sogs brgyud/

dpal ldan rtser bcags mal zhig byas/ byams gling du tsha ba la sleb khong rnams kyis de nyin sdod dbang mo che zhig byed dgos zer/ de 'phral tshe bum bzhengs brda' btang bas khrom chen po rang tshogs ma ṇi'i lung dang tshe dbang zhig byas me tog 'bab pa sogs dge ltas kyang byung*/ de nas mdos 'drar bcags mal zhig bsdad/ rim pas snar thang du sleb/ gzims tshe ba bsnyungs nas zhag shas song 'dug cing de nub rang tshe'i 'phen pa rdzogs de'i khrus chog sogs byed dgos byung*/ tshong 'dus dbu rtser zhal ngo rnams dang mjal zhing dus rim dang thug pa'i zing zing mang po 'dug pas snang ba sgyu ma lta bu la nges shes skye bar byung*/ bla ma dam pa dpal ldan chos bzang gi zhabs dang yang mjal/ rang gnas bsam sdings su sleb ste mtshams zhag bdun ma zhig byas lha phran zhig gi bsnyen pa bskyal/ de nas 'dol byung rtse chen sogs brgyud rgyal rtser 'byor/ sde pa mchen drung snga sor gshed dmar gyi thugs dam rgyun de ka gnang na bar chad zhi ba zhig yong ba yod na'ang*/ zhabs drung bdag po khri chen gyis/ gshed dmar spros med 'dra sprang po'i chos yin/ rdo rje brag rdzong ma rang gis gsungs pas gshed dmar gyi thugs dam 'phro bcad/ mi ring bar sku khams log pa'i thugs la bde dog cher byung 'dug pa/ zhabs drung spyan 'dren gnang 'dug na'ang zhabs drung gi 'chibs dpon dang sde pa gam pa nas kyi phyag g.yog rnams 'khrugs/ thugs sun la gtad rkyen des sku khams shin tu thu bar song 'grongs la khad byung*/ dngos kyis sleb dus zhabs drung ni phyir phebs grub 'dug cing*/ sku khams lod pa rang gi skabs der 'dug pas zla phyed tsam sdod dgos byung*/ gtor dbang dang dmigs pa sogs phul bas bdag po'i drung gi sku khams kyang sor chud cing*/ mnga' bdag rgyal mo'i drung du sku khams bsnyel ba zhig byung ba'ang byabs bkru lan 'ga' yar phul bas 'phral du dwangs/

de skabs gtsang rgyud pa dpon slob thams cad la chos 'brel tsam zhig byas/ bdag rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa mos pas de dus mtshams sbyor zhus pas/ da lta gtsang rgyud pa la rgyal rtse nas chos bar 'degs pa 'di de dus nas byung ba yin/ de gong thugs 'brel mi gda'/ de nas sna dkar rtser sde pa zhal ngo rnams dang mjal/ nan chags kyis sdod gsung bas zhag bdun bsdad/ dgongs bzhed ltar rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi dbang dang tshe rta sogs phul/ rang yul tu 'byor zhag po lnga tsam bsdad/ slar chu bo'i ri'i gru la thon te lcang gling khang gsar du chu shul ba'i zhal ngo rnams dang zhabs drung bkras stobs drung gi lcam chung chung zhig 'phrad par phebs byung*/ de nas skyor mo lung du'ang yum drung dang mjal/ nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang dang gcod khrid bsdus pa zhig phul/ zhag gsum nas zhabs drung rin po che yang phebs byung zhing*/ tshe rta sbrags ma zhig dang mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang zhig dgos phebs pa ltar phul nas slar chos 'khor lha sar sleb zhag gsum tsam bsdad/ phyag mchod smon lam gang 'grub byas/ de nas yer ba lcang lung chos sdings su ma 'phrad gnya' ri khug rnams brgyud nas phyin/ phyag la dgon par stag lung gra nang gling gsum gyi nas bsu ba ja 'dren sogs sleb/ de nas gsol ba gung tshigs kyi thog dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo 'gro ba'i mgon po stag lung pa chen po don gyi slad du mtshan smos te/ rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong zhing*/ sang nyin drung pa rin po che bar le ba rnam rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po yang 'phrad par phebs byung zhing*/ de'i sang gling du sprul pa'i sku dang mjal/ de skabs bzhugs yul ni mgron khang na gnang 'dugagrog khar yang mjal bar phyin pas sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i shin tu dges pa chen pos da ni shin tu yid ches pa rang yin no zhes gzengs bstod pa mang po dang bcas bka' stsal yid la 'bab pa dgyes dgyes dpe med gnang*/

chos kyi 'brel ba than thun zhus myur stabs bzhugs sgar 'degs pa gnang song*/ de nas zla gcig skor chos rdzong rnam rgyal rab brtan rang du bla ma mchog gi zhabs drung kho na bsten cing*/ sngar ma thob pa'i 'gro mgon ri bo che pa'i gsung 'bum ci rigs pa'i lung sogs zab chos mang du zhus shing*/ dngos can lta bu ma bsdams pa/ mi mkhas pa/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa/ sems rnam par ma grol ba'i rang bzhin can 'di lta bus/ dam pa mchog 'di lta bu la chos tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam yang 'bul ba'i rngo thogs pa ga la zhig ste/ 'on kyang bka' nan ches lci ba nas mi 'bul kha med du shar ba ni/ bka' stsal las/ nyid kyis rgya gar ba'i slob dpon 'dra las chos gsar ba mang du thob yong 'dug pa/ de rnams cha tshang ba zhig dgos phebs pa ltar phyag rgya bzhi'i snying po'i byin rlabs thog ma'i rten 'brel du byas nas phal cher 'bul thub/ 'di skabs sgrol ma'i rgyud chen po bsgyur ma grub/ do ha dang sems kyi phyag rgya sogs zhus dag ma grub pas 'gyur ma legs tsam zhig yod/ chos 'di rnams la mchog gi bla ma shin tu thugs dgyes shing tshim pa'i tshul gnang gin 'dug pas chos 'di rnams phul bas bsod nams kyi phung po mtha' med pa thob par shes so/ / de ltar zla gcig tsam nas gnas bcu'i gos sku khyad par can bzhengs pa'i dgongs bzhed kyis bka' phebs so sor gnang ba ltar sprul sku sman thang pa blo bzang rgya mtsho la sogs pa yang sku gzhogs su 'byor/ nged rnams stag lung gling gi gzims spyil du bskyas/ de'i gnangs nyin nas gos sku 'tshem pa'i gra yang tshugs shing*/ dngos kyis zla gcig tsam gyi bar du sprul pa'i sku ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs pad bsten pa la/ spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong klu sgrub lugs kyi dbang dang gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dbang*/ mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang*/

rgyud sde mang po'i lung sogs thob/ bka' nan phebs pa la brten te/ phar phul ba yang bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang*/ bde mchog bong zhal can gyi dbang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa nyer lnga ma'i dbang*/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs lung dang bcas pa/ sgrol ma nyer gcig jo bo lugs kyi rjes gnang dang*/ de la yang rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs kyi lung spel mar mdzad pas/ gang ltar na'ang nyi ma gnyis la byin rlabs rjes gnang brgya dang brgyad lung po ti gcig song*/ gzhan yang dbang bka' rjes gnang ci rigs pa dang*/ grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drugamai tri pa'i a ma na si'i chos skor nyer gnyis/ bka' yis bskul ba'i chos bzhi sogs lung yang mang du phul/ stag lung tshogs su yang sbyor drug shin tu rgyas pa kun mkhyen jo nang pa chen po'i bzhed srol ltar mthar rgyas su byas/ drung pa rin po che bar le bar yang sbyor drug jo zhal gnyis ka'i lugs tshang mar phul/ de ltar zla gcig gi mtshams su gos sku yang legs par grub/

de mtshams dngos la rab gnas byed dgos par bka' stsal te/ mchod khang chen mo'i lha khang shod du gza' skar gyi stabs nas/ sta gon gyi cho ga thams cad srod la grol bar byas/ nam byed nas dngos gzhi'i cho ga btsugs te/ rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi'i cho ga tsha gong du rdzogs par grub pa byas/ slar snga sor bzhengs pa gnang ba'i thub dbang gi gos sku nyid gtso bor mdzad cing*/ de res gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i gnas bcu'i gos sku gnyis po g.yas g.yon du ldem gyi tshul du gnang*/ bla ma dam pa khu dbon dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas brtan bzhugs dang mchod bstod bzab rgyas su gnang*/ me tog gi char 'bab pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung*/ slar rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid seng ge'i khri la gdan chags par mdzad de/ dngos cag cho ga ba rnams kyis rab gnas rjes chog gi shis brjod rgyas pa rnams phul zhing*/ nyin gung bla ma dam pa khu dbon gnyis gtso bor phebs gral pa gzhi byes kyi mi drag tshad 'dus pa la bzhi brgya tsam zhig byung*/ rab gnas dga' ston bsam gyis mi khyab pas gzhi byes thams cad yid brtas par gnang zhing*/ de'i nang bar sku 'bum ltag tu gzhi byes rags bsdus la yang dga' ston rgya chen po gnang*/ slar rab gnas rjes kyi rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg sogs kyang phyag len mtha' rgyas rang byas/ de mtshams nas dpal rwa bsgreng gi gtsug lag khang la phyag mchod bgyid par phyin/ jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje sogs rten byin rlabs can thams cad la gser chab rgyas par phul/ gzhan yang rten thams cad la snyan dar dang*/ lha khang mchod rten thams cad la dar cog sogs gcig la'ang ma chad par 'bul thub cing*/ thams cad la smon lam gyi yi ge sogs thebs/ rmi lam du 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku tshad shin tu che ba zhig kyang gsal bar byung*/ de bzhin du rnal 'byor nam mkha'i sku che la gsal ba zhig kyang rmis/

'di skabs kyang zhag bdun bsdad cing*/ tshogs pa rnams la bka' gdams lha bzhi'i rjes gnang dang khrid bsdus pa zhig byas te zang zing gis kyang der bzhugs rnams yid kyi re ba gang bar gyur to/ / 'di smras pa/ mtha' yas dge ba'i 'od dkar 'bum 'char ba/ / 'di dag sngon goms stobs kyis drangs pa ste/ / zla ba gsar ba gcig 'char mtshar ci yod/ / 'gro kun yid mkhar rtag tu 'char 'di mtshar/ / de nas slar rnam rgyal rab brtan du ri bo che ba'i chos skor 'ga' zhig dang*/ gzhan yang chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig zhus shing*/ 'di skabs rin po che ka bzhi pa'i drung yang sgrags su sku mtshams lo gsum ma song 'phral yin la/ stag lung du rje khu dpon mjal ba dang*/ nged la'ang dbus kyi lho kha la yong dgos tshul nan chags gnang ba dang bcas phebs byung zhing*/ nged kyis kyang de'i gnangs nyin rang stag lung thang nas 'ongs te/ yar bzang du khong tsho la tshe dbang dang mgon po'i rjes gnang zhig dgos zer ba ltar byas/ glang thang du zhag gsum tsam bsdad/ mi dmangs dang bcas pa thams cad la ma ṇi'i lung sogs chos thun re 'chag med dang*/ so so'i 'dod pa'i chos than thun 'dra bshad/ 'di skabs kyang lha sar rten rnams la zhal gser rgyas pa rang 'bul thub cing*/ yer ba nas nan chags gnang ba'i yong dgos tshul phebs pa ltar yer bar phyin/ zhag shas nas sde pa g.yul rgyal drung dpon g.yog 'ga'/ 'tsho byed dge slong na 'o ba/ sman thang blo bzang pa sogs la bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang dang*/ don gnyer so so la mkha' spyod dkar dmar gyi byin rlabs/ rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi rjes gnang*/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi lung bshad/ yum drung du nai gu'i dmigs 'doms bsdus pa zhig dang*/ sde pa'i drung mkha' spyod ma dkar mo la thugs dam gnang bzhed yin 'dug pas mngon rtogs gsar rtsom zhig dgos gsung ba ltar so sor brtsams nas phul/

slar chos 'khor lha sar zhag gsum bsdad/ lha sa nas snga bar langs te/ 'bras spungs su tsha ba la sleb/ 'di skabs rig grwa chen mo'i skabs yin pas tshogs shin tu che bar 'dugamangar hang rdum lnga'i mang ja bzang ba zhig zhus/ 'jam dbyangs [ chos rje ] bkra shis dpal ldan gyi dngul gdung sogs rten rnams la so sor snyan dar dang mchod rdzas gang 'os dang*/ khyad par sngags khang gi rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi sku brnyan chen po'i thugs ka na rwa lo'i sku gdung bzhugs par grags pa la snyan dar gos yug lcags nag gcig la rim gnyis dang mthun pa'i bstod pa brtsams nas bris pa zhig phul/ gsol ba rgyun ring du btab pas byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma cung zad byung*/ thon mi'i yig phud dang rje btsun tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri sogs la'ang dri bzang gi mchod pa dang*/ rgya gar paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa'i sku gdung bzhugs pa'i sa 'bum de la snyan dar kha bcu tsam phul/ smon lam drag tu btab/ mchod rten gyi gung nas/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ga ti ga ti sogs kyi sgra gsal ba zhig byung*/ de nub nor bu dge 'phel du dkon gnyer dpon tshang gi sar gnas tshang byas/ sang gru la thon te 'ongs mgon po gdong gi mgon po la gtor ma zhig phul/ de nub lum par sleb/ zhag lnga drug tsam bsdad tshe dbang sogs rkyen sel gyi chos than thun 'dra byas/ drang srong srin po ri mjal bar phyin 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku brnyan dang*/ byang chub chen po'i zhal tshad/ bde mchog lū hi pa dang dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil thang bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra'i thugs dam rten rgya gar ma yin nges ri mo'i rnam cha phul du byung ba 'dugardo rje rnal 'byor ma'i li ma dang*/ thugs rje chen po nga long ma dang*/ rdo rje gdan gyi bkod pa'i zhal thang de gsum po de/ sngon gyi de dngos rang min pa'i sku tshab yin nam sems pa zhig 'dug pa gang ltar yang de rnams mjal/ phyag mchod gang 'grub byas shing*/

sde pa ka bzhi pa'i drung nas bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang zhig dgos gsung ba ltar de nub byas/ nub mo'ang gtsang khar de kar nyal/ gagag rmi lam du 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha khang shin tu mang ba zhig tu phyin pas/ ga bud med rgan mo zhig gis gser pod chen po zhig gtad byung*/ zhal phye nas bltas pas 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa rgyud du 'dug cing*/ mchan bu rig mi ga cig pa shin tu mang ba rgyab pa'i yi ge rnams kyang gser dngul spang mthing mtshal sogs sna tshogs pas bris pa'i khra chem chem pa zhig 'dugade nyid du ni de dbyer med/ / zhes pa'i rjes su/ 'dod pa dug gi lo ma dag/ sgrub po nyams nga med spyod pa/ / rigs lnga la ni mngon bgrod nas/ / sman gyi dbang po rigs gcig brtag/ lha dang lha min zil gnon cing*/ / pho nya rnams kyis rab tu 'khyud/ / sbyor ba bde ba'i ngang tshul can/ blo ldan rnal 'byor ma la bsrub/ / ces pa'-i tshigs bcad yod pa zhig dang*/ 'jug na/ shin tu rnyed par dka' ba ni/ / gzhan gyis rtogs pa ma yin te/ blo ldan khyod la bstan pa yin/ / 'on kyang rkyen gzhan dag gis bsgribs/ / zhes pa zhig 'dugader rmi lam du shes de bud med rgan mor 'ong ba 'di dam tshig gi skyon cung zad yod pa'i brdar 'dug snyam nas/ bshags bsdams mang du byed kyin 'dug pas de nyid bu mo gzhon nu zhig tu song nas lus kyi g.yon phyogs la thim pa snyam byed pa na/ rmi lam gyi snang ba yal zhing bde bas rgyal ba 'dra ba'i 'od gsal 'thug po yun ring bar byung ngo*/ / sang nyin yang rdzong du ma slaib bar du snang ba 'gyur zhing lus bde cham me 'dug pa la rdzong nang du sleb pa na yal nas song gnas kyi grib yin nam sems/ srin po rir bde mchog gi bstod pa rim lnga dang mthun pa de brtsams so/ / de nas sgrags mdar sgrags rgyal byed tshal pa dpon slob rnams kyang phebs byung zhing*/ slob dpon pa la bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang dgos gsung ba ltar bgyis/

sngags grwa'i bla ma bgres po rnying ba rang yin kyang bla med kyi dbang zhu mi mkhyen pa cig 'dugade'i sang rdo mchod thang kha'i rdo'i mchod rten rnams la byin rlabs re zhus shing mchod pa dang na bza' re phul smon lam btab/ chos 'khor chen po bsam yas su sleb lha khang rnams la zhib mjal du byas/ byang chub chen po la gser zhal phul/ ar+ya pa lo gling gi spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma/ 'od zer can ma gsum/ sems bskyed byang chub gling gi de bzhin gshegs pa ma chags pad+ma rnams la'ang gser zhal re sbron/ srod la rmi lam du lung pa skyid po zhig gi nags gseb cig na khang pa dmar po chen mo blos mi 'khyud pa zhig 'dugade'i nang du sleb tsa na rtsig rdo thams cad mi mgor song ste/ kha 'phrul mig 'phrul byas gad mo dir dir 'jigs pa ston du byung*/ de thams cad bden med sgyu ma lta bu shes nas cham me mnyam par bzhag pas/ khang stong de'i gseb nas nga ma 'ching zer ba'i sgra lhang lhang byung*/ de nas ji zhig na de rnams yal te skyes pa gzhon nu lus che zhing mdzes pa gos dkar po gyon pa zhig gus gus ltar phyag btsal dar dkar po zhig phul/ sha khog gcig gtad pa rmi/ sang nyin mchims phu mjal/ de nyin gnas tshang ba'i gnyen tshan khyo kha zhig chus khyer nas shi/ de nub rmi lam du mdang gi mi dkar po de byung nas khyod kyi gang dgos ngas byed pa yin zer/ nga la khyed kyis sgrub dgos cang med byas pa rmi/ sems bskyed bsdus pa zhig de la bshad pa lta bu ha cang gsal ba min tsam zhig byung*/ phyis bla ma dam pa la zhus dus/ rang re la tshar chad chod tshad 'grig pa ni yin/ mi gzhan la gnod pa yong ba de dam thogs ni min gsung*/ dwags la skor du bde mchog gi rgyud nas bshad pa'i bcu bzhi pa dang tshes brgyad nyin/ de yi dus tshigs yin par bshad/ khyim du mdung rtse gsum pa yang*/ / bris nas de ni rtag tu mchod/

/ ces pa'i rnam cha gsal por mthong*/ / de res gong du lha sa na yod dus mi ldog ma'i mtshan nyid can gyi [ brdab ] pho nya mo'i rigs cig yod pa'i gtam bden nges byung*/ mthong ni ma mthong*/ bsam yas rang na'ang zhing gi rnal 'byor ma dngos su 'dug par mthong zhing shes/ de gsum zla gcig gi nang du yin/ de nas de ka'i thad nas ko ba la zhugs te/ 'brong zhol du bcad de yar lam bye rdzing tshogs pa rnams kyis bsu ba bzabs/ grub chen khyung po'i thugs sogs rten ngo mtshar can rnams kyi byin rlabs thob/ tshogs pa rnams la'ang chos 'brel gyi rten 'brel legs tshogs che bar byas te/ de nub byams pa gling du sleb/ sde pa sku gzhon pa phebs 'dugathog mar byams pa'i lha khang mjal/ sang mchod rten chen po'i rten mjal zhib rgyas byas/ mchod rten gyi logs bris rnams mthong ba'i tshe sngar yang lan cig yongs pa 'dra ba zhig gi rig pa yul yul ba dang*/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i gser sku de mthong dus dga' skyo zung du 'brel ba zhig byung*/ de nas rgyal chen gling du zhag bzhi bsdad/ tshogs pa dge 'dun sgang pa rnams kyi tshogs khang du dpon slob thams cad la bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig spyi chos su byas/ rting la rang rang so so'i 'dod chos zhu mkhan rnam grangs mang ba rang byung*/ mkhan po kun blo ba yin/ sde pa lcam sring du yang tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang rjes gnang rnam grangs mang ba phul/ nyin re bzhin bde yangs der khrom 'dus che ba la chos thun re bshad/ grwa thang du zhag gsum tsam bsdad cing*/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i dbang bskur sogs so so'i 'dod chos ci rigs pa bshad/ 'di skabs rgya gar tri liṅga nas sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa phyi rol gyi rig gnas sogs la'ang mkhas shing*/ theg pa mchog gi man ngag la shin tu 'dris pa tsang ga shrī zhes pa dpon slob gnyis lha sa mjal zin nas slar rgya gar la ldog phebs pa dang dus 'dzom zhing*/

chos zhu 'dod tsam byung na yang zhu ma thub/ khong yang zhag gcig la yang rtseg 'dam mdzad nas myur por 'byon par 'dugayin na'ang zhag po gnyis lhan du byung ba la gling slang gi sgo nas dogs gcod mang po dang sngar shes pa'i chos kyi yan lag 'dra'i khungs kyang chod par byung/ khong byon pa'i rkyen gyis gang ga gi ri'i gnas tshul 'dri mkhan mang du byung bas/ ngas lar bod la yong ba'i a tsa ra phal cher phyi pa ka yin/ khong pa yang mu stegs pa yin zhing bslabs shes kyi yon tan rang ni yod rigs su mi 'dugagazhan gnas tshul ni mi shes zhes smras/ sa skya zhabs drung khri chen gyis grub thob yin rgyu'i bsngags brjod mdzad 'dug pas/ nged kyis drang por smras pa la/ dpon sa'i drung sogs thams cad bden par mi 'dzin pa 'dug ste phyis rang rtags bstan pa de yin/ de nas dol mda' lhun grub lha rtser sde pa a khu drung pa khu dpon rnams dang mjal zhag bdun tsam bsdad/ chos zhu ba mang dag yod pa rnams la khrid lung sogs kyi chos smrar ba dang*/ zhal ngo rnams la'ang rkyen sel than thun phul/ yul tsho yul tsho'i mi dmangs rnams la ma ṇi'i lung*/ smyung gnas la sogs pa 'phral 'phral byed dgos byung*/ chos rdzong tshogs pa rnams kyang chos 'brel zhu bar byung*/ dar phyung du'ang zhag gcig phyin/ byi rdzing mkhan po dpon slob rnams la bzhed don gyi gtso bo khrid brgya bshad lhan du skyid gshongs su 'ongs/ gsang phu ra ba smad pa dpon slob tshang ma la rjes gnang 'ga' zhig chos 'brel du byas/ mkhan chen dpon slob dang gzhan don gnyer mang rab la lung gi 'phros dang*/ ma hā mā ya'i dbang bskur/ bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs/ de gnyis kyi khrid chen mo ngag thog nas mgyogs khrid rnams phul/ gong dkar nas gong ma khu dpon gyis yong dgos tshul phebs/ lam mi 'chag la chos sder phyin/ klu dbang gling du chos rje 'bul dpon pa dang co 'dri byed res 'dra byung*/

bla ma lha khang du bla chen drung yang phebs rten thams cad la chos rje ri grong bas rten bshad bzabs/ de nub sa srib la gzhis kar sleb/ sang zhogs zhabs drung mi dbang drung dang mjal 'phrad kyi legs lam thog mar spel/ ka bcur gong ma rin po che ma chen dang mjal kha zhus dus/ phyag len dang gdan mthong sogs mthong zos dpe med gnang*/ de'i sang nyin chos sde'i nang mjal zhib rgyas byed par phyin/ de dus yo ga sgrub mchod kyi skabs na 'dug pas yo ga'i dkyil chen rnams la bshad pa cung zad byas/ dge slong rdor grags sogs mchog tu ngo mtshar zhing dgyes/ chos sder mang ja dang spos shel brgya lhag pa'i brgya phrang sogs spyi 'bul byas/ yangs pa can du rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal gyi gdung rten la phyag mchod 'bul bar phyin/ sprul sku sbyin pa'i nang du'ang shog zer ba bzhin phyin/ slar yang gzhis kar zhal ngo so so'i dgongs bzhed ltar chos sna mang tsam phul zhing*/ mi dbang drung du gnyos mgon gyi rjes gnang zhig dgos zhes nan gyis phebs pa ltar 'bul dgos byung bas shin tu 'tshub pa rang zhig byung*/
