gzhan chos 'dod mang por chos sna sad sud mang du bshad/ zhal ngo rnams sngar gzhan zer gyi dbang las de gong du thugs mthong cher med na'ang dngos su mjal ba nas brtsams thugs mos kyang che bar gnang gin 'dugazhabs drung mi dbang drung gis brtag dpyad kyi tshul du thugs dam thang ka mang po la bstod pa smon lam sogs kyi rgyab yig 'bri dgos dang*/ gsol 'debs dang zhal gdams sogs sku gzhogs su 'phral du 'bri dgos mang du byung*/ de rnams thogs med du bris rtsom shin tu myur ba dang tshig don yang legs rab byung bas/ gzhan dag la phebs sgor yang*/ rje dam pa'i rnam 'phrul yin min gang ltar yang kho rang gis chog pa 'dug gsung*/ de skabs ga ri pa de ba zer ba'i dza gam mthu chen gcig gis khol brnyas pa byas zer/ gong ma zhal ngo rang la ngan byed grabs 'dug pa la ngas zhib sed sel sbyangs byas kho rang yang sems zhi song*/ de nas 'brang phur zhag gnyis gsum ngal gso byas shing*/ de mtshams drin can gyi ma la nai gu'i zab khrid snying por bsgril ba chos drug stan thog gcig ma zhal shes dang bcas nas phul/ mi ngo byings la dang po mes po rin po cher dbang bskur thob sa de nyid du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang bskur zhig byas/ bla ma dam pa slob dpon rin po cher yang*/ mi nge rnams ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa nag po dang*/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu sogs kyi rjes gnang zhur bcugamakhan chen rin chen shes rab pas de skabs 'bod mi nan chags gnang ba ltar gnam bzhir phyin/ dmar po skor gsum gyi rjes gnang zhig dgongs bzhed ltar dpon slob 'ga' shas la byas/ de skabs chos lung byang rtse'i chos gzhis 'ga' shas rje btsun dpal groms btsan phrogs byas nas mtshod du phul/ mtshod nas kyang chos dam tshig mi dgos par bla ma'i gdan sa rlag par bzhed pa'i dar 'dzugs sogs mdzad 'dugabastan 'dzin rin po che gzhis ka gong dkar du phebs 'dug pa la de thad la zhu mkhan btang bas/

sku dbang gi phebs sgo 'ga' rong gi snyem gnam slongs 'di ngam ring chos sde'i brgyad brgya ma'i mchod thes yin pa chos lung du sbyar bas byang ba'i zhal ngo gang stongs kyi rgyud song zhes sogs ra thon lug thon mang po gsung gin don ma mthong*/ de nas nged rnams skyas su sleb dus/ rgya gar lho phyogs bhi na da'i ri'i khongs bhaṃ dwa zhes pa'i yul nas rig sngags grub pa'i rgyal po pa la bha dras/ dngos la 'phrin yig gau ra'i yi ge saṃ skṛ ta'i skad kyis bris pa/ bod skad du bsgyur na 'di ltar/ ri kha ba can gyi khongs na grub thob zhi ba sbas pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa gcig pu gnyis su med pa ni/ tā ra gu ru khyed yin zhes thos/ bsod nams kyi stobs mi dman par spyod pa'i rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug nga dang yang*/ srid pa gzhan du 'thams pa yin zhes grub pa'i lung las 'byung*/ de'i don du ba ṭo la dzar+bha gnyis dang sur dza kran t+ya gcig zung mchis/ rā dzā pā traṃ/ zhes pa'i 'phrin yig rten bcas gser chu'i thaṃ khas mnan pa/ i li khaṃ zhes pa'i rgyal rigs ldom bu'i chas su zhugs pa zhig lha sa mjal ba la ched kyis 'ongs pa la bskur nas byung*/ 'phags pa'i yul du sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa gsar du dar bar mdzad pa'i rgyal po khong gcig pu yin par thos shing*/ khyad par grub chen zhi ba'i slob ma thams cad rgyal po de'i bsngags pa mdzad pa yang yang thos pas/ bstan pa nub tu nye ba na/ ri bo 'bigs byed kyi nang du dam pa'i chos gsar du dar bar byed par 'byung bar rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs pa de nyid yin tshul sogs kyi bstod bkur rgya che ba kha gsag dang bcas pa'i lan yang brdzangs/ sang gi lam du longs spyod chen po dang bcas bzhin du slong mo pa mang po yang phyi bzhin du 'brang bzhin pa la kha zas dang yon gyi sbyin pas tshim par byas te/ sna dkar rtser sleb de mtshams nas thog mar stag lung gi chos sde'i bla brang dkar por 'byor zhing*/

sde pa zhal ngo rnams dang gzhan mang por gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dbang bskur/ gur zhal gyi rjes gnang*/ mgon pod me 'bar ma dang zhal gyi sgrub yig cha tshang ba'i lung*/ sgyu lus dbang mo che'i byin rlabs kyis sgo phye ste/ nai gu'i 'khrid tshul spyi nye bar bsdus pa 'bring po'i dbang du byas pa rnams phul/ chos rje sngags ram pa dang*/ shar chen slob dpon pa sogs slob dpon las thog pa gsum/ grwa rigs don gnyer che ba mang dag dang bcas la bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang*/ dril bu rim lnga'i khrid/ lū hi pa'i khrid rnams dmigs pa nges shing mtha' gcod bshad pa zhib mo byas/ chos rje sngags ram pas nan tan gyi dgos gsung nas nyung bsdus la nag po rim bzhi smar khrid de yang bshad/ de rjes chu shul nas dpon sa phebs pa'i shis brjod sogs kyang bgyis/ zhal ngo spyi mthun du tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang rjes gnang 'ga' shas phul/ rim pas brgyud nas chos sde'i ser bsgreng sogs bsu ba bzab ma dang bcas nas rgyal rtser sleb/ 'di skabs zhag bcu lhag bsdad/ rtse chen dang stag rtser gzims dpon thad smad pa tsho brtib pa'i zar zir gyi skabs yin/ khyung rtse dang 'dol byung nas 'bod mi nan chags byung na'ang ma phyin/ lhun grub rtser kun spangs drung gis sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang*/ tshe dbang 'dra dgos gsung ba ltar byas/ slar bsam sdings su sleb phyi mtshams su bsdams/ zhag bcu skor zhig mang bskol 'gyed bcas kyi bkod pa dgos pa byung ba nas nang mtshams ma thub/ de nas mang bskor ba rnams kyang brdzangs te/ gtsang phyogs kyi mdo sngags kyi grwa sa dang*/ chos sde grags chen thams cad la mang ja 'gyed bcas bzang ba re grub/ sems nyid rtogs par smon lam btab/ thag nye ba nas ri phug dang dga' ba gdong du mang ja 'phral 'phral drangs/ gser mdog can du yang dgun thog de la mang ja nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam zhu thub/

mang bskol ba rnams brdzangs 'phral nang mtshams dam du bcad/ de gong zla ba gnyis tsam gyi sngon nas bsag sbyangs 'go tshugs zin pa dang zhag bcu skor de la srog thor snga dgongs rnams smar po byed rgyu byung bas/ nang mtshams bcad nas dgyes pa rdo rje'i rtsa sngags kyi bsnyen pa'i dngos gzhi la zhugs/ zla ba gnyis su nye ba tsam song skabs/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bdun gyi tho rangs/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can gyi sku'i rnam pa shin tu gsal ba snam sbyar gser ma sku la gsol ba zhig byung*/ bdag la byin rlabs shig gnang nas skas shin tu ring ba rtse mo mngon mi mngon zhig la yar phebs song ba zhig byung*/ gnyid sad tsam na blo yang ma bde zhing nyin gung thun mtshams kyi skabs slob dpon rin po che dang pha rgan dang mtshams g.yog rnams la'ang rmi lam yang bshad/ tshes bcu la dbyings su thim pa'i gnas tshul skyel mi byung ba/ bsnyen mtshams yin na'ang hor 'don byas te 'phral du 'gro rtsis kyi grabs kyang byas/ grang reg skyob pa'i gos 'dra yang brtsems/ gnas tshul skyel mi rnams la bla ma dam pa chos dbyings su thim khar sku gzhogs su 'byor ma thub pa 'dis nged ma sleb par zhugs 'bul 'then dgos tshul nan chags rang byas/ khong tshos kyang myur shad phyin pa'i nged kyi yi ge dang ngag lan thams cad 'byor 'dug ste/ de la ma nyan par tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin zhugs 'bul byas 'dugade kas phyogs de'i rten 'brel 'ga' re sgrig rgyu yod de cung zad 'chugs pa der 'dugade'i gnas tshul yang 'phral du byung bas de phyin bla ma'i phyag rdzas za bar phyin pa la dgos pa mi 'dug pas/ de bas bsnyen pa rang don che bar bsam te/ nye skor gyi dgon sde che sa rnams la dgongs rdzogs la dmigs pa'i mang ja 'gyed bcas gang drag bgyis shing*/ bzlas pa'i ngang nas bla ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i smon lam nyin re bzhin yid kyis 'debs pa bsnyen pa 'di ma grol bar la byas/

nam dus bzang bas rig pa dwangs pa dang rtsol ba bskyed de nam gung cung zad tsam ma gtogs gnyid kyang ye ma log par bzlas pas grangs bsnyen zla ba bdun du nye ba tsam la song*/ de mtshams rgyal rtse nas zhabs drung bla ma dpon slob gser mdog can du phebs pa'i lam zhor du bsam sding su'ang phebs byung ba/ gang spyi'i snyan bskul yang nang sbyar blo la shar tshad phul/ de nas hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bdun gyi nub mo rmi lam du bud med cig la bkra shis kha btags kyi mdud pa zhig byin te shi ba gsos pa yin no zer ba zhig rmi/ sang nyin rgyal rtse nas nang so dpal 'phel ba byung nas dpon sa gting skyes nas 'phral du sku shin tu bsnyel ba zhig byung ba/ sku 'tsho mi 'tsho'i thad du sleb 'dug 'phral du yong dgos phebs pa zhig byung ba mdang gi rmi lam dang sbyar na de res cang mi yong bar nges bsam nas/ da lam yong mi dgos shing skyon mi yong ba'i khag 'khur sku rim 'di tsho mdzad dgos zhes sku rim 'dra phog bkra shis kha btags kyi sngags mdud zhig kyang yar bskur/ khong de dus 'khang nge byed kyin 'dug na'ang phyis nged kyi tshig bden par byung*/ de nas zhag gsum tsam bsnyen pa kha gsos nas zhag bcu'i bar kha skong gi sbyin sreg rdzogs par byas/ de ka'i ring la gtsang rgyud pa rnams kyis drug cu pa dang*/ mgon po'i gtor chen zhig mdzad du bcug pas byad kha bzlog pa'i ltas shig kyang byung*/ nyer lnga'i nub zhig nyams dang rmi lam cha mi phyed pa zhig la o rgyan gyi dur khrod yin zer ba dur khrod zhig gi dbus na chos khri chen po zhig 'dug pa'i steng na/ he badz+ra zhal phyag yongs rdzogs sku tshad thog so do tsam shel sngon po las grub pa 'dra ba/ de spyan hrig hrig zhal 'dzum 'dzum mdzad pa mthong ba tsam gyis 'jigs kyang 'jigs la dga' yang dga' ba zil bzod par dka' zhing bag kyang dro ba rig pa la dpa' ngar yang bskyed thub pa zhig 'dugaro langs yin zer ba brgyad dang lhan du nga rang yang rnal 'byor pa'i chas su bsgyur nas/

aṣ+ta la 'dzab dbyangs byed kyin 'chod rgyug dang skor ba byed kyin 'dugade nas bud med mdzes ma gos sngon po gyon pa gsum byung nas/ thod pa 'o mas gang ba gcig 'dug pa la 'di ci yin dris pas bskyed rim yin zer/ thod pa sbrang gis gang ba zhig 'dug pa la dris pas rdzogs rim yin zer/ khrag gi gang ba zhig 'dug pa la dris pas dam tshig dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag yin zer/ 'o na nga gang nas 'thung byas pas/ sngon la 'o ma 'thung*/ / sbrang dang khrag 'di phyis rim gyis 'thung zer/ der 'o ma de 'thung pas lus nyams mer mer shig shig la yun ring rab song*/ gnyid sad nas kyang nyin gung thugs ma sangs par 'duga'adi rting gzhan yang bsnyen mtshams che ba zhig byed 'dod yong na'ang*/ jo nang du rje drung rin po che gshegs pa'i stabs/ jo nang pa rnams kyis 'bod mi nan can dang*/ smon 'gro nas tshe dbang don grub pa dang dpon sa'i drung gi gsung yig yong mi yong gi 'thangs len dang*/ yong par shar tshe gang myur yong dgos pa'i tshul byung*/ ngag mtshams grol nas de 'phral yong ba'i grabs byas/ hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bdun gyi nyin mo khri khang du bla ma dam pa dpal ldan chos bzang mjal tsam byas/ bsam 'grub rtse nas 'bod mi byung ba bzhin tshes brgyad kyi nyin bsam rtser sleb pa'i gzims khang bde ba can gyi logs bris la rab gnas kyi sta gon tshugs par byas/ de'i sang gza' skar bzang ba la rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi byas pas logs bris kyi lha 'ga' res me tog mang du bzhes pa byung*/ me tog byings rnams de 'phral drung 'khor rnams kyis byin rlabs rten la khyer/ gsum bzhi zhig zhag mang rab bsdad par gda'/ sde pa rgyal bu'i drung gis de gong mjal ma myong bas de'i nyin mjal/ tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin ri khrod chen mo jo mo nang du sleb/ sdod sa 'du khang steng gi thigs khang du byas/

gdung 'bul gang bzang bzang gi khungs dgu tshan gsum pa zhig dang de nyin mang ja zhig dang de'i sang mang ja sbrel ma 'gyed bcas dang bcas pa zhig btang*/ jo nang bla brang na ni de skabs rgyu yod pa'i rigs su mi 'dugagazims chung bzang rab yod pa smon 'gro ba rang dang gciganged rnams sleb pa'i nyin gdung gi drung du cho ga zhig btang*/ sang nyin gung tshigs grol mtshams la sku 'bum thang du gzhir bzhugs kyi sgrub sde rnams kyi steng du jo nang rang gi dgon lag rnams dang chos lung sgrub sde dang dkar po ba sogs tshogs dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i 'gyed de yang mdzad cing*/ de mtshams mol gtam rgyas pa dang bcas mchod bsngo rgyas par phul/ dpon drung sku mched la 'du khang steng du ja 'dren gang grag dang shis brjod bkra shis sogs byas/ sgrub sde rnams kyis da res dgongs rdzogs la dmigs pa'i sbyor drug yongs rdzogs shig sgrub sde ngo rkyang la byed dgos tshul nan chags su byung bas zla ba gcig gi bar du sgrub sde spyi nas dkor zos/ sang nyin tshes bco lnga de kha nas khrid kyi 'go btsugs/ sngon 'gro mdor bsdus dmigs pa 'dri ba gtso bor byas zhag bdun tsam la bsdus/ dben gsum gyi dam po zhag bdun gyi skabs mtshams la 'jug khar sgrub sde rnams kyis brtan bzhugs shig kyang mdzad pa bzhin 'du khang rang du mtshams bcad nas bsdad/ rig pa dwangs shing skyid pa la nub re bzhin 'tshub cing cho 'phrul che ba dang*/ dbang gong ma'i skabs mi tshogs kyang shin tu che ba zhig byung zhing*/ dngos gzhi dam po sogs ni ma thub/ sngar gong jo nang gi tshogs su sor spong tsam las sbyor drug yongs rdzogs gnang ba ma byung ba lo mang dag rang song 'dug pas/ 'khrid tshul yongs rdzogs mi nub par bya ba'i phyir yan lag drug kar zhib par bshad cing*/ khyad par rgyud don zhib mor bshad na der tshogs mi rnams kyis mgo rung*/

dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams dgyes par nges shes skyes te/ rgyud don ltar mtha' gcod bshad pa yang shin tu rgyas par byas/ spyir da lta yang kun mkhyen chen po nas brgyud pa chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i khrid yig gi steng nas 'chad pa tsam dang*/ dam po'i phyag len tsam yod pa 'ga' re 'dug na yang*/ kun mkhyen jo nang pa yab sras kyi grub mtha' shes bzhin du skyong ba shin tu dkon par 'dug pa dang*/ jo nang gi gdan sar phebs pa la'ang rje o rgyan rdzong pa sogs 'ga' zhig gis jo nang pa'i lugs kyi dbang khrid sogs gnang yang*/ kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed srol rgyal ba sras bcas kyi gsang tshig don dam gzhan stong du ston pa rdo rje'i gsung seng ge'i sgrar grags pa rnams la zur za dang dgag sgrub mdzad pas/ chos srung phyin chad ma mnyes pa'i gsung ngag mi bde ba sogs ji snyed zhig byung 'dugaspyir dngos can gis shing rta chen po su la'ang dgag sgrub nus pa ma yin pas mchog tu gus par byed mod kyi skabs 'di dag tu ni brton pa bzhi ldan chen po nyid kyi bzhed pa ltar dgag sgrub kyang mtha' chod par byas so/

/ de nas sde pa o lo'i 'bod mi nan chags yod pa ltar gtsang go gnyis ma'i dgon pa bde mchog rtser byin/ 'di skabs gtsug lag khang sogs gsar bzhengs dang mnga' zhabs la grwa khral yang mdzad 'dugazhag bcu bdun tsam bsdad de bar dgon pa ba rnams la 'du khang der snga gro theg chen blo sbyong gi chos thun re dang dgongs mo nai gu'i chos thun re bshad/ thos btsun rab byung byed mkhan gsar ba bdun bcu tsam byung zhing*/ kun dga' dpal bzang yang de skabs kyi grwa pa yin/ bsnyen rdzogs pa'ang bde mchog rtse ba rang bcu gnyis tsam dang phyogs pa 'dra yang bsnan mas bcu bdun tsam byung*/ sde pa rang la sgos su'ang dbang bka' 'dra byas/ de nas rang re'i grwa rigs 'dra dang yon bdag 'dras yang yang bskul ba dang*/ ngam ring nas shog gsung nan chags yod pa ltar blos ma longs pa 'gro ma 'dod pa gcig la yar chas te/ rdod phug po cher chos rje grags bkras pa dang gsung 'phros smar bar byung*/ sang nyin ngam ring gi pho brang du 'byor/ sleb pa'i gnangs nyin rgyal bu'i zhabs drung dang 'jal/ ka bzhi lhor bzhugs gral zhig kyang byung*/ de skabs gcung tshul bas tshod bgam pa'i tshul du/ dus 'khor la brten pa'i dri ba cung zad byas pa la de mthun gyi lan rgyas par btab/ 'di gong du smon 'gro nas tshe dbang don grub pa jo nang du dgongs rdzogs grol 'phral ngam ring du byon pa'i mtho dman phyi nang thams cad du kha log gang shes bcug 'dugazhag shas ma go bar rdzu bskyabs su byas na'ang*/ de mtshams smon 'gro bas jo nang du mi sna zhig phab/ jo nang spyi sa dang smon 'gro ba kha mchu thug ngam rings su zhu gtugs byas/ jo nang pa'i phugs su nged tsho zhugs zer phyogs 'phul glan ga bsnyad brko mngon tshan can byung ba rkyen du song*/ chos lung gi khur len kyang nged gyis byed skabs yin pa la brten pa'i smon 'gro ba dang 'dod pa ma mnyam phyi ltas legs lam chung ba rang zhig byung song*/

bsam 'grub dga' ldan pa'i 'du khang logs bris la rab gnas bsdus pa zhig byas/ rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i sku thang rnying pa gcig dang logs bris gyi lhas me tog bzhes pa mang du byung bas slob dpon pa sogs shin tu dgyes par gyur/ 'di skabs bzang ldan chos sde spyi bas khor gcig cis kyang yong dgos tshul byung bas nyer gnyis kyi nyin phyin/ khong rnams kyis kyang ser bsgreng sogs bzab ma mdzad/ sleb pa'i sang nyin 'jam dbyangs chos khri nas thog ma'i rten 'brel 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang zhig byas pa/ nam mkha' shin tu dwangs pa la nyi ma thog phub nyis rim dang me tog gi char chen po babs pa bsnyon med der tshogs thams cad kyi mig lam du phebs shing*/ grwa pa bgres po thams cad mos gus stobs su gyur pa'i spyan chab rang dbang med par 'byin pa byung*/ da res dus 'khor gyi dbang zhig cis kyang byed dgos zhes thams cad mgrin gcig tu gsung gin 'dug pas/ tshogs pa thams cad la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa zhig byas/ dbang mi bdun brgya lhag tsam byung*/ de rjes drag bsdus la bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang zhig dang*/ tshogs pa byings la nyeng mkho'i lung dang rjes gnang mang du byas/ tshogs su mang ja gsum tsam dang 'gyed bzang ba zhig dang*/ smu rdzing du chos bdag ma la'ang spyan gzigs sogs bzab rgyas phul/ 'di skabs zhag bdun bsdad/ nyer dgu'i nub na dmar du bsdad sang zhogs bzang ldan gyi chos bdag ma 'phreng ba'i rten 'brel gyis khal ma thams cad ngam rings phyogs su mi 'gro bar bzang ldan phyogs la yang yang phyir ldog pa zhig byung*/ ngam rings su 'di skabs rje btsun ma ngag dbang drung la bde mchog yab bka' yum bka' rtsa dbu ma'i khrid sogs gsung phebs ltar byas/ shig khror sgrub sde pa rnams la kyai rdo rje dang dus 'khor gyi dbang*/ gzhan yang bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang cha gnyis tsam dang*/

'jigs byed rwa lugs ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dbang*/ khrid lung rjes gnang sogs chos mi 'phel ba med tsam byung*/ smon 'gro nas chos lung gi phyogs la nged la thob thang gcig kyang med tshul chos lung gi lugs gnyis thams cad smon 'gro ba rang yin tshul kho na zhu ba dang*/ gzhan yang snga phyir blo btang mtshams sna tshogs zhig 'dus pa rnams skabs 'dir mngon mtshan du gyur/ de phyin khong tsho rang la gtod 'dod pa zhig deng rang gi bsam pa la byung na'ang zla po rnams kyi blo la ye mi ran pa 'dugade sta bas nas lo gcig gnyis 'dzin dka' ba zhig yong 'dug pas sde srid rang la dgon bcol zhus/ dbyar gzigs sar yol thang rab gnas la dga' ston ye med pa skam po rang zhig kyang byas/ snga sor jo nang gi khri thog tu rje drung gong ma nyid kyis 'jog pa mdzad pa'i phyag nas gnang ba yin kyang de la 'di yin rang gi dgos pa ma byung bas/ 'di skabs jo nang gi gdan sa la 'gro dgos tshul gyi phebs sgo byung ba/ spyir ni dgon pa sogs kyi zhe 'dod ye med cing gnas nges med du dge sbyor gang 'phel byed pa zhig rang la smon pa yin pa dang khyad par dog 'tshangs kyi rigs la 'dod pa ye med na'ang*/ bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can gyis kyang bka' bkod kyi rim pa mang du gnang ba dang*/ de skabs kyang 'phral du slob dpon rin po che'i bka' las kyang stod phyogs 'dir yon mchod kyi 'brel byed pa la jo nang cis kyang 'dzin pa 'thad/ de 'dra'i chos brgyad kyi snang ba la mi lta na'ang*/ phyogs 'di kun na grub mtha' rang blo'i lam du 'dren pa tsam las jo nang pa yab sras kyi bzhed srol skyod pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ grub mtha'i phyogs 'go things pa tsam yang mi 'dug pas chos tshul gyi bstan pa rang la bsam dgos pa yin zhes nan tan tu gsung bas de blo la gzhag nas sde par yang jo nang gi gdan sa'i khas len zhus/

de min bgyed du sgrub khang yang btab/ der sgrub pa la gzhol ba zhig lag tu longs nad tsam na tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas la yang dka' ba rang med dam snyam pa dang*/ khyad par rang gzhan thams cad la phugs su phan che ba rang zhig yong ba yod na'ang*/ 'gro don du rdzu pa'i bdud kyi 'jug pa 'di spong dka' ba rang zhig byung*/ bla chen gzhan rnams kyis kyang 'di ye ma dgongs par gda'o/ / ngam rings nas phyir 'ongs dus chos rje grags bkras pa cung zad bsnyung nas zhag shas song 'dug pa khong gi gzims khang du 'phrad par phyin/ de nub rang ya mtshan pa'i ltas dang bcas nas grongs/ de nas ri khrod chen po jo mo nang du hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga la sleb/ tshes brgyad kyi nyin gza' skar bzang ba la gdan sar 'khod cing bsko 'ja' sgrog pa dang bla brang gi snga phyi'i rtsis sprod gyi dbang po la gro lung nang so gnang byung*/ de skabs bla brang rnying pa nas sprod snying gi ming btags phran bu las sprod nas sogs ni gcig kyang med/ rtsis len grub mtshams nged rang gis skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam mtshams dam pa rang byas/ phag mo'i rigs shig la bsnyen pa bskyal/ hor zla dgu pa'i gzhug na mar skyid phug gi se ba rnams la me tog mang po gsar du kha 'bus pa'i dung 'dab skya chil le byung*/ dus tshigs ma yin par me tog 'byin pa dge ltas su bshad 'dug pas dge ltas tsam yin la che 'am yin du re ba ni mi gdoga'adi skabs rmi lam du ri chen po zhig gi ngos la 'dzeg pas spang gshongs nyams dga' ba zhig tu sleb byung*/ de na slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas yin zer ba rnal 'byor pa dbu breg mtshar la gzi brjid che ba zhig 'dugade'i drung na bod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bgres sang gis song ba shin tu gzi brjid che ba zhig 'dug pa dwags po rnyi ba rin po che yin zer/ rnal 'byor pa de'i gsung nas nga dang dol po ba ngo bo gcig gsung*/

gzhan de'i gsung nas nga dang yang gcig go gsung ngo*/ / de nas lha khang zhig na rta mgrin gyi sku chen po bzo khyad blo yul las 'das pa zhig 'dugathugs ka'i thad na sbar mthil tsam gcig la drod tsha ring nge ba/ me bzhin du 'od dmar lam lam 'dugarta mgrin 'di kun mkhyen chen po nyid mtshon par 'dugarnal 'byor pa de'i gsung nas 'di lung pa 'di'i rten gtso 'di yin/ rab gnas kyang ngas byas pa yin/ dang po sku gzugs thams cad thugs ka'i 'di 'dra ba zhig yod pa yin phyis lta grub kyi skyon 'gas 'di ltar song gsung*/ sngon gyi byin rlabs kyi rgyun da lta de tsam gnas pa'i brda' ru go / chen po de dag rgyud gcig gsung ba de dag kho rang gi gnas tshul bsam las 'das pa dang*/ de skad gsung ba la'ang dgos pa gzhan rang e yod mi shes 'di skad gsung pa 'di bdag la nyams myong skye tshul lung bstan par 'dugadang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad yong la khad la phyir log kyang des sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dpal sgam po ba'i chos kyis rtogs pa mkha' ltar khyab/ de kas rgyud smin nas phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba 'di la lta bar 'dug go / 'dir smras pa/ dkar nag las kyi ri mo tshor ba bkra / legs par smon lam phyag rgyas btab pa'ang de/ / blo ldan de ltar shes nas nam du yang*/ / zhing sbyong ba la nan tan 'bad par mdzod/ / de nas bde mchog rtse'i rten bzhengs kyi rab gnas la 'bod mi nan can yod pa ltar phyin zhag brgyad tsam sdod dgos byung*/ rab gnas kyi cho ga'ang bod kyi phyag len la rgya gar ba'i phyag len gyis brgyan te gnyis car tshang bar byas/ dngos gzhi'i nub mo rmi lam du gdams ngag rmi lam ma de byung*/ de grol nas sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rje rdo rings pa chen po'i dngul gdung gi rab gnas la gting skyes la 'gro dgos skabs/

bde gling du dbang chos thor bu 'dra byas/ yang chas te 'gor med bkra shis rtser sleb/ de'i sang nyin mkhar chen du sleb pa'i gnangs nyin nas/ dngul gdung rin po che'i rten sgrig gi 'go brtsams/ skye tshang du bzhugs rgyu'i sku 'dra rin po che la thog mar rab gnas shig byas/ de nas dngul gdung rin po che byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od mkha' mthar chags pa la/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phye ste/ cho ga shin tu rgyas pa'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa phul/ rab gnas kyi dga' ston dang yon rdzogs sogs bzang la gya nom pa byung*/ gam pa rdzong nas 'bod mi gnang byung ba ltar khor tsam phyin/ dge grong du phyin khrom dbang zhig bskur/ slar gting skyes su yongs dus/ drung chen sangs snying pa ni thegs 'duga'adi skabs bde mchog bong zhal can dang sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang bskur sogs dbang chos kyang ci rigs par bsgrubs/ de nas myur bar bskyod de/ tshur lam dpal ldan sa skya'i gnas mjal zhib mo byas/ zhabs drung rgyan la mjal kha cig zhus te gu dog mdzad nas mjal ma byung*/ de rjes gdong dga' brgyud lha rtse'i dgon pa bde chen du khrom dbang zhig kyang byas/ myur stabs ri khrod chen po jo nang du sleb/ de nyin tshes lnga yin zhing tshes bcu bzhi la dus khrid tshugs par byas/ de lo khrid yig sogs ma rgyab pas khrid gsar pa mang po ma byung*/ khrid lo ni shin tu legs de khrid ma thebs pa gcig mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bdag nyid kyi rnam thar nges par brjod pa'i rtogs brjod ces bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 2--PAGE 119--PAGE 1-
